Abstract: LLM-generated stories are a popular use case, but they show very low variability. We sample 20,000 total stories from four current models using five prompts. We find that 11 words occur in 88.3% of generated stories, with little difference between models. These words include names (Elias, Mara, Elara), settings (lighthouses), and professions (clockmaker, librarian). These tokens do not often occur in published literature nor pre-training data, but they are found in preference data that is likely to have been used by all current models. Surprisingly, these "lighthouse" stories are infrequent when compared with the average post-training story, much of which contains references to copyrighted characters or adult content. This result demonstrates the potentially disproportionate impact of small datasets combined with powerful alignment algorithms.

</details>


### [33] [Verilog-Evolve: Feedback-Driven and Skill-Evolving Verilog Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26498)
*Zehua Pei,Hui-Ling Zhen,Yu Zhang,Sinno Jialin Pan,Mingxuan Yuan,Bei Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Verilog-Evolve 是一个"反馈驱动 + 技能演化"的 Verilog 生成框架：把规格到 RTL 的过程建模为带版本管理的迭代精化问题，在每个大版本内生成多个互不相同的候选（minor），用可执行工具（iverilog 仿真、Yosys 综合、ABC 时序代理、混合精度 GEMM 下游评估器、可选 DC/SEC）打分，按可配置多目标评分把最优候选提升为大版本；同时把跨会话运行历史蒸馏为可复用的模块化"技能"，经证据门控与外部回放验证后才入库。在 VerilogEval 与混合精度 GEMM 任务上，最终功能成功率提升（Machine 85.3、Human 72.8），同时获得更低的单元数/乘法器数/ABC 延迟/ADP 与下游分数；"经验证发布"的技能演化模式在下游质量与留出通过率上最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 生成 Verilog 的流水线多为"一次性采样 + 功能测试"，存在三点不足：(1) 仅靠模型自反思/自断言作为证据强度很弱，代码可能连编译或仿真都过不了；(2) 功能等价的两份 RTL 在综合后的单元数、布线复杂度、时序代理指标及对加速器内核的适配度上差异巨大，功能正确不等于下游可用；(3) 每次尝试被当作孤立样本，缺乏记录工具结果、提升更优候选、跨任务积累修复知识的版本化机制。已有工作或从黄金 RTL 出发做优化（缺少从自然语言规格出发的生成路径），或提供通用技能演化机制（记忆未与 HDL 工具证据绑定）。因此作者将 Verilog 生成重新表述为"反馈驱动的精化问题"，需要把 LLM 生成与可执行工具闭环、把候选工件版本化，并把成功轨迹转化为可复用技能。

Method: **1) 主/次版本化搜索（Algorithm 1）**：输入任务描述 d 与模块头 h，迭代 R 个大轮次，每轮生成 K 个 minor 候选；评估、记录轨迹，若启用 early-stop 且出现通过者则提前终止本轮 minor 循环；合格集合 A_i 非空时按 (Score, Tie) 取最优 k*，只有当 Score 严格低于当前大版本基线（Improve）且通过 Gate（如留出测试）时才提升为 V_{i+1}，否则保留原版本并继承反馈上下文。

**2) 候选多样性**：两类来源——生成策略（direct 直接生成、c_bridge 先生成 C 风格功能参考再转 Verilog、feedback-conditioned repair 基于失败评估器的结构化反馈做定点修复，功能不匹配触发复位/符号位/位宽修复提示，综合失败触发不支持构造的简化）与时序/结构多样性计划（PathSelect 优先时序关键路径、结构复杂模块或随机探索；Focus 在组合、时序、混合变换间轮换）。候选 v_{i,k} ~ Strategy × PathSelect × Focus。

**3) 可插拔评估器池**：每个评估器返回 (pass_j, m_j, f_j)。功能评估器用 iverilog/vvp（VerilogEval 框架）区分 passed/mismatch/compile_error/syntax_error/timeout/unknown_failure，并记录失配样本比例、转化为修复提示；Yosys 综合评估器提取 cell_count、wire_count、wire_bits、单元类型分布；ABC 时序代理给出逻辑单元数、DFF 数与 abc_delay_proxy；下游评估器针对混合精度 GEMM 报告乘法器/加法器/DFF/mux 数量、位宽命中、流水线深度代理、面积-延迟积代理与聚合下游分数；可选工业 DC/SEC 评估器返回 SEC 状态、WNS、TNS、面积、功耗、关键路径（也支持仅解析已有报告的 parse-only 模式）；留出晋级评估器用可见测试做修复反馈、仅用生成的随机留出测试做大版本晋级，防止对可见 testbench 过拟合。

**4) 可配置多目标评分**：EvalScore(r) = (Score(r), Pass(r))，Pass 为必选评估器与硬门（如 SEC）的合取；开源模式 Score_open = P_func + P_opt + λ_a A + λ_w W + λ_t T + λ_d D（失配按比例罚分，编译/语法/超时/未知失败为固定罚分，可选评估器失败累加 P_opt）；工业模式 Score_EDA = 0.5·ΔWNS + 0.35·ΔTNS + 0.15·ΔArea + P_area + P_SEC。

**5) 技能检索与跨会话技能演化**：技能以轻量文件存储（含触发条件与可复用领域知识），覆盖功能生成、仿真反馈修复、综合感知重写、时序感知重写、RTL 优化模式、量化 GEMM 协同设计；按任务描述、当前时序/综合反馈、多样性计划三路检索，且注册表中有验证版本历史者检索得分更高。历史按行记录，批次结束后作为 session 导入，按引用技能聚合；证据门控为 n_pass ≥ 2 ∧ (n_promote ≥ 1 ∨ Δs̄ < 0)（高等价风险时强制要求 promotion），通过则 create_skill / improve_skill，否则 skip。发布分两种模式：immediate 直接写回并登记版本哈希；validated 进入验证队列（存最多 8 条回放用例，当前 worker 每次作业最多回放 3 例，用功能评估器判定），要求 N_results ≥ 2、N_approve ≥ 2、q̄_cand ≥ 0.75，且候选技能回放质量不得劣于基线才发布。

**6) 实验设置**：基座模型 BetterV-CodeQwen-7B（以聚焦算法贡献而非模型规模）；统一预算为 3 大轮 × 5 minor，策略池 direct,c_bridge,repair；对比 Direct LLM、C-Bridge、Repair-only、Verilog-Evolve w/o Skill Evolution、Full；GEMM 侧含 int4_int8_mac_pe、mixed_precision_dot4、requantize_int32_to_int8 三个内置任务。

Result: **表1（VerilogEval 功能与晋级稳定性）**：Final Success 逐步提升——Direct 76.8/58.9 → C-Bridge 79.4/61.8 → Repair-only 81.2/64.9 → w/o Skill 83.6/68.7 → Full 85.3/71.6（Machine/Human）；Best Func. Score 同步下降（70.4 → 72.8 对应值降至 0.41/0.23 量级）；Promotion Pass 由 58.9 升至 71.6，Compile Pass 由 84.2 升至 91.9，平均晋级大版本数 0.0 → 2.2，Full 的技能验证接受/拒绝为 18/6。表明版本化多工具选择与技能演化在不牺牲正确性的前提下稳定增益。

**表2（混合精度 GEMM 多目标）**：Correctness-only（仅 F）功能通过 91.7、留出 83.3，但 cell 182.4、mul 4.7、ABC delay 6.81、ADP 512.6、下游分 4.92；PPA-aware（F+Y）91.7/86.1，cell 降至 159.8、下游分 4.31；Timing-aware（F+Y+A）留出 86.1、delay 5.72、ADP 401.7；Downstream-aware（F+Y+A+D）取得最佳综合：功能 91.7、留出 88.9、cell 151.6、mul 2.4、delay 5.48、ADP 332.5、下游分 3.21。说明仅靠功能正确无法选出 GEMM 友好 RTL，开源工具代理足以替代商业 EDA 做下游引导。

**表3（技能模式消融）**：No skills 68.9/4.37/82.1；Static skills 70.4/3.98/85.0；Evolved-immediate 72.1/3.55/87.3（技能 24/0）；Evolved-validated 72.8/3.21/88.9（技能 18/6）。即静态技能本身有效，演化进一步增益，回放验证以"更少发布"换来"更高质量"。

Conclusion: Verilog-Evolve 证明：以可执行工具反馈为核心、以主/次版本化搜索为骨架、以验证门控的跨会话技能演化为记忆层，可以在不损失功能正确性的前提下系统性提升 RTL 的综合结构、时序代理与下游硬件质量；开源评估器栈（iverilog + Yosys + ABC + 任务特定下游评估器）足以逼近工业流程的下游引导能力，且回放式验证能有效过滤低质量技能更新（接受 18 / 拒绝 6）。作者指出局限与后续方向：扩展评估器栈以纳入更丰富的物理设计信号、集成工业 EDA 流程并引入形式等价性检查；同时 ABC 时序仅为代理指标、工业 PPA 结果依赖可选 DC/SEC 适配器（主实验未启用），技能演化阈值与验证队列参数均带有经验性默认值。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation from natural-language specifications, but most pipelines still treat generation as isolated sampling followed by functional checking. This is insufficient for practical RTL design, where useful Verilog must be correct, synthesizable, timing-conscious, and friendly to downstream hardware objectives. We present Verilog-Evolve, a feedback-driven framework for versioned Verilog refinement and cross-session skill evolution. For each task, Verilog-Evolve generates diverse minor candidates, evaluates them with executable feedback from functional simulation, Yosys synthesis, ABC timing proxy, and optional GEMM metrics, then promotes the best candidate into a major version under configurable scoring. To improve across tasks, the system maintains modular skill guidance, retrieves skills according to task and feedback context, and evolves candidate skills from logged histories through create/improve/skip decisions and verifier reports. Experiments on VerilogEval and mixed-precision GEMM tasks show that Verilog-Evolve improves final functional success and promotion stability while producing more downstream-friendly RTL under open-source synthesis, timing-proxy, and netlist-level GEMM objectives. Validation-gated skill evolution further improves GEMM downstream quality and achieves the best downstream score and GEMM held-out pass rate among the evaluated skill modes.

</details>


### [34] [Conceptual Steganography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26537)
*Zhejian Zhou,Jonathan May*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper introduces "conceptual steganography," a new technique for embedding hidden messages in Language Models' reasoning chains through patterns of high-level reasoning behavior rather than word choice. This method is more resistant to paraphrase-based defenses than traditional approaches, but can be partially mitigated by strategy-aware paraphrasing, raising new challenges for LLM safety.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Language Models can embed covert messages in their Chains-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning through steganography, potentially allowing misaligned models to communicate hidden information past human supervision—a risk that current defenses may not fully address.

Method: The researchers tested conceptual steganography across four model families and two reasoning domains, evaluating its robustness against a strong paraphrase defense compared to standard keyword-based approaches. They also proposed a strategy-aware paraphraser as a potential countermeasure.

Result: Conceptual steganography proved consistently more robust to paraphrase defenses than standard keyword approaches, while the encoded information did not compromise the CoTs' utility for reasoning. A strategy-aware paraphraser, however, was able to close much of this covert channel.

Conclusion: The study demonstrates that conceptual steganography poses a significant new threat to LLM safety, but a strategy-aware paraphraser can substantially mitigate this risk, highlighting the importance of developing more sophisticated defenses for ensuring faithful LLM reasoning.

Abstract: Language Models (LMs) emit Chains-of-Thought (CoTs) that drive much of their capability. However, the same sequence that carries useful reasoning can also covertly convey messages: a misaligned model may embed covert information in its CoT that slips through human supervision, a form of steganography known as encoded reasoning. Prior LM steganography schemes operate in the token or lexical space, and a content-preserving paraphraser is the canonical and effective defense in recent work. We introduce conceptual steganography, in which each step of a CoT carries information through patterns of high-level reasoning behavior, rather than through lexical choice. Across four model families and two reasoning domains, this backdoor communication channel is shown to be consistently more robust to a strong paraphrase defense than standard keyword approaches, and the encoding of information into CoTs does not affect their utility in the reasoning process. Having raised awareness of this new risk, we then demonstrate that a strategy-aware paraphraser can close much of the channel, highlighting new challenges and recommended defenses for ensuring faithful LLM reasoning in the wild.

</details>


### [35] [Reliable Extraction of Clinical Follow-Up Instructions: A Hybrid Neural-Symbolic Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26560)
*Michal Laufer,Yehudit Aperstein,Alexander Apartsin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究提出混合神经符号管道分离实体提取与确定性日期计算，相比GPT-4o-mini和LLaMA-3等生成模型，在门诊笔记的动作-时间配对提取任务上显著提升性能（Pair F1达0.986 vs 0.53），MAE为0且泛化至未见动作类型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 门诊笔记包含配对的动作和时间指令（如"MRI脑部检查两周后"），提取这些(action, date)配对可支持调度和审计任务。生成式模型在提取日期时表现不佳，因为日期链接和算术运算在解码过程中是隐式的。

Method: 提出混合神经符号管道：BioBERT作为编码器进行BIO标注和双仿射链接，定义TestSpecification和TimeSpecification实体及ScheduledFor关系，通过28类动作本体库进行实体规范化，时间归一化为天偏移量后进行确定性计算。与零样本GPT-4o-mini和LoRA微调LLaMA-3 8B进行对比。

Conclusion: 混合神经符号管道在成对(action, date)提取任务上显著优于生成模型，成对F1达0.986-0.997，MAE为0。分离式架构不仅性能更优，还能泛化到未见过的动作类型，并有效暴露失败模式。下一阶段将迁移至真实EHR数据进行验证。

Abstract: Objective. Outpatient notes carry follow-up instructions pairing actions with future times ("MRI brain in two weeks"). Extracting (action, date) pairs supports scheduling and audit, but generative extractors miss the date because linking and arithmetic are implicit in decoding. We test a hybrid neural-symbolic pipeline against direct generation. Methods. We define TestSpecification and TimeSpecification entities and a ScheduledFor relation. Results. On 259-note seen and OOV splits the hybrid pipeline achieves Test-Time Pair F1 of 0.997 and 0.986 with 0.00-day MAE. Baselines reach high action F1 (LLaMA-3 0.992; GPT-4o-mini 0.963 seen) but Pair F1 stays at 0.51-0.57 (LLaMA-3) and 0.53 (GPT-4o-mini), CIs non-overlapping with the hybrid. Conclusion. Separating learned entity extraction from deterministic date arithmetic outperforms generation on this benchmark, generalizes to held-out actions, and exposes failure modes. Transfer to real EHR notes is the next validation; a first-pass realism check is in Limitations.

</details>

*Adib Sakhawat,Fardeen Sadab,Atik Shahriar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了多语言嵌入模型跨语言检索非对称性的根本原因——hubness而非各向异性，并证明CSLS通过修正相似度度量而非消除特定hub向量即可有效解决该问题，建议将CSLS作为默认检索度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨语言检索假设对称性成立，但实际不然。多语言嵌入空间存在多种几何病理（hubness、各向异性、质心漂移、幅度差异），需确定哪个是检索非对称性的主要驱动因素。

Abstract: Multilingual embedding models are deployed under the assumption that cross-lingual retrieval is symmetric: if a query in language A retrieves its translation in language B, the reverse should also hold. In practice it does not. Across five pre-registered experiments with falsification conditions specified in advance, hub mass dominates a joint regression on reciprocity (49.5% dominance share, 1.68x the next predictor; partial R^2 = 0.302 versus 0.003 for anisotropy), while a hub-aware score correction (CSLS) closes 63.5% of the worst-to-best reciprocity gap and yields a mean within-model effect size 130x larger than surgical hub-vector ablation. </details>

*Jinze Li,Xiaoyan Yang,Shuo Yang,Jinfeng Xu,Yue Shen,Jian Wang,Jinjie Gu,Edith Cheuk-Han Ngai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LATTE通过同侪锚定机制将用户偏好表示为相对差异状态，利用轻量序列预测器预测用户偏好的时序演变，并通过单软令牌注入冻结LLM，在Amazon Reviews 2023和MemoryCD数据集上显著优于多种基线方法，验证了轨迹预测而非静态档案或软提示接口才是性能提升的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有个性化方法将用户过去行为视为聚合档案，将稳定身份、最近漂移和项目内容混在同一表示中，无法有效区分这些不同维度的信息。此外，检索或摘要方法虽然高效，但缺乏对用户偏好动态演变过程的显式建模。

Method: LATTE提出了一种将个性化建模为同侪锚定相对偏好状态预测的框架。具体包括：(1) 对于每个历史会话，从响应相同项目的可比用户中提取时间掩码基线并相减，得到衡量目标用户与同侪差异的状态；(2) 使用轻量级序列预测器预测轨迹中的下一状态；(3) 通过状态到令牌桥接器，将预测状态注入冻结的指令调优LLM中，使用单个锚定软令牌实现。

Result: 在Amazon Reviews 2023和MemoryCD数据集上，LATTE一致性地优于检索、摘要记忆、静态潜在档案、差异感知潜在档案和软提示压缩等基线方法。在Amazon Reviews 2023上，ROUGE-L从静态潜在档案的0.219和最强潜在压缩基线的0.245提升至0.259。诊断分析表明，性能提升主要归因于预测用户特定轨迹信息，而非简单添加软提示接口。

Conclusion: LATTE通过预测用户特定轨迹信息而非仅添加软提示接口来实现性能提升。在Amazon Reviews 2023和MemoryCD数据集上的一致性提升验证了该方法的有效性。LATTE通过将个性化建模为同侪锚定的相对偏好状态预测，实现了更精确的用户建模。

Abstract: Personalized generation with frozen large language models requires a conditioning signal that is both compact and current. Existing personalization methods typically retrieve or summarize user histories in text, or compress them into static latent profiles and soft prompts. These approaches are efficient, but they treat a user's past behavior as an aggregate profile and therefore mix stable identity, recent drift, and item content in the same representation. We propose LAtent Trajectory Tracking and Extrapolation (LATTE), a framework that represents personalization as forecasting a peer anchored relative preference state. For each historical session, LATTE subtracts a time masked baseline formed from comparable users who responded to the same item, producing a state that measures how the target user differs from peers under a shared item context. A lightweight sequence predictor then forecasts the next state in this trajectory, and a State to Token Bridge injects the forecast into a frozen instruction tuned LLM through a single anchored soft token. We provide a latent factor analysis showing when peer anchoring cancels shared item variation and why temporal forecasting trades off stale averages against noisy recent states. Experiments on Amazon Reviews 2023 and MemoryCD show that LATTE consistently outperforms retrieval, summary memory, static latent profiles, difference aware latent profiles, and soft prompt compression baselines. On Amazon Reviews 2023, LATTE improves average ROUGE-L from 0.219 for a static latent profile and 0.245 for the strongest added latent compression baseline to 0.259. Additional pairwise comparisons and diagnostic analyses suggest that the improvement is mainly due to forecasting user-specific trajectory information, rather than merely adding a soft prompt interface.

</details>


### [38] [Granuscore: A Reference-Free Measure of Granularity for Text Analysis and Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26620)
*Lukas Ellinger,Alexander Fichtl,Miriam Anschütz,Georg Groh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Granuscore，一种利用层次嵌入空间结构特性的无参考粒度度量方法，能够恢复层次排序、捕捉跨语境粒度差异、解释句子特异性变化，并揭示QA模型行为的粒度特征差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言在不同的粒度层级上传递信息，从细粒度指称到宽泛描述。虽然粒度是人类交流的基础，但现有度量方法大多只捕捉表面细节或句子特异性。

Method: 利用层次嵌入空间的结构特性，引入了一种无参考的粒度度量方法Granuscore。

Conclusion: Granuscore被定位为一种可扩展且广泛适用的工具，用于分析文本中的粒度。它能够恢复层次排序，捕捉不同语篇情境下的粒度差异，并解释句子特异性中的非线性变化。在QA基准测试中的应用揭示了模型行为的差异，并为QA数据集的难度特征提供了原则性视角。

Abstract: Natural language conveys information at varying levels of granularity, from fine-grained references to broad descriptions. While granularity is fundamental to human communication, existing measures mostly capture surface detail or sentence specificity. We introduce Granuscore, a reference-free measure of granularity that leverages structural properties of a hierarchical embedding space. Granuscore reliably recovers hierarchical orderings on the Granola-EQ dataset and captures expected differences in granularity across discourse contexts. Across domains, we further show that Granuscore explains non-linear variation in sentence specificity beyond sentence length. Finally, we apply Granuscore to four question-answering benchmarks and analyze how granularity differs for questions, gold answers, and model outputs across response outcomes. The analysis reveals consistent differences in model behavior and provides a principled lens for characterizing the difficulty of QA datasets. Together, the results position Granuscore as a scalable, broadly applicable tool for analyzing granularity in text.

</details>


### [39] [Bounded Path Context: A Controlled Study of Visible Path History in LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26645)
*Xihang Shan,Ye Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Bounded Path Context (BPC) proposes that LLM-based KGQA systems should only include the last K hops in relation-selection prompts rather than the complete path history, achieving equal or better performance with fewer tokens.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Current LLM-based KGQA systems serialize complete partial paths into every routing prompt by default, despite the controller already maintaining exact symbolic state. This creates redundant token overhead without clear justification.

Method: Bounded Path Context (BPC) decouples two roles of path context: controller retains full paths symbolically for answer extraction/audit, while relation-selection prompt exposes only question, current entity, outgoing relation candidates, and at most last K hops. Controlled experiments sweep K while fixing graph neighborhoods, beam budget, depth, decoding, and answer-extraction format.

Result: BPC matches or exceeds full-history prompting with fewer tokens. Key findings: (1) K=1 optimal for 9B model on WebQSP (0.487 F1) and 4B model on both benchmarks; (2) K=0 best for 9B on CWQ (0.287 F1); (3) Significant token reduction (9.7-12.1%); (4) 71-84% examples unaffected by history length; (5) Affected cases show prior hops can both disambiguate and distract.

Conclusion: BPC outperforms full-history prompting while using fewer tokens. Qwen3.5-9B-AWQ: K=1 achieves 0.487 F1 on WebQSP (+0.015 vs full history), K=0 reaches 0.287 on CWQ (+0.013 vs full history). Reduces input tokens by 9.7-12.1%. At 4B scale, K=1 remains optimal. 71-84% examples unaffected; remaining cases reveal when prior hops disambiguate vs distract.

Abstract: LLM-based knowledge-graph question answering (KGQA) delegates graph traversal to language models, turning each question into a sequence of local relation-selection decisions repeated across beams and hops. A common but untested default is to serialize the complete partial path into every routing prompt, even though the controller already maintains this path as exact symbolic state. Bounded Path Context (BPC) decouples these two roles: the controller retains full paths in symbolic memory for answer extraction and audit, while the relation-selection prompt exposes only the question, the current entity, outgoing relation candidates, and at most the last K hops. A controlled sweep over K -- fixing graph neighborhoods, beam budget, depth, decoding, and answer-extraction format -- shows that bounded histories match or exceed full-history prompting on complete WebQSP and CWQ test sets with Qwen3.5-9B-AWQ: K=1 achieves 0.487 answer-set F1 on WebQSP versus 0.472 for full history, and K=0 reaches 0.287 on CWQ versus 0.274, with 9.7% and 12.1% fewer input tokens respectively. At the 4B scale, K=1 remains the strongest setting on both benchmarks. Per-example analysis reveals that 71-84% of examples are unaffected by history length, while the affected cases expose when prior hops disambiguate versus distract. These results suggest that path serialization length is better treated as a tunable interface variable than as a default assumption in LLM-based graph controllers.

</details>


### [40] [Why Prompt Optimization Works, and Why It Sometimes Doesn't: A Causal-Inspired Edit-Level Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26655)
*Shuzhi Gong,Hechuan Wen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对提示优化器（DSPy/MiPROv2、TextGrad、GEPA）诱导的提示词编辑做"编辑级、因果启发"的观察性分析，回答"优化器到底学到了什么编辑、为何某些编辑在某些任务上有效而在另一些任务上损害性能"。作者在3个优化框架、5个LLM骨干、11个基准（5类推理任务）上采集约2万条(prompt, question, correctness)轨迹数据，用三种互补表征（GPT-4o认知负荷标注特征、确定性表层文本统计、文本diff编辑motif）刻画编辑，并采用倾向得分调整的IPTW加权条件平均增益差（ACMGD）估计"某类编辑↑"与下游性能增益的关联，配合分块bootstrap与BH-FDR控制及两级证据体系（Tier 1确认/Tier 2探索）。核心发现：复杂度增加类与元指令类编辑与数学、多跳推理性能负相关，而分步类/元认知类编辑提升逻辑与序列推理任务；4项关联通过BH-FDR校正。作者据此指出提示优化失败源于"编辑族×任务特性"的系统性交互，而非随机优化噪声，并提出任务条件化的优化器设计方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动提示优化（DSPy、TextGrad、GEPA等）虽能在单一基准上显著提升性能，但优化出的提示在跨任务、跨骨干时迁移失败：在逻辑/序列推理上表现好的优化器，往往在数学与多跳推理基准上大幅退化。作者指出既有工作多停留在聚合基准层面的成功率、优化动态或嵌入方向分析，无法回答"优化器究竟学会了施加什么样的提示修改、为什么同一类修改在不同推理任务上效果相反"这一关键问题。这一异质性的来源（未被充分探索）正是本文动机；同时，对编辑级行为的刻画对诊断与优化器设计（避免"平均增益相同但编辑策略迥异"）具有直接价值。

Method: 观察性、多视图（multi-view）+ 因果启发的关联分析框架。数据：3个框架（DSPy/MiPROv2、TextGrad、GEPA）×5个骨干（GPT-5.2、GPT-4o、Qwen3-32B、DeepSeek-v3/R1）×11个基准、5类推理任务（常识/数学/逻辑/序列/多跳），主分析用DSPy的2,095对相邻提示修订（p1→p2，Δacc=acc(p2)−acc(p1)），另用TextGrad+GEPA的17,708对做跨框架方向性复核。三种互补编辑表征：(1) GPT-4o按认知负载理论/教学设计标注的12个提示特征（清晰度、参与度、礼貌、内在/外在/增益负载、目标、元认知、示例、结构/上下文逻辑、幻觉意识，1–10分）；(2) 13–14个确定性表层文本特征（词数、示例数、步骤词密度、type-token比、压缩比、句数等）；(3) 从连续修订文本diff中抽取≥4 token插入片段并按预注册正则归入4类motif（chain_of_thought、meta_instruction、step_by_step、clarity_constraint）。估计：对每个特征f与任务组τ，以T=1[特征变化>0]为处理，用仅含编辑前协变量（提示长度、示例数、headroom、框架、骨干、数据集、优化步数）的逻辑回归估计倾向得分，计算稳定化IPTW权重（截断于10），估计加权ACMGD；标准误用按dataset×backbone分块的500次block bootstrap；BH-FDR分别跨60个特征×组与15个motif×组检验校正，并划分Tier 1（q<0.05）与Tier 2（仅p<0.05方向一致）。辅助分析：Spearman构念效度校验（19个预期相关中7个成立）、天花板效应检验（headroom与Δacc、偏R²）、LOO留一数据集稳定性（18折）、PC算法+DirectLiNGAM条件独立结构、SBERT+PCA编辑方向敏感性、"因果接受度得分"与LOO-CV分类器、motif人工精度审计（每类50条）、以及Qwen2-VL-7B上的结构化CoT干预sanity check。全文明示不做强因果断言，仅报告"调整后关联对比"。

Result: 主分析60次检验中11次未校正显著，2项通过BH-FDR（Tier 1）：Extraneous_load⊗序列推理 −0.060（5/5 LOO稳定）、Metacognition⊗序列推理 +0.062（2/3稳定，disambiguation_qa翻转）。motif分析15次检验中2项通过BH-FDR：meta_instruction⊗数学 −0.103（部分集中于MultiArith：naive CATE −0.277 vs GSM8K −0.019；多跳方向性 −0.044）、clarity_constraint⊗逻辑 −0.083（布尔/掷币两数据集均为负）。探索性（Tier 2）方向模式：数学组在12个特征中9个点估计为负；chain_of_thought在数学为负（motif −0.048；表层step_words −0.044）而在序列/last_letters为正（motif +0.045；step_words +0.075）；表层特征（n_demos、type_token_ratio、word_count、step_words、reasoning_words）复现了全部四个LLM标注方向模式；TextGrad/GEPA上word_count、sentence_count、reasoning_words方向一致（commonsense正/序列与多跳负）。混杂校正在总体上使估计偏移0.018，说明朴素估计确有选择性偏差；天花板效应为次要因素（ρ(headroom, Δacc)=0.047, p=0.053；R²(任务组|headroom)=0.003）。LOO稳定性15/18（83%），meta_instruction正则精确率≥90%，chain_of_thought因JSON "reasoning"键误匹配而噪声较大。结构化CoT sanity check显示GSM8K 28%→60%（McNemar p=0.027）、last_letters 0%→4%（不显著），说明motif估计并非"CoT普遍有害"或标签纯度问题所致；但"接受度得分"对未见任务类型不可泛化（LOO-CV AUC=0.260，低于随机），条件独立结构跨任务边Jaccard仅0.249，数学结构最独特。

Conclusion: 提示优化的失败并非随机优化噪声，而是"编辑族×任务特性"之间的系统性交互：优化器倾向插入的复杂度增加型与元指令型编辑在数学与多跳推理上负向关联，而分步结构化与元认知型编辑在逻辑/序列推理上有益。据此可在运行昂贵优化前做事前诊断（目标基准是否类似math-like/multihop-like），并推动三类优化器设计假设：任务条件化的编辑先验（对算术/多步任务抑制元指令插入，可实现为正则过滤器或编辑分类器）、复杂度惩罚的搜索目标、以及按任务组划分的held-out验证门控。方法论上，作者主张以"多视图+IPTW调整关联+FDR校正的两级证据体系"来刻画优化器行为，但明确声明结果为观察性关联而非因果效应：条件可交换性难以完全成立（搜索轨迹历史、选择压力、骨干指令遵循差异等未测混杂），且优化器常同时修改多个特征（处理被打包）；部分发现对具体数据集敏感（MultiArith、date_understanding、disambiguation_qa），motif正则抽取存在不可避免的标注噪声，审计为单人标注，最终仍需受控干预验证。

Abstract: Automated prompt optimization methods (e.g., DSpy, TextGrad) can substantially improve the performance of large language model (LLM), however, their generalization ability across different tasks remains underperformed. In practice, the superiority of the optimized prompt on one benchmark often fails to transfer to another, and this limitation persists even when switching across different LLM backbones. To investigate the underexplored sources of heterogeneity in prompt performance, we conduct a causal inference-inspired observational analysis of optimized prompts across a diverse set of optimization frameworks, LLM backbones, and NLP benchmarks. To achieve the goal, we build upon the propensity-adjusted associational analysis together with multiple complementary representations of prompt edits, where the consistent task-conditioned edits patterns are identified. We find that complexity-increasing and meta-instructional edits are negatively associated with mathematical and multi-hop reasoning performance, whereas step-by-step and meta-cognitive edits improve logical and sequential reasoning tasks. Abstract: Sequential editing of structured knowledge in large language models allows targeted factual updates without retraining, yet existing methods often rely on complex regularization or constraint mechanisms whose necessity remains unclear. Building on this insight, we generalize the equivalence to a broader class of editing objectives, demonstrating that stability emerges naturally from properly accounting for accumulated editing constraints, rather than from specialized regularization or null-space operations. Abstract: Long-context language models are limited by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache. On Qwen3-4B, it improves over KeyDiff by up to 19.10 points on RULER and 19.29 on LongBench at $r=0.75$; at $r=0.95$, it retains 37.32 on LongBench versus 17.55 for KeyDiff.

### [44] [An In-Vitro Study on Cross-Lingual Generalization in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26683)
*Adrian Cosma*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper introduces a controlled in-vitro framework to study cross-lingual transfer by creating procedurally generated languages. Through 700 experiments, they demonstrate that tokenization preserving cross-lingual substructure is more critical than lexical similarity or tokenizer balance. Smaller vocabularies facilitate transfer by maintaining decomposable shared fragments, and the transfer process occurs in stages from grammar/type competence to lexical generalization.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Cross-lingual transfer in language models is difficult to study in natural corpora due to entanglement of multiple confounding factors: lexical overlap, morphology, data imbalance, and tokenization cannot be independently varied.

Result: Key findings: (1) Transfer is governed more by whether tokenization preserves reusable cross-lingual substructure than by tokenizer balance or raw lexical similarity; (2) Smaller vocabularies often improve masked transfer by keeping words decomposable into shared fragments, while larger vocabularies can turn forms into language-specific atoms; (3) Transfer emerges as a staged process where grammatical and type-level competence precede masked lexical generalization.

Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer in language models is difficult to study in natural corpora because lexical overlap, morphology, data imbalance, and tokenization are entangled. We introduce an in-vitro framework with two procedurally generated languages that share the same ontology, typed grammar, and compositional structure, but differ in surface realization. This lets us independently vary lexical distance, minority-language proportion, tokenizer training regime, and vocabulary size, while evaluating transfer on a masked minority-language condition whose lexical forms are never observed during training. Across 700 controlled runs, we find that transfer is governed less by tokenizer balance or raw lexical similarity than by whether tokenization preserves reusable cross-lingual substructure. Smaller vocabularies often improve masked transfer by keeping words decomposable into shared fragments, whereas larger vocabularies can turn forms into language-specific atoms. We further show that transfer emerges as a staged process: grammatical and type-level competence precede masked lexical generalization. Finally, we attempt to explain this mechanism through tokenizer bridges and show that bridge strength correlates strongly with masked reachability.

</details>

*Francesco Corielli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文研究了在隐状态未观测情况下序列预测器的置信度问题，揭示了充足性缺口源于边缘化而非优化误差，并通过贝叶斯分析证明外部信号的纠正效果受限于文本后验权重分配的阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 问题背景：即使理想的无穷容量序列预测器能精确恢复仅文本边缘律，当观测前缀与错误隐机制兼容时，仍会产生过度自信问题。这引发了对"充足性缺口"本质的追问。

Method: 构建一个二元混合机制过程：一个确定性文本机制和一个由未观测隐状态驱动的随机机制。形式化检索、工具使用和外部接地，通过保真度 γ∈[1/2,1] 的辅助二元信号进行贝叶斯更新。

Result: 引入辅助信号后推导出情境主导阈值：纠正信号在保真度超过文本后验权重时恰好逆转由误导性机制引起的赔率。但该阈值只能减少，不能完全消除充足性缺口；完全闭合需要完美揭示相关隐状态或等效验证机制。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了充足性缺口的本质——源于对未观测隐状态的边缘化，而非优化误差。温度 scaling 无法弥补缺失的上下文；接地机制必须既具有信息性又可被模型学习使用；在高风险领域，自主序列模型需要结构上解耦的观察者或验证器。

Abstract: We construct a binary mixed-regime process with one deterministic textual regime and one random regime governed by an unobserved latent state. Even an ideal infinite-capacity sequence predictor that exactly recovers the text-only marginal law can become overconfident when the observed prefix is compatible with the wrong latent regime. The resulting entropy difference is not an ordinary optimization error; it is a sufficiency gap caused by marginalization over an unobserved state. We then formalize retrieval, tool use, and external grounding through an auxiliary binary signal with fidelity $γ\in [1/2,1]$. The resulting Bayesian update yields a contextual dominance threshold: a corrective signal reverses the posterior odds induced by the textual history exactly when its fidelity exceeds the text-only posterior weight assigned to the misleading regime. This threshold reduces, but does not generally eliminate, the sufficiency gap; complete closure requires perfect revelation of the relevant latent state or an equivalent verification mechanism. The analysis clarifies why temperature scaling cannot restore missing context, why grounding mechanisms must be both informative and learnably usable by the model, and why autonomous sequence models require structurally decoupled observers or verifiers in high-stakes domains.

</details>


### [46] [PRISM: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Peer Reviewers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26730)
*Ngoc Phan Phuoc Loc,Toan Huynh La Viet,Thanh Tran Khanh,Duy A Nguyen,Tuan Anh Nguyen Pham,Thanh Nguyen,Nitesh V. Chawla,Wray Buntine,Kok-Seng Wong,Khoa D. Doan,Binh T. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PRISM 是一个面向"LLM 自动审稿人"的多维度评测基准，将同行评审质量拆为四个维度（分析深度、新颖性评估、缺陷识别与主次排序、多维建设性），每维用可验证的专用流水线打分（论证挖掘、检索增强核验、共识加权评分、语义规则匹配），在 ICLR 2026/ICML 2025/NeurIPS 2025 的 600 篇论文上对比 5 个自动化审稿系统与人类评审。核心结论：LLM 在单一维度上可匹敌甚至超越人类（深度相当、SEA 新颖性核验更强、Reviewer2 缺陷召回最高、DeepReview 建设性最佳），但无一系统能全维度均衡；更致命的是 LLM 评审对"录用/拒稿"缺乏区分度（评估不变性），故只适合作为人机协同中的定向补充，而非自主替代者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习顶会投稿量激增（NeurIPS 从 2024 年 15,671 篇增至 2025 年 21,575 篇，ICML 同比 +44.9% 与 +25.4%），审稿系统严重超载，已有 17–21% 的评审涉及 LLM 辅助（部分会议全面禁止、有的要求强制披露），而人类评审质量也在恶化（NeurIPS 一致性实验显示约 23% 的录用决定仅因审稿人分配而改变）。核心问题是：LLM 审稿人究竟能否像人类一样发现论文的科学缺口？现有评测方法存在明显缺陷：ROUGE/BLEU 只看表层词面重叠，LLM-as-a-judge 的整体打分把"语言流畅度"与"科学严谨性"混为一谈；ReviewEval 虽定义 6 个维度但依赖端到端 rubric 打分且仅覆盖 16 篇论文、3 个系统；DeepReview-Bench 规模虽大但局限于 ICLR 单一场次；均无法验证"单条论断是否有据可依"、"新颖性断言能否被检索到的先前工作证实"。因此需要一个可追溯、可核验、跨维度的评测框架来刻画 LLM 审稿人的能力画像与失效模式。

Method: 框架设计：形式化 E(R_LLM, R_human, P) → 多维分数集合 S，每个维度用独立的"证据抽取 + 解析式计分"流水线（LLM 只做受限的证据标注，最终分数由公式解析计算），配合 Data Segmentation 单元解析论文与评审结构。(1) 深度分析 DoA：将 Summary/Strengths/Weaknesses 切成论证话语单元 ADU，标注 Claim/Premise 角色与四类主题（新颖性、方法、实验、清晰度），对 Premise 评 grounding 0/1/2（泛化/内部引用/外部文献），以 Premise Ratio 与归一化 Grounding 的调和平均计分（|P|=0 则为 0）。(2) 新颖性评估：三阶段——受限 LLM 抽取论文核心任务/贡献锚点/关键术语与评审中的逐字新颖性断言（含 stance、置信度、引用正则回退）→ 用 Semantic Scholar 确定性构造查询、去重（标题摘要相似度 ≥0.96）、按投稿年份时间过滤、MMR 选 K=30 候选池 → LLM 裁判对每个（断言, 候选）对照论文摘要+引言与候选标题+摘要给出 [−2,+2] 五级证据支持度；采用相关性加权 top-3 聚合（而非 max 池化）得到 NS/SR/SSR。(3) 缺陷识别与主次排序：先原子化并归并多评审（含人类与 LLM）的 Micro-flaw 至七类宏主题，再由独立"元审稿人"对论文核验有效性并按本体标注 Critical/Minor（是否需要新实验/证明修订 vs 纯文字修订），合并为共识真值集；按严重度分层召回 + 受 NDCG 启发的 nCPS（严重度权重 2/1，按出现位置 log2 折损，除以理想分 iCPS）。(4) 多维建设性：把评审拆成原子评论 ARC（含 5–25 词锚定引文与类型），在 D1 可执行性、D2 具体性、D3 论证性、D4 解决方案、D5 语气五个 0/1/2 维度打分，取评论级均值 CLC 与评审级 MCS，另派生 Actionability Ratio、Solution Density、Constructiveness Density。实验设置：每会场年 200 篇、按决定类别（Oral/Spotlight/Poster/Reject）与主题分层并保持原始分数分布，共 600 篇、生成 3,000 条 LLM 评审；对比 5 个系统（SEA-E、CycleReviewer、DeepReview 为微调范式，Reviewer2、TreeReview 为提示范式，后者统一骨干以隔离框架效应）；裁判引擎 Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite（temperature 0）；统计用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 + Holm-Bonferroni 校正（按模型-维度族），接受/拒稿对比用 Mann-Whitney U 检验，维度独立性用 Pearson 相关；并邀请 15 位资深研究者对 25 篇论文的预抽取片段重标，计算 Cohen's κ/κw 与 ±1 一致率做人类验证。

Result: 1) 深度分析：人类 0.493 为最高，CycleReviewer 0.483、DeepReview 0.481 统计上与之无差异（ns），Reviewer2/SEA/TreeReview 显著更低；差异主要来自 Premise Ratio（人类 0.557、CycleReviewer 0.614、DeepReview 0.588）而非 Grounding（0.432–0.481 相当）。TreeReview 把 26.3% 前提预算投向 Clarity（人类 9.5%），JSD 最高 0.205；Reviewer2 聚焦最贴近人类（JSD 0.055）但前提比仅 0.376，暴露"冗长无据"幻觉。2) 新颖性：SEA 最高 0.854（显著超越人类 0.802），但其 83% 断言判为"novel"，人类为 62%，反映趋同作者；DeepReview 最怀疑（41% novel/21% not novel/35% unclear）。跨评审一致规律是"novel"断言证据支撑远强于"not novel/unclear"（否定新颖性需定位到具体先验工作，门槛更高），说明这是检索核验任务本身的属性。3) 缺陷识别：Reviewer2 召回最高（Critical 0.644、Minor 0.470，远超人类 0.311/0.253）且幻觉率仅约 3.6%，CycleReviewer 幻觉率约 16.2%；所有系统的幻觉严格限于 Minor，Critical 缺陷零幻觉。nCPS 所有系统与人类均约 0.97，说明"先主后次"已是普遍基线行为而非区分性能力。4) 建设性：DeepReview 最高 0.636（三会场均显著优于人类 0.556），D1=1.422、D4=0.781、语气最佳 D5=1.730；人类 Specificity 高（1.732）但 Solution 极低（D4=0.427、Solution Density≈0.102），呈"诊断者"而非"指导者"特征；Reviewer2 高分由 D3=0.969 的冗长辩护造成而 D4 仅 0.249（"解释为何错却不给修法"）；CycleReviewer Specificity/AR 高但 D3≈0.326、SD≈0.05（清单式浅层评审）。5) 接受/拒稿敏感性（最关键）：人类评审与决定显著相关（Novelty Δ=+0.051*、Prioritization Δ=+0.006***、Critical Δ=−0.049***、Minor Δ=−0.018**，Critical 差距约为 Minor 的 2.7–3 倍），而 5 个 LLM 系统几乎全部 ns，仅 DeepReview 的 Prioritization 显著（Δ=+0.011***），呈"评估不变性"。6) 维度独立性：6 指标两两 Pearson |r|max=0.193，15 对中 7 对不显著，共享方差 <4%，近正交。7) 人类验证：与 Gemini 的一致性在客观任务较好（Aspect Identification κ=0.688、Flaw Validity F1=0.880），主观任务一般（Novelty κ=0.332、D5 κ=0.122），但序数任务 ±1 一致率 75.7%–100%。8) 裁判鲁棒性：换用 Mimo v2.5 Pro 后各指标绝对值有偏移但相对排序与全部定性结论不变。9) 案例：TreeReview 陷入"表层陷阱"源于其启发式（无论论文是否需要都产出泛化可复现性套话）；Reviewer2 与人类缺陷集合近零重叠（9+9+2），LLM 强在逐公式级核查、人类强在论断—证据校准与领域规范感知；Reviewer2 会捏造"论文未报告计算开销"而论文实际有报告，属孤立评估未交叉核验所致。

Conclusion: LLM 审稿人是"专精型工具"而非通用替代品：每个系统在某一维度上突出、在他处存在结构化盲区，聚合指标完全掩盖这些失效模式。作者给出部署建议——采用定向集成：Reviewer2 负责缺陷穷举扫描（最高诊断召回）、DeepReview 负责建设性反馈起草（最高可执行性与方案密度）、SEA 负责新颖性文献核验（最高证据支撑率），作为人机协同流水线中的"专科副驾驶"而非自主审稿人。最强论据不是任何单项分数，而是 LLM 评审对论文真实科学质量的"评估不变性"——它无法区分将被录用与将被拒稿的论文，因此单项维度的高分不等于专家级判断力，须对此结论保持必要的保守解释。局限与未来工作：主裁判依赖单一模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite，仅做 Mimo 子集初步验证），需跨模型家族的多裁判研究与不确定度量化；语料仅限 ML/AI 三个会场年（600 篇），跨领域（临床医学、社科、纯数学）需重新校准；原子化切分可能丢失上下文，事实核查受检索 API 覆盖度限制；未来应扩展到作者满意度与跨年度纵向追踪，以验证 PRISM 指标捕捉的是真实评审质量而非表层流畅度。

Abstract: The rapid growth in submissions to machine learning venues has strained the scientific peer-review system and intensified interest in LLM-based automated peer reviewers. However, how good these systems are actually, especially compared to human reviewers at catching scientific gaps, remains poorly understood. In this work, we introduce PRISM (Peer Review Intelligence via Structured Multi-dimensional assessment), a benchmarking framework that evaluates review quality across four dimensions: Depth of Analysis, Novelty Assessment,Flaw Identification & Major Issues Prioritization, and Multi-dimensional Constructiveness. Unlike most existing evaluations based on surface-level metrics like ROUGE and BLEU, or unconstrained LLM-as-a-judge prompting that conflates fluency with rigor, PRISM grounds each dimension in argument mining, retrieval-augmented verification, and consensus-based scoring. We apply PRISM to benchmark five leading automated reviewer systems and human reviewers on a stratified corpus of reviews from ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS. The results reveal that LLMs can match or beat human reviewers on individual dimensions: comparable depth of analysis, stronger novelty verification, and highly accurate critique prioritization. However, no single system consistently matches the balanced performance of the human baseline across all dimensions at once. Each exhibits a distinct specialization profile with characteristic blind spots -- failure modes that aggregate metrics miss entirely. The implication is that LLM reviewers are best understood as targeted supplements to human review, effective within specific dimensions, but unreliable as standalone replacements. Our demo and key results can be found at https://khanhthanhdev.github.io/prism-page/.

</details>


### [47] [Rethinking the Multilingual Reasoning Gap with Layer Swap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26735)
*Maxence Lasbordes,Amélie Chatelain,Djamé Seddah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本研究在更大规模和可比监督条件下重新评估了多语言大模型的本地推理差距，发现该差距（1.9-3.5%）比先前报告小得多。通过权重分析发现推理核心是语言无关的（位于中间层），而外层是语言特定的。基于此发现，提出Layer Swap技术，通过迁移英语专家的强推理中间层到本地专家，有效缩小了本地推理差距，同时保留了目标语言输出的能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究认为强迫CoT保持在输入语言（本地推理）相比允许先用英语推理再翻译回输入语言（英语转向推理）会显著降低性能，但这些研究多依赖推理时干预或有限的本地语言训练数据，需要在更大规模和可比监督条件下重新审视这一差距。

Method: 构建跨6种语言的长推理数据集；在Qwen3-8B-Base基础上分别进行本地推理和英语转向推理模式的微调；在数学、科学、常识和代码领域进行评估；对本地专家模型进行权重空间分析；提出Layer Swap方法——将英语专家较强的中间层迁移到各本地专家模型中。

Result: 在可比监督设置下，本地推理差距缩小至1.9-3.5%，远低于先前研究；权重空间分析发现本地专家模型在中间层有对齐的微调更新，在外层存在分歧，显示出语言无关的推理核心被语言特定层包围的结构；Layer Swap可关闭大部分本地推理差距。

Conclusion: Layer Swap技术通过迁移英语专家模型的中间层到本地语言专家模型，成功缩小了大部分本地推理差距，同时保持了目标语言的CoT输出。研究发布了所有模型和数据集。

Abstract: Recent reasoning Large Language Models produce a chain-of-thought (CoT) predominantly in English, even when prompted in non-English languages. Prior work suggests that forcing the CoT to remain in the input language (\emph{native reasoning}) substantially degrades performance relative to allowing the model to reason in English before answering in the input language (\emph{English-pivoted reasoning}). However, most studies of this native reasoning gap rely on inference-time interventions or limited native-language training data. We revisit this comparison at a larger scale and under comparable supervision. We construct long multilingual reasoning datasets across six languages (English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese and Swahili); fine-tune specialists in both native and English-pivoted regimes on top of \texttt{Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base}, and evaluate across mathematics, science, general knowledge, and code. In this setting, the average native reasoning gap shrinks to 1.9--3.5\% across the five non-English languages, considerably smaller than previously reported. Weight-space analysis of the native specialists reveals aligned fine-tuning updates in the middle layers and divergence in the outer layers. This points to a largely language-agnostic reasoning core surrounded by language-specific layers. Exploiting this structure, we introduce a Layer Swap: transferring the English specialist's stronger reasoning mid-layers into each native specialist, closing most of the native reasoning gap across the five non-English languages while preserving CoT in the target language. We release all models and datasets.

</details>


### [48] [KARMA: Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26738)
*Jared Scott,Jesse Roberts*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: KARMA框架通过Reddit社交数据训练奖励模型，用强化学习微调LLM以提升语用能力。关键发现：预测karma更好的奖励模型反而导致更差的下游表现；仅使用对话上下文的奖励模型效果更优。所有条件下KARMA都会降低事实性，且这一权衡似乎根植于奖励信号本身而非训练数据噪声。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Human communication relies heavily on implicit social signals (tone, context, conversational norms) rather than semantic content alone. Training LLMs to handle context-sensitive conversational behavior requires learning from large-scale social interaction data, which presents challenges in capturing pragmatics while maintaining other desirable properties.

Method: KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on conversational context, then fine-tunes LLMs via reinforcement learning. The framework was evaluated with and without direct exposure to social media data to isolate the effects of the reward signal itself.

Result: A context-only reward model (worse at predicting Reddit karma) actually yielded substantially better downstream performance than a karma-predictive model. KARMA improves pragmatics-mediated behaviors with mitigated side effects, but factuality consistently diminishes across all conditions—including when the downstream model has no direct Reddit data exposure.

Conclusion: KARMA improves pragmatics-mediated conversational behaviors while largely mitigating side effects; however, the factuality-pragmatics trade-off appears inherent to the reward signal itself, as factuality diminishes even without direct Reddit exposure. The counterintuitive finding that better karma prediction leads to worse downstream performance suggests that context-only reward models may be more suitable for practical deployment.

Abstract: Human communication depends on implicit social signals where effectiveness is shaped by tone, context, and conversational norms rather than semantic content alone. We introduce KARMA (Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation), a framework for LLM learning of context-sensitive conversational behavior from large-scale social interaction data. KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to predict response valuation conditioned on context, and uses this signal to fine-tune language models via reinforcement learning to improve performance on pragmatics-mediated tasks. Critically, we find that the highest performing reward model does not lead to better downstream model alignment: a reward model relying exclusively on conversational context was a worse predictor of Reddit karma but yielded substantially better downstream performance. We evaluate the effects of KARMA applied to a downstream model with and without direct exposure to the social media data. The resulting models show improved pragmatics-mediated behaviors with largely mitigated undesirable side effects. Factuality is consistently diminished by KARMA across all conditions, including when the downstream model has no direct exposure to Reddit data, suggesting that this tension is embedded in the reward signal itself rather than introduced by noisy training data.

</details>

Conclusion: SEEK框架通过语义分块策略显著提升了多语言事实核查的性能，在X-FACT和RU22Fact数据集上均展现出优于基线方法的表现，证明了构建连贯证据块对提升事实核查可靠性的有效性。

Abstract: Multilingual fact verification requires evidence that is both relevant and sufficiently complete for reliable factuality prediction. However, existing systems often rely on search snippets, sentence-level evidence, or locally segmented passages, which can miss decisive context and produce fragmented evidence. To overcome these limitations, we propose SEEK, a Semantic Evidence Extraction with an adaptive chunKing framework that constructs coherent evidence chunks from full fact-checking articles by identifying semantic topic transitions and preserving local verification context. </details>

*Fabian Lukassen,Jan Herrmann,Christoph Weisser,Alexander Silbersdorff,Benjamin Saefken,Thomas Kneib*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large Language Models can transform XAI outputs into high-quality natural language explanations, but this quality does not translate to practical usefulness. In energy forecasting tasks, such explanations fail to improve accuracy while inflating user confidence through mere text presence, and reduce the ability to detect unreliable predictions—highlighting a "Quality-Usefulness Gap" that demands evaluation beyond text-quality metrics.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior work demonstrated that LLMs can produce Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) scoring highly on quality metrics (plausibility, coherence, comprehensibility). However, it remains unclear whether these high-quality NLEs translate to practical usefulness in real-world tasks.

Method: Five controlled experiments (2,730 judgments across 60 test instances) in a time-series energy forecasting domain, each operationalizing a distinct facet of usefulness. A placebo control was used to isolate the effect of text presence versus content.

Result: NLEs do not improve task accuracy across any of the five tasks while inflating self-reported confidence. This confidence boost is driven by text presence rather than content. In out-of-distribution detection, NLEs reduce the LLM judge's ability to flag unreliable predictions, providing false reassurance that masks model failure.

Conclusion: The study introduces and characterizes the "Quality-Usefulness Gap" and argues that XAI-to-NLE pipeline evaluation must extend beyond text-quality metrics to downstream task performance.

Abstract: Prior work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can transform Explainable AI (XAI) outputs into Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) that score highly on quality metrics such as plausibility, coherence, and comprehensibility. But does explanation quality translate to practical usefulness? We investigate this question in a time-series energy forecasting domain through five controlled experiments (2,730 judgments across 60 test instances), each operationalising a distinct facet of usefulness studied in the XAI literature. Holding NLE quality constant at the high levels established by a prior factorial study, we find that NLEs do not improve task accuracy on any of the five tasks, while inflating self-reported confidence. A placebic control shows that this confidence boost is driven by text presence rather than content. In an out-of-distribution detection task, NLEs reduce the LLM judge's ability to flag unreliable predictions, providing false reassurance that masks model failure. We characterise these findings as the Quality-Usefulness Gap and argue that evaluation of the XAI-to-NLE pipeline must extend beyond text-quality metrics to downstream task performance.

</details>


### [51] [EmoDistill: Offline Emotion Skill Distillation for Language Model Agents in Adversarial Negotiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26785)
*Yunbo Long,Haolang Zhao,Lukas Beckenbauer,Liming Xu,Alexandra Brintrup*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出EmoDistill框架，通过离线方式将情绪谈判技能提炼到语言模型智能体中。该框架结合隐式Q学习进行情绪选择，以及LoRA微调与判断策略优化进行情绪表达，在多个高风险谈判场景中超越基线方法，并展现出良好的跨领域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练LLM的对齐优化在对抗性谈判中可能成为弱点——情绪化语言会引导智能体偏离自身利益。论文认为情绪是一个战略性行动渠道，而非表面风格，因此需要专门将情绪谈判技能提炼到语言模型智能体中。

Method: EmoDistill将情绪策略分解为情绪选择和情绪表达两部分：隐式Q学习（IQL）选择器学习"何时"表达情绪，而基于低秩适应（LoRA）的策略通过监督微调（SFT）和判断策略优化（JPO）学习"如何"表达情绪。

Result: 在四个情绪敏感的高风险谈判领域中，基于EmoDistill框架训练的小型语言模型（SLM）策略获得最高效用，优于vanilla SLM/LLM基线和仅使用IQL的情绪选择方法。消融实验表明情绪条件化是关键，迁移研究表明该方法能够泛化到未见领域、未见对手以及训练-训练锦标赛场景。

Conclusion: EmoDistill能够从离线智能体间交互中学习技能，避免了训练过程中的高昂在线谈判成本，且展现出跨领域、跨对手及训练-训练锦标赛的泛化能力。

Abstract: Post-trained LLMs are often optimized to align responses with human preferences, making them safe, polite, and conversationally appropriate. In adversarial negotiation, however, this alignment can become a vulnerability: emotionally framed language may steer agents toward the counterparty's interests. Using GoEmotions-based affective prompting, we show that emotion substantially shifts negotiation outcomes, suggesting that emotion is a strategic action channel rather than a surface style. Thus, we introduce \textbf{EmoDistill}, an offline framework for distilling emotional negotiation skills into language model agents. EmoDistill decomposes emotional strategy into emotion selection and emotion expression: an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) selector learns \emph{which} emotion to express, while a Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)-based policy learns \emph{how} to express it through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Judge Policy Optimization (JPO). Across four emotion-sensitive, high-stakes negotiation domains, SLM policies trained under the EmoDistill framework achieve the highest utility, outperforming vanilla SLM/LLM baselines and IQL-only emotion selection. Ablations show that emotion conditioning is essential, and transfer studies demonstrate generalization across domains, unseen counterparties, and trained-vs-trained tournaments. Overall, EmoDistill learns skills from offline agent-to-agent interactions, avoiding costly online negotiation during training.

</details>


### [52] [SeDT: Sentence-Transformer Decision-Transformer Conditioning for Multi-Turn Conversation Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26788)
*Ramakrishna Vamsi Setti,Jagadeesh Rachapudi,Sachin Chaudhary,Praful Hambarde,Amit Shukla*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SeDT方法解决LLM多轮对话中的性能崩溃问题。该方法通过语义、词汇和位置三信号计算累积相关性分数并标注对话分片，使模型能在最终回合识别关键约束。实验证明此训练-free推理方法在9个组合中均有效，最高提升37.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: SeDT通过无需训练、无需权重更改且不丢弃上下文的推理时方法，在9个模型-任务组合中均优于基线，最高提升37.7%，同时在7个组合中降低不可靠性，证明了"告知模型哪些过去回合重要"足以显著恢复对话中丢失的性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve impressive performance when a task is fully specified in a single turn, yet the same models lose up to 39% of that performance when the identical task is revealed incrementally across multiple turns, a phenomenon documented at scale as Lost in Conversation. Crucially, this collapse is almost entirely a reliability failure; the best case, the aptitude only falls 16%, while the unreliability more than doubles (+112%). We argue that the root cause is structural, a flat conversation history assigns equal implicit weight to every prior turn, giving the model no signal to distinguish a critical constraint from incidental dialog. We present SeDT Sentence-transformer Decision-Transformer, a training-free inference-time method that resolves this by importing return-to-go conditioning from offline reinforcement learning. SeDT annotates each conversation shard with a cumulative relevance score derived from three complementary semantic, lexical, and positional signals and presents the full annotated history to the model at the final turn, without weight changes, without training data, and without discarding context. Evaluated on the Lost-in-Conversation benchmark in three LLMs and three generation tasks, SeDT outperforms the sharded baseline in all nine model-task combinations, with gains up to +37.7% in mean performance P and simultaneous reductions in unreliability in seven of the nine combinations. In short, telling the model which past turns matter is sufficient to substantially recover the performance lost in conversation.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理学构念通常在不同的测量工具、数据集和研究传统中进行测量，导致直接比较困难，缺乏统一的可通约性框架。

Method: 提出监督语义差异法(Supervised Semantic Differential)：(1)从文本-结果关联中估计构念特异性语义梯度；(2)将语义梯度投影到理论驱动的参考轴上。以效价、唤醒度和支配性(VAD)作为情感坐标系统进行验证。

Conclusion: 词嵌入空间可支持跨测量工具的构念级比较，但需对语义定位的稳定性和可解释性进行评估。该框架为整合不同心理学测量传统提供了方法学基础。

Abstract: Psychological constructs are often measured in separate instruments, datasets, and research traditions, which makes direct comparison difficult. This paper proposes a framework for making such constructs semantically commensurate by representing and comparing them as directions in a shared word-embedding space. Using Supervised Semantic Differential, we estimate construct-specific semantic gradients from text-outcome associations and project them onto theoretically motivated reference axes. As an initial test case, we use Valence, Arousal, and Dominance (VAD) as an affective coordinate system. First, we recover interpretable VAD directions from English word-level affective norms. Second, we project semantic gradients for 27 GoEmotions categories into this space and recover the expected organization of emotions, especially along valence and arousal. Third, we apply the same procedure to Big Five personality domains and facets derived from IPIP-NEO-300 item-factor associations. Domain-level placements are broadly coherent, while facet-level results are more exploratory because they rely on sparse questionnaire text. The results suggest that embedding spaces can support construct-level comparison across otherwise incommensurable psychological measurements, provided that semantic placements are assessed for stability and interpretability.

</details>

*Yunbo Long,Ge Zheng,Liming Xu,Alexandra Brintrup*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出TabKG框架，通过构建列关系知识图谱(CR-KG)并结合多LLM集成与潜在扩散模型，生成既保留统计分布又遵守运营逻辑约束的合成供应链表格数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据是解决供应链分析中数据稀缺和数据隐私问题的有前景方案，但现有表格生成模型主要优化分布保真度和下游预测效用，生成的记录虽然统计上逼真但往往违反基本操作约束。供应链数据的"物理"特性（包括时序排序、数学依赖、层级分类和条件规则）尚未被有效保留。

Method: TabKG构建列关系知识图谱(CR-KG)来表示数据操作依赖关系，使用多LLM集成与多数投票机制从列元数据中提出候选关系，并针对真实数据进行验证以移除幻觉或不支持的边。随后，将原始表格压缩为独立列，使用潜在扩散模型生成，再根据验证后的关系确定性重建依赖列，从而在发现的运营规则上强制执行逻辑一致性。

Result: 通过知识图谱验证操作规则并引导生成过程，TabKG能够确保合成数据在统计真实性的同时遵守运营逻辑约束。

Conclusion: TabKG provides a novel framework for generating logically consistent synthetic supply chain data by combining knowledge graph validation with latent diffusion models, ensuring both statistical fidelity and operational plausibility.

Abstract: Synthetic data offers a promising solution to two persistent barriers in supply chain analytics: data scarcity and data privacy. However, for synthetic data to support operational simulation and decision-making, it must do more than reproduce the statistical distributions of real records, and also preserve the \emph{operational logic} that governs supply chain processes, including the temporal orderings, mathematical dependencies, hierarchical taxonomies, and conditional rules that make a record operationally plausible. We consider this logic as the ``physics'' of supply chain data. Existing tabular generative models are primarily optimized for distributional fidelity and downstream predictive utility, and therefore often generate records that appear statistically realistic but violate fundamental operational constraints. This paper introduces \textbf{\textit{TabKG}}, a knowledge-graph-guided framework for logically consistent synthetic supply chain tabular data generation. TabKG constructs a \textbf{\textit{Column Relationship Knowledge Graph (CR-KG)}} to represent data operational dependencies. It uses a multi-LLM ensemble with majority voting to propose candidate relationships from column metadata, validates these relationships against real data to remove hallucinated or unsupported edges, and then uses the validated CR-KG to guide generation. Specifically, TabKG compresses the original table into independent columns, generates these columns using a latent diffusion model, and deterministically reconstructs dependent columns according to the validated relationships, enforcing logical consistency by construction with respect to the discovered operational rules.

</details>

Abstract: Recent benchmarks reveal that despite strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) still struggle to faithfully apply complex contextual knowledge. These failures are often not wholesale reasoning collapses: in context-rich tasks, models may follow the central reasoning path while missing peripheral, persistent, or format-sensitive requirements.

### [56] [Optimising Factual Consistency in Summarisation via Preference Learning from Multiple Imperfect Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26840)
*Yuxuan Ye,Raul Santos-Rodriguez,Edwin Simpson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一条全自动的摘要事实一致性优化流水线：仅用源文档，通过不同解码策略生成词汇高度相似的摘要对，用多个「弱」事实性指标（SBERTScore、SummaC）打分并转为二元偏好标签，筛除指标分歧样本后用 DPO 训练模型。在 XSUM/TL;DR 上，BART 的 AlignScore 大幅提升（XSUM +24.7），小模型可达到与 LLaMA/DeepSeek 相当的事实性水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要任务中模型频繁产生事实性错误或幻觉。已有工作多把单个自动指标（如 FactCC、SummaC、AlignScore）直接当作 RL 奖励，但这些指标本身不可靠（会误罚正确摘要、难以捕捉细微矛盾），且单指标标量奖励易导致训练不稳定、分布漂移与灾难性遗忘；将多指标作为 RL 奖励又需要繁琐的手工奖励塑形与权重调节。另一方面，RLHF 的人类偏好标注往往忽视事实性（标注者会权衡流畅性、信息量等），成本高、难扩展；MPO（Choi et al. 2024）用启发式规则（默认束搜索输出更好）标注，忽略了个体差异会引入大量噪声，且在词汇相似对上会退化。作者因此希望：无需人工标注与参考摘要，仅凭源文档自动构建高质量、聚焦事实性的偏好数据集。

Method: 方法由三部分组成：(1) 摘要对生成——对同一源文档采用束搜索（取第 1 与第 2 优候选 BS#1/BS#2）和束搜索+贪心解码（BS#1/Greedy）组合，刻意保证对内摘要词汇高度相似，从而把评测指标聚焦于细微事实差异而非文体/结构差异；由 Table 3 观察 BS#1 事实性最高，故以 BS#1 作为最终评测输出。(2) 数据标注——用多个计算成本低的事实性指标（相似度类 SBERTScore、蕴含类 SummaC-Conv）对每个摘要打分，跨指标不可比故转为二元偏好标签 P_mi=sign(S_mi(y1,x)-S_mi(y2,x))，再用「一致性过滤」仅保留所有指标标签完全一致的样本对（约 60%–70% 保留），以抑制弱指标噪声。(3) 训练——采用 DPO（无需独立奖励模型，损失为 σ(β(f_θ(x,y_w)-f_θ(x,y_l)))）进行偏好优化，大模型用 LoRA 适配器训练。实验覆盖 BART-large(406M)、GPT-J-6B、LLaMA-3.2-3B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B，数据集为 XSUM 与 TL;DR；评测用 AlignScore、FactCC（事实性）、BARTScore、ROUGE-L（流畅/相似），并用 ChatGPT-4o-mini 做两两对比胜率与错误类型（Intrinsic/Extrinsic/Noun/Predicate/Quantifier）分析；基线为 SFT、RLHF、MPO。

Result: 本文方法在 AlignScore、FactCC、BARTScore 上全面优于所有基线，且对所有模型均为正增益：XSUM 上 BART 61.9→86.6(+24.7)、GPT-J 59.7→75.8(+16.1)、LLaMA 86.1→88.7(+2.6)、DeepSeek 82.5→83.2(+0.7)；TL;DR 上 BART 84.9→94.2(+9.3)、GPT-J 89.6→93.8(+4.2)、LLaMA 91.4→93.5(+2.1)、DeepSeek 89.1→90.9(+1.8)。相反，MPO 在 GPT-J/LLaMA 上出现负增益（-6.2、-6.3、-5.0），RLHF 在 TL;DR 上普遍下降（-11.8、-8.1、-1.2）。ROUGE-L 略降（体现事实性与参考相似度的权衡）。消融显示：单一指标并不稳定生效（有时反而下降），多指标组合后全部模型提升，再加一致性过滤进一步提升；过滤平均仅剔除 27%–37% 的样本。相似度分析表明：词汇越相似越有利于学习事实差异，(BS#1,BS#2) 相似度约 0.94–0.99 效果最佳，平均相似度约 0.7 已足够，而 (BS#1,RS#1) 差异过大难以学习；本方法在 MPO 最好的低相似度设置上仍优于 MPO（72.0 vs 66.4）。ChatGPT 胜率显示本方法优于 MPO，但低于 SFT/RLHF——原因是本方法摘要更抽象、舍弃细节以降低幻觉风险。错误类型分析显示 Noun/Predicate/Quantifier 类错误频率下降，Correct 摘要显著增多。全程未出现灾难性遗忘。

Conclusion: 多指标组合经由偏好学习可有效转化为训练目标：仅用源文档、无需人工标注与参考摘要，即可跨架构与规模一致提升摘要事实一致性，甚至让 BART 这类小模型追平 LLaMA/DeepSeek 的事实性表现，且训练稳定、无需大型奖励模型。局限：仅验证了 SBERTScore 与 SummaC 两个打分指标，泛化性未充分验证；未与「标量指标直接作 RL 奖励」的路线做对比（因成本高、易灾难性遗忘）；方法牺牲部分信息量与流畅度（ROUGE-L 下降、ChatGPT 偏好度低于 SFT/RLHF），事实性与摘要风格的权衡需结合具体应用权衡；对推理模型（DeepSeek）增益最小，因偏好标签仅依据最终摘要，会忽略思维链过程中的错误，导致训练信号噪声。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with evaluation metrics as rewards is widely used to enhance specific capabilities of language models. However, for tasks such as factually consistent summarisation, existing metrics remain underdeveloped, limiting their effectiveness as signals for shaping model behaviour.While individual factuality metrics are unreliable, their combination can more effectively capture diverse factual errors. We leverage this insight to introduce an automated training pipeline that improves factual consistency in summaries by aggregating scores from different weak metrics. Our approach avoids the need for complex reward shaping by mapping scores to preferences and filtering out cases with high disagreement between metrics. For each source document, we generate lexically similar summary pairs by varying decoding strategies, enabling the model to learn from factual differences caused by subtle lexical differences. This approach constructs a high-quality preference dataset using only source documents.Experiments demonstrate consistent factuality gains across models, ranging from early encoder-decoder architectures to modern large language models, with smaller models reaching comparable factuality to larger ones.

</details>


### [57] [Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Adaptive Test-Time Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26849)
*Manh Nguyen,Sunil Gupta,Hung Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出不确定性感知预算分配方法 UAB：在固定总采样预算下，先对每题做一轮（K=2）固定采样，用答案投票熵免费估计难度，再用一个可精确求解的凹整数规划（边际贪心分配）把剩余预算重分配给"答案不一致"的题目，从而在相同成本下提升多数投票准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时计算扩展（self-consistency / best-of-N）虽能提升推理准确率，但均匀分配采样预算效率低下：简单题采样过多而早已饱和，困难题采样不足。已有自适应方法各有结构性缺陷：顺序早停类（Adaptive-Consistency、ESC、ReASC）实际开销取决于多少题触发停止，无法先验保证固定总预算 B，也不能把简单题省下的预算转给困难题；依赖辅助模型/训练难度预测器的方法在小 N 时开销占优；intra-trace 方法（MUR、SelfBudgeter）分配的是响应内部 token 而非样本数。作者的核心问题：在总预算 B=N×M 下如何分配样本以最大化准确率？作者认为只要配上凹目标的最优贪心求解，前几个样本的答案一致性已是足够的分配信号，无需额外模型或额外 LLM 调用。

Method: 形式化为可分离凹覆盖最大化整数规划：max Σ_i [1-(1-p_i)^{N_i}]，s.t. ΣN_i=B, N_i∈Z+。将 N_i=K+n_i 代入后得等价目标 Σ_i (1-p_i)^K[1-(1-p_i)^{n_i}]，即零基可分离凹背包问题，其边际增益 Δ_i(m)=p_i(1-p_i)^m 关于 m 单调不增，故边际贪心（每次把一个样本单位分配给当前边际增益最大的题）可精确求解（给出 KKT/交换论证的完整证明，Proposition 1/2，任意 tie-breaking 皆成立）。Phase-1：对每题均匀生成 K 个样本（默认 K=2），从答案投票分布计算归一化 Shannon 熵 H_i∈[0,1]，映射为成功率 p_i=e^{-H_i/τ}（默认 τ=1）；这些 K 个样本同时进入最终投票，不浪费预算。Phase-2：剩余预算 B_eff=(N−K)M 由贪心一次性分配；K=2 时 H∈{0,1}，退化为"一致/不一致规则+均分"，一致题 p=1 边际增益为 0 不再追加，不一致题按 ⌈B_eff/D⌉ 或 ⌊B_eff/D⌋ 均分。附录 F 给出 K=1 的 log-prob 变体（NLL、ANLL、Token Var、Max Token NLL，min-max 归一化后同样映射）。附录 C 分析了边际增益对 p 的单峰性（峰值 p*=1/(m+1)）及覆盖目标与多数投票准确率的分歧（p<1/2 时追加样本反而降低多数准确率），解释增益集中在低预算区间的原因。实验：5 个开源模型（Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B、Llama3.2-3B、GPT-OSS-20B、Gemma3-27B）× 5 个基准（MATH500、MMLU Formal Logic、DeepScaler、GSM8K、自建 Graded Arithmetic 10 级难度阶梯），N∈{4,8,12,16}，vLLM、temperature=1、max_new_tokens=1024、3 个种子、单张 H100；基线含 Random、Length、Uniform、LLM-Judge、ASC（阈值调参以匹配预算）、PETS（DSC 因无法达到低预算被剔除）；评估配对 bootstrap、分配相对 Oracle 的欠分配/过分配比例、τ 与 K 消融、墙钟时间与 token 消耗。

Result: N=4 时 UAB 在三个较小模型上均取得最高平均准确率，14/15 个模型-基准设定优于 Uniform，平均 +2.5%，单模型最高 +3.1%，GSM8K 上最高 +5.5%，其中 9 项改进在配对 bootstrap 下 p<0.05 显著；两个大模型上 UAB 全面优于 Uniform（+2.7% / +1.5%），但平均准确率不再超过 ASC（强模型 Phase-1 一致率更高，可重分配的不一致题更少）。增益集中在低预算 N≈4–8，N=16 时无显著优势；N≥12 时 UAB 与 ASC、PETS 接近，PETS 随预算增大追平 UAB。消融显示："w/o probe reuse"（丢弃 Phase-1 样本）变差，说明仅分配机制就贡献至少一半增益；投票熵在 AUROC 与准确率上均优于四种 K=1 log-prob 信号；K=2 在 N≤12 时最优，τ 对 K=2 不影响分配。相对 Oracle 的分配质量：UAB 欠分配比例最低（10.5%）、过分配且正确比例最高（75.4%），在有标注难度级的两个数据集上优于基于真实难度的 Oracle(Difficulty)。逐级分析显示 p̂ 与平均分配样本数随难度单调变化，但精度增益峰值不在最难级（最难题正确答案常不在采样中）。开销上 UAB 相对 Uniform 仅增加轻微墙钟时间（如 MATH500 上 134s vs 136s），每样本 token 消耗与基线相当，而 PETS 因逐样本 Monte-Carlo 知识梯度决策显著更慢。

Conclusion: UAB 把固定预算下的 LLM 采样分配建模为由投票熵驱动的凹整数规划，并用边际贪心精确求解，在无需辅助模型、训练或额外 LLM 调用、精确满足预算的条件下，于低预算场景稳定优于均匀分配（最高约 +3% 平均、+5.5% 单基准）。其贡献在于"无查询一致性信号 + 凹覆盖目标的可证明最优贪心求解"的组合，代码已开源。局限：优化的是覆盖代理目标而非多数投票准确率本身；假设题内样本独立（实际存在相关性会使覆盖增益偏乐观）；需可抽取离散答案类别做多数投票，仅验证于纯文本可抽取答案任务；随预算增大增益消失（N=16 无显著优势），且在强模型上已被 ASC 追平。

Abstract: Sampling multiple responses improves language model reasoning, but uniform compute allocation is inefficient: easy questions are over-sampled while hard questions remain under-explored. We propose Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation (UAB), a concave integer optimization framework that reallocates a fixed sampling budget based on per-question uncertainty estimated at no additional inference cost. In Phase 1, every question receives one generation; its average negative log-likelihood (ANLL), extracted directly from output log-probabilities, serves as a difficulty signal while the generation contributes to the final vote. In Phase 2, the remaining budget is allocated by a marginal-greedy algorithm that solves a concave coverage-maximization surrogate exactly: uncertain questions receive more sampling budget while confident questions receive fewer additional samples. Evaluated on six open-weight and black-box models spanning 1.5B to 27B parameters and five reasoning benchmarks covering math, logic, and preference tasks, UAB outperforms baselines by up to +3% in average accuracy and up to +5% on individual benchmarks, with the largest gains in low-resource settings, requiring no auxiliary model or additional LLM call. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/manhitv/UAB.

</details>


### [58] [Telenor Nordics Customer Service self-help corpus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26891)
*Mike Riess*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发布Telenor集团构建的北欧多语种客服自助文档语料库：包含芬兰语、丹麦语、挪威语、瑞典语共1,122篇经人工校验的文档（274,599词、1,884,833字符），源自四家北欧电信运营商的公开自助页面，经"网页抓取→HTML转Markdown并去导航→Gemma-3-27b-it标注相关性与PII→机器翻译为英文辅助校验→人工验证→过滤"流程产出，语料以CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0许可在Zenodo公开，旨在支持北欧语NLP与信息检索的可复现研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 北欧语言（芬兰语、丹麦语、挪威语、瑞典语）的领域专用数据集严重稀缺，客服自助文本尤为缺乏——而该领域对检索增强生成（RAG）、跨语迁移学习及新兴智能体式服务架构日益重要。同时Telenor集团业务战略上重视客服质量与知识资源建设，现有工作（如挪威语客服对话零样本分类）也表明LLM在该领域潜力巨大、并需要领域专用评测资源。因此Telenor希望以合乎伦理与法律的方式向学术社区开放真实世界客服语料，推动北欧NLP与AI创新。

Method: 采用六步数据准备管线：(1) 用专用爬虫抓取选定运营商网站的原始HTML；(2) 转换为Markdown，并用站点特定的XPath规则剥离导航菜单、页眉页脚等非正文元素；(3) 用LLM（Gemma-3-27b-it）标注内容相关性、PII检测及具体文本片段位置；(4) 用同一模型将文档机器翻译成英文，以降低人工校验时的误判与翻译误差（提示词见附录2）；(5) 人工标注员通过Web界面审核并修正自动标注（界面见附录3）；(6) 按相关性与法律合规标准过滤，剔除不合格文档。各站点初始抓取量为DNA Finland 382、Telenor DK 234、Telenor NO 187、Telenor SE 449，共1,252篇；按过滤步骤统计各站剩余文档量（表1）。论文遵循既有数据集文档化指南，完整记录构建全过程。

Result: 最终语料包含1,122篇人工校验文档，合计274,599词与1,884,833字符（超过一百万token），覆盖芬兰语、丹麦语、挪威语、瑞典语四种语言；来源为四家北欧电信运营商公开自助页面；已通过LLM+人工组合流程过滤个人身份信息（PII）并确保主题相关性。分析显示：不同运营商之间文档长度与结构差异显著，反映各自不同的编辑策略；主题覆盖广泛，涵盖网络硬件、移动服务、电视与流媒体、账单与账户管理等。数据集以CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0许可公开发布于Zenodo（记录号20732652）。

Conclusion: 该工作首次系统化地发布并文档化了北欧多语种电信客服自助语料库，在稀缺的低资源北欧语言领域填补了领域专用数据集空白。语料经严格的人工校验与隐私过滤、法律与伦理流程处理，可直接用于RAG、跨语迁移、客服LLM评测等研究，从而支撑可复现的北欧NLP与信息检索研究，并有助于提升真实客服知识资源的质量。

Abstract: This paper presents a multilingual customer service self-help corpus comprising 1,122 manually validated documents in Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, and Swedish, totaling over one million tokens. The documents have been sourced from the public self-help pages of four Nordic telecommunications operators and subsequently filtered for person-identifiable information and relevance through a combined LLM and human annotation pipeline. Domain-specific datasets for Nordic languages remain scarce, particularly in customer service: a domain of growing importance for retrieval-augmented generation, cross-lingual transfer learning, and emerging agent-based service architectures. An analysis of the corpus reveals substantial variation in document length and structure across operators, reflecting distinct editorial strategies, as well as broad topical coverage spanning network hardware, mobile services, TV and streaming, billing, and account management. The dataset is publicly available under a CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 license at https://zenodo.org/records/19493152, intended to support reproducible research in Nordic NLP and information retrieval.

</details>


### [59] [GeoFaith: A Spatio-Temporal Dual View of Faithful Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26893)
*Weijiang Lv,Wentong Zhao,Jiayu Wang,Yuhao Wu,Jiaheng Wei,Xiaobo Xia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has advanced large language models (LLMs), but outcome-based supervision leads to pervasive post-hoc rationalization, producing plausible yet unfaithful reasoning chains. Most prior faithfulness assessment methods are either unscalable, expensive, or unreliable. We propose GeoFaith, a spatio-temporal framework that leverages latent geometric structure and entropy dynamics to diagnose and enforce faithful reasoning. We develop a scalable bootstrapping pipeline expanding step-level annotations from 1k to 20k samples across four domains, train an 8B faithfulness detector outperforming GPT-5 on standard benchmarks, and design a faithfulness-aware reinforcement learning framework jointly optimizing outcome correctness, process faithfulness, and trajectory consistency. Experiments show the proposed method achieves superior performance on both faithfulness detection and downstream reasoning, producing shorter, more interpretable chains without sacrificing accuracy. Our code will be made available publicly.

### [60] [Are Video Models Zero-Shot Learners and Reasoners in Education? EduVideoBench, A Knowledge-Skills-Attitude Benchmark for Educational Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26918)
*Unggi Lee,Hoyoung Ahn,Yoon Choi,Seonmin Eun,Jahyun Jeong,Seonmin Jin,Harmony Jung,Hye Jin Kim,Chaerin Lee,Hyunji Lee,Jeongjin Lee,Soohwan Lee,Young-Seok Oh,Jaehyeon Park,Sun-ok Ryu,Sunyoung Shin,Yoorim Son,Haeun Park,Yeil Jeong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Video generation models (VGMs) are rapidly entering classrooms, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only perceptual quality, intrinsic faithfulness, generic safety, or video as a reasoning medium, and none assesses whether the outputs are educationally valid. In this work, we present EduVideoBench, the first balanced benchmark in the education domain, grounded in the Knowledge-Skills-Attitude (KSA) framework so that pedagogical adequacy and educational safety are evaluated jointly rather than as ad-hoc quality dimensions. Across five frontier VGMs, our results show substantial room for improvement across knowledge, skills, and attitude before they are classroom-ready. We complement this with a qualitative analysis of expert comments, finding that educational validity is multi-component, where a single misaligned element such as pacing, legibility, or notation can invalidate an otherwise correct video. We hope EduVideoBench will guide the development of VGMs that are pedagogically grounded and safe for the classroom.

### [61] [Learning to Adapt SFT Data for Better Reasoning Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26924)
*Lisong Sun,Li Wang,Chen Zhang,Jinyang Wu,Kui Zhang,Tianhao Peng,Wenjun Wu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, with post-training playing a crucial role in enhancing their reasoning capabilities. Among post-training paradigms, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely used: it leverages external data to provide dense supervision and enables efficient training. However, directly fine-tuning on expert data can hurt generalization when the data distribution is mismatched with the target model's own distribution. In this work, we propose Data Adaptation for Reasoning Tuning (DART), which formulates the use of a fixed, potentially distributionally misaligned SFT dataset as an optimization problem over demonstration transformations. DART trains a mapper model with reinforcement learning to convert original SFT data into model-adapted supervision that better matches the target model's distribution and learning preferences. The transformed data are then used for SFT, allowing the target model to better exploit external supervision. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that DART improves generalization, achieves higher training efficiency than direct RL, and helps models surpass standard SFT. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DART525E50D.

### [62] [Reasoning Depth and Environment Complexity: A Controlled Study of RLVR Data Allocation across Logical Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26934)
*Yihua Zhu,Qianying Liu,Fei Cheng,Jiaxin Wang,Akiko Aizawa,Sadao Kurohashi,Hidetoshi Shimodaira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become central to post-training reasoning models, yet a key limitation of existing studies is their narrow view of the reasoning space: difficulty is treated as reasoning depth alone, and reward is concentrated on forward deductive state tracking. We instead characterize the reasoning space along two dimensions. Difficulty. Beyond reasoning depth, we study environment complexity, where models must identify the correct path amid distractors and interacting structures. Rewarded reasoning form. We consider four abilities core to real-world reasoning: deductive state tracking, abductive recovery of hidden events or facts, inductive rule induction, and analogical transfer. To disentangle these factors, we construct a synthetic knowledge-graph environment with controlled pre- and post-training distributions, where each instance varies along depth, complexity, and task family. Three findings emerge: joint depth-complexity coverage outperforms single-axis recipes; reasoning families respond non-uniformly, with abductive reasoning degrading outside the RL-covered region and task correlations clustering into deductive-abductive and inductive-analogy pairs; and uniform mixing outperforms staged curricula under a fixed budget. We also find that recent off-the-shelf models exhibit the same deductive-over-abductive asymmetry, suggesting that this gap is not merely an artifact of our controlled setup.

### [63] [DunbaaBERT: From Sacrifice to Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26935)
*Iffat Maab,Waleed Jamil,Raphael Schmitt*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models have achieved strong performance across many NLP tasks, yet Urdu remains comparatively underexplored due to limited resources and fragmented evaluation settings. To address this gap, we introduce DunbaaBERT, a family of Urdu RoBERTa-base models trained from scratch with Byte-BPE vocabularies of 32k, 52k, and 96k tokens on a deduplicated 17GB Urdu corpus. We evaluate DunbaaBERT across intrinsic and downstream Urdu NLP benchmarks covering linguistic acceptability, news classification, offensive language detection, and sentiment analysis while analyzing vocabulary-size effects on performance and efficiency trade-offs. Across benchmarks, the DunbaaBERT variants achieve competitive performance against strong multilingual baselines while consistently maintaining favorable efficiency trade-offs. Interestingly, larger vocabularies do not consistently improve downstream effectiveness, with DunbaaBERT$_{\text{32k}}$ repeatedly providing the strongest overall efficiency profile. Overall, our results demonstrate that carefully curated Urdu-specific encoder models can remain highly competitive despite comparatively compact model and training scales. All models are released under the MIT license.

### [64] [Beyond Questions: Evaluating What Large Language Models (Actually) Know](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26937)
*Luca Giordano,Simon Razniewski*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Parametric knowledge in large language models (LLMs) is a cornerstone of their success, yet remains poorly understood. Existing knowledge benchmarks typically rely on predefined questions (e.g., "What is the birth date of M.L. King?"), evaluating only knowledge that benchmark designers explicitly choose to query, a problematic availability bias.
  In this paper, we introduce open knowledge evaluation, a new paradigm for LLM knowledge benchmarking. Instead of asking narrow questions, it evaluates models on the knowledge they choose to surface in response to open-ended elicitation prompts (e.g., "Tell me everything you know about M.L. King"). This shifts the focus from predefined answer retrieval toward characterizing the knowledge models naturally express.
  We instantiate this paradigm with BeQu (Beyond Questions), a benchmark of 10,000 entities paired with reference corpora for statement verification. Using BeQu, we evaluate a broad range of language models and analyze the effects of reasoning effort, model scale, prompt format, and knowledge domain. Data and leaderboard are available on this work's GitHub repository and at the benchmark's website.

Using BeQu, we evaluate a broad range of language models and analyze the effects of reasoning effort, model scale, prompt format, and knowledge domain. Data and leaderboard are available on this work's GitHub repository and at the benchmark's website.

</details>


### [65] [Accountable Human-AI Deliberation with LLMs: Scaling Collective Intelligence through Symbiotic Scaffolding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26940)
*Wajdi Zaghouani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) can support democratic deliberation at scales previously constrained by turn-taking and facilitation bandwidth. Recent work shows that LLM-generated group statements are often preferred over human-mediated outputs, while theoretical analyses argue that LLMs relax the simultaneity constraints limiting collective intelligence. Yet pure LLM mediation risks collapsing pluralism, over-optimizing for agreement, and undermining legitimacy when participants cannot contest how they are represented. We propose a symbiotic human-AI framework organized into three layers: observation and diversity amplification, facilitation with clause-level provenance, and human primacy for ratification. Our contributions include graded coverage, diversity, and erasure metrics with salience-aware weighting; a provenance pipeline combining cross-encoder similarity with causal knockout diagnostics; preference-conditioned trade-off control; equity-aware contestability workflows; adversarial robustness tests; and an evaluation protocol with ablation designs informed by evidence of LLM-as-judge limitations. The result is a testable blueprint for deliberation technology that scales collective intelligence while preserving agency and legitimacy.

### [66] [KZ-SafetyPrompts: A Kazakh Safety Evaluation Prompt Dataset for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26947)
*Wajdi Zaghouani,Shimaa Amer Ibrahim,Aruzhan Muratbek,Olzhasbek Zhakenov,Adiya Akhmetzhanova*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Kazakh is underrepresented in resources for evaluating the safety behavior of large language models. We present KZ-SafetyPrompts, a Kazakh prompt dataset for safety evaluation across eleven categories covering common risk areas such as self-harm, violence, child exploitation, sexual content, racist content, radicalization, and regulated goods or illegal activities. The dataset contains 5,717 prompts written natively in Kazakh (Cyrillic), organized by category, with English translations for cross-lingual analysis. Prompts resemble realistic user queries, often in a teen or child style, and are phrased as intent prompts without procedural instructions. We document the writing protocol, labeling procedures (including borderline-case decision rules), and quality-control steps (schema standardization, completeness checks, and deduplication). We also align the categories with widely used safety taxonomies to support integration with existing evaluation pipelines. Baseline results with GPT-4o show an overall refusal rate of 28.2%, varying from 5.5% to 53.8% across categories, indicating that Kazakh prompts expose category-specific safety gaps not captured by English-only evaluation.

### [67] [Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning with On-Policy Intrinsic Knowledge Boundary Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26952)
*Dingwei Chen,Zefang Zong,Zhipeng Ma,Leo Luo,Yang Li,Chengming Li,Peng Chen,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) has proven effective for training LLM-based agents with external tool-use capabilities. However, we identify that agentic RL training induces increasing redundant tool calls and blurs the model's intrinsic knowledge boundary, where the model fails to distinguish when tools are needed versus when parametric knowledge suffices. Existing solutions based on reward shaping create coarse-grained optimization targets that tend to incentivize indiscriminate tool-call suppression, leading to reward hacking. In this paper, we propose AKBE (Agentic Knowledge Boundary Enhancement), an on-policy method that dynamically probes the model's intrinsic knowledge boundary through dual-path (with-tool and no-tool) rollouts during training. We define the knowledge boundary as the per-instance determination of whether tools are required and the minimum tool calls necessary. By comparing correctness across paths, AKBE categorizes trajectories and constructs targeted supervisory signals that guide efficient tool-use patterns for each question. These signals are integrated seamlessly into the agentic RL training loop. Experiments on seven QA benchmarks demonstrate that AKBE improves task accuracy by +1.85 on average and reduces tool calls by 18% over standard agentic RL, yielding 25% higher tool productivity without any accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Further analysis suggests its plug-and-play compatibility across different RL algorithms and the mechanism of each signal category. Our code is available at https://github.com/CuSO4-Chen/AKBE.
