Results: Recoverable main-agent telemetry contained 75,671 de-duplicated records across 96 active days, with 8,059 user-role and 23,710 assistant-role messages. The workspace included 502 memory-related files, 17 configured agent directories, and 57 skill files. Active system time was 579.7 hours (30-minute capped-gap estimate). Memory-derived records identified 482 output-proxy events and 889 failure, verification, correction, or protocol-proxy events. A strict May 2026 trajectory subset captured 627 model-completed events and 73.95 million recorded tokens, of which 82.9% were cache reads. Conclusions: The workflow was cache-dominant, suggesting that persistent agentic environments may shift the economic unit from cost per token to cost per completed artifact. Future evaluations should use artifact-level denominators, reproducible parsing rules, correction taxonomies, and independent coding of governance events.

</details>


### [112] [Cost of Structural Learning Under Censored Feedback: A Threshold-Bandit Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27076)
*Michael Ledford,William Regli*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 研究多智能体多臂老虎机中阈值触发任务的协调学习问题，提出集中式C-TAC和去中心化D-TAC算法，证实在截断反馈下可实现对数级遗憾，且去中心化方法能大幅降低通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体任务中，当协作联盟规模满足未知阈值时才获得奖励反馈，否则反馈被完全截断。此截断导致可辨识性问题：智能体无法区分随机失败与协调不足。

Method: 提出TAC-MAB形式化框架；设计集中式C-TAC算法（ regrets O(log T)），分解为结构性搜索项和统计监控项；开发去中心化D-TAC协议，采用事件触发通信，仅在结构信念变化时同步。

Result: 集中式C-TAC算法达到O(log T)的累积遗憾；去中心化D-TAC在保持可行性对齐的同时实现23倍通信量 reduction。

Conclusion: D-TAC实现23倍通信量 reduction，同时保持可行性对齐，证明了无需持续同步即可实现接近集中式的通信效率，揭示了截断反馈下学习的协调成本。

Abstract: In many multi-agent applications, tasks yield rewards only when executed by a coalition meeting an unknown size threshold; otherwise, feedback is fully censored. This censorship creates an identifiability problem: agents cannot distinguish stochastic failure from insufficient coordination. We formalize this setting as the Threshold-Activated Cooperative Multi-Armed Bandit (TAC-MAB) and analyze it under both centralized and decentralized coordination. We show that a centralized algorithm (C-TAC) achieves cumulative regret O(log T), decomposed into a structural-search term that captures the cost of resolving feasibility under censored feedback and a statistical-monitoring term for value estimation. We then introduce D-TAC, a decentralized event-triggered protocol in which agents synchronize only when their structural beliefs change. Empirically, D-TAC achieves a 23x reduction in communication relative to the centralized baseline while preserving feasibility alignment under conservative belief fusion. These results characterize the coordination cost of learning under censored feedback and show that near-centralized communication efficiency is achievable without continuous synchronization.

</details>


<div id='cs.IR'></div>

# cs.IR [[Back]](#toc)

### [113] [Credit-assigned Policy Gradient for Early Stage Retrieval in Two-stage Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26385)
*Haruka Kiyohara,Mihaela Curmei,Ariel Evnine,Shankar Kalyanaraman,Israel Nir,Ana-Roxana Pop,Nitzan Razin,Sarah Dean,Thorsten Joachims,Udi Weinsberg*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文针对两阶段检索系统中早期排序器（ESR）的训练难题，提出信用分配策略梯度（CA-PG）方法，通过边际化候选集组成来降低策略梯度方差，在保持与后期排序器对齐的前提下，显著提升大规模候选集场景下的训练效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有策略梯度方法（V-PG）在大规模候选集场景下梯度方差爆炸，难以规模化应用。原因在于V-PG将梯度传播到候选集的联合概率分布，忽略了个别候选项对奖励的独立贡献。

Method: 提出信用分配策略梯度（CA-PG），通过将梯度计算从联合概率转换为目标项被选中的边际概率（即对所有包含该目标的候选集求边际），实现方差缩减。

Result: 实验证明，CA-PG在Plackett-Luce模型下显著提升收敛速度和训练稳定性，尤其在大规模候选集场景。

Conclusion: CA-PG显著改善了大规模候选集场景下ESR训练的收敛速度和稳定性，为两阶段检索系统的端到端优化提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Large-scale search, recommendation, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems typically employ a two-stage architecture: an early-stage ranker (ESR) generates a candidate set, which is subsequently re-ranked by a late-stage ranker (LSR). While there are many reinforcement learning (RL) methods for training the LSR, end-to-end training of the ESR has proven challenging. In particular, naive application of "vanilla" policy gradient (V-PG) is not scalable for candidate-set sizes relevant for practical use due to exploding variance. This issue arises because V-PG propagates the gradient to the joint probability of the candidate sets, ignoring the contribution of each specific item in the candidate set to the reward. To mitigate this issue, we propose a novel "credit-assigned" policy gradient (CA-PG), which computes gradients with respect to the probability that the target item is chosen in any candidate set, i.e. marginalizing over all candidate sets that contain it. Our theoretical analysis reveals that CA-PG significantly reduces the variance of V-PG by marginalizing over the specific composition of the candidate set, while preserving the ability to learn the correct ranking of items under a reasonably aligned LSR policy. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world data demonstrate that CA-PG improves the convergence speed and training stability for ESRs utilizing the canonical Plackett-Luce model, especially when the candidate-set size is large.

</details>


### [114] [Plans for Evaluating Structured Generative Search Summaries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26400)
*Tetsuya Sakai,Jina Lee,Hanpei Fang,Young-In Song*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文（Tetsuya Sakai 等，Waseda University / Naver Corporation，arXiv 预印本）提出并"设计"了一个用于评价搜索结果页（SERP）顶部由大语言模型生成的结构化搜索摘要的框架 SGSS，并详细给出后续的实现与验证计划。核心是由 XUX（Expected User Experience，期望用户体验）与 Comp（Comprehensiveness，全面性）两大部分组合而成的 SGSS 总分；本文仅是框架与计划论文，实验结果留待他文报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着 LLM 被搜索引擎部署到 SERP 顶部，在自然（organic）结果之上生成"概览 + 若干小节（标题+陈述）+ 引用文档列表"的结构化摘要，传统二十余年沿用的 nDCG 等度量只能评价文档列表（doclist），无法评价生成内容本身。更关键的是：(1) LLM 存在"幻觉"，即使源文档准确，生成步骤仍可能注入错误信息，因此除相关性（relevance）外还必须考察忠实性（faithfulness/groundedness）；(2) 开发者视角还需要知道摘要"漏掉了什么"，即全面性（comprehensiveness，对应传统 IR 的 recall 概念）；(3) 真实检索场景中任意查询往往不存在人工参考摘要，因而只能采用 reference-free 的评价方式；(4) 已有工作（如 Gienapp et al., 2024 的 reading model）多针对"扁平"的带引用文本，未利用结构化摘要的层级特性。

Method: 框架把 doclist 视为给定条件，聚焦评价结构化摘要本身。① 阅读模型与用户模型：把摘要按"行"切分——概览 1 行、每个小节标题 1 行、每条陈述 1 行，总行数 L = 1 + I + ΣJ_i；引入最大阅读行数 L_max（可用真实点击/滚动/悬停日志，或按阅读速度常数×时间窗 M 估算，如韩语约 500 字符/分钟，L_max ≈ 500M/avlen）进行截断惩罚。② 放弃概率分布（APD）与 XUX：假设一群体用户在摘要中不同位置放弃阅读，先用 L' = min(L, L_max) 上的均匀分布实例化，XUX = (1/L')Σ_{l=1}^{L'} X(l)；并给出 XUX_F（仅在概览行或小节末行放弃）与 XUX_G（任意 APD 的一般化）变体。③ 质量基元（由人工或 LLM 标注，3 级 Perfectly/Partially/No，映射到 0–1）：概览层面 OS（Overview Sufficiency，对应 query-overview）、OF（Overview Faithfulness，doclist 是否 entail 概览断言）、OR（Overview Representativeness，概览是否概括了各小节），加权得 OQ(o)；标题层面 HR（Heading Representativeness，第 i 小节各陈述对标题的平均相关性）；陈述层面 SRel（Statement Relevance，对 query）与 SF（Statement Faithfulness，对引用文档）。④ Top-heavy 的 XUX 实例化：X(l) = X'(l)/l，X'(l) = OQ(o) + w_HR·ΣHR + w_SRel·ΣSRel + w_SF·ΣSF（只累加行号 ≤ l 的成分），从而奖励"好内容前置"，类似 AP 的 top-heaviness；文中以 Figure 3 的重排示例说明。⑤ Comp（全面性）：对同一查询收集 N>1 个不同生成器产出的摘要，抽取其小节构成池 P（K=|P| 个小节），对每个摘要与每个池中小节做 3 级相关性标注（自身小节记为 Perfectly），归一化为概率分布 F^n，以池上的均匀分布 U 为"gold"分布，定义 Comp(S^n) = 1 − JSD(F^n, U)，奖励"覆盖各视角且均衡"的摘要。⑥ 总分：SGSS(S) = XUX(S) + w_Comp·Comp(S)。⑦ 实施计划：构建数据集（真实查询的生成输出、至少两个不同生成摘要器、退化版本 NoHeadings / NoSection1、类似 ten-blue-links 的并排标注界面、H>2 名标注者给出 OS/OF/OR、HR、SRel/SF、绝对全面性及 LEFT/RIGHT 偏好标签，并由 LLM 产生同套标签；训练/测试划分用于调参）；用逻辑回归拟合 ΔSGSS = SGSS(S_LEFT) − SGSS(S_RIGHT) 与偏好标签以确定各权重 w_OS…w_Comp，并做准则精简的模型选择；用查询日志估计 L_max；评价用 agreement rate（AR）与 Mean AR（MAR），并检验 LLM 标注能否替代人工。

Result: 论文本身不含实验结果，属于"提出框架 + 实施计划"性质：给出了 SGSS 的完整形式化定义（XUX 系列公式、OQ/HR/SRel/SF 标注与权重约束条件、Comp 的 Jensen–Shannon 散度形式、SGSS 线性组合）、数据构造与标注方案、权重学习与验证方法论，并以 Figure 3/4 的小例子说明 top-heaviness（(a) 优于 (b)）与 Comp 计算（示例中 a=0.983、b=0.792）。文中亦讨论了若干开放问题：XUX 的 APD 目前取均匀分布、非均匀情形留待未来；XUX 无法量化"缺失的相关信息"与"多方面的均衡覆盖"，故必须引入 Comp；是否可去掉某些评价准则以简化 SGSS 尚待实验。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一个面向 SERP 顶部结构化生成摘要的、可解释、reference-free 的评价框架：XUX 通过行级用户放弃模型与 top-heavy 加权刻画"用户实际看到什么"的精确性/忠实性体验，Comp 通过小节池化与 Jensen–Shannon 散度刻画系统开发者视角的全面性，SGSS 将二者线性组合。标注环节主张"分而治之"（divide and conquer），把复杂评价分解为可简单控制的人工或 LLM 子任务，并兼顾与对话式检索用户模型、S-measure/U-measure、SWAN 等既有框架的衔接。作者正在准备数据，计划以逻辑回归调权重、以 MAR 验证 SGSS 与人类偏好的一致性，实施与评估结果将另行报告。

Abstract: We propose a framework for evaluating structured generative search summaries that are placed atop organic web search results. A structured summary, generated by a large language model, typically consists of an overview, several sections with section titles, and a list of source documents that are cited within the summary. We then describe our plans for implementing and evaluating the framework.

</details>


### [115] [Uniboost: Global Coordination with Value Alignment for Fair and Efficient Traffic Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26424)
*Ge Fan,Nan Zhao,Kai Meng,Cong Luo,Yang Fu,Huiping Chu,Jialin Liu,Yuning Jiang,Bo Zheng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Uniboost is a unified traffic allocation framework for industrial recommendation systems that addresses score inflation and interpretability issues through value alignment and decoupled boosting, validated via A/B tests to improve both micro-level efficiency and macro-level system guidance.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing recommendation system approaches suffer from three key challenges: coupled allocation plans, score inflation, and lack of interpretability, which limit their effectiveness in allocating traffic across diverse business objectives.

Method: Uniboost introduces a posterior value alignment mechanism that calibrates abstract model scores to anchor metrics with explicit business semantics, combined with an independent linear boosting paradigm to decouple complex weighting schemes for precise attribution of each plan's contribution.

Result: Three key findings: 1) Reducing overall weight of weighted scores mitigates unintended business interference for more efficient micro-level traffic allocation; 2) Post-hoc analyses and aggregated dashboards provide macro-level insights for overall traffic allocation mechanism design; 3) The "Effective Completion Score" serves as a reliable anchor post-metric for content recommendation pipelines.

Conclusion: Uniboost provides an efficient and controllable traffic regulation solution for large-scale industrial recommendation systems, improving both micro-level traffic allocation efficiency and recommendation performance while offering macro-level guidance for system iteration.

Abstract: With the rapid evolution of internet services, recommendation systems have become indispensable. In particular, the blending (re-ranking) stage plays a pivotal role in allocating traffic across diverse business objectives. However, existing approaches often suffer from coupled allocation plans, score inflation, and a lack of interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose Uniboost, a unified traffic allocation framework. Uniboost introduces a posterior value alignment mechanism that calibrates abstract model scores to anchor metrics with explicit business semantics, significantly enhancing interpretability. Furthermore, it employs an independent linear boosting paradigm to decouple complex weighting schemes, enabling precise attribution of each plan's contribution. We validate the effectiveness of Uniboost through online A/B tests and in-depth data analysis, demonstrating three key findings: 1) Reducing the overall weight of weighted scores effectively mitigates unintended business interference, yielding a more efficient micro-level traffic allocation strategy; 2) Post-hoc analyses and aggregated dashboards provide intuitive, macro-level insights that guide the design of the overall traffic allocation mechanism; 3) The proposed "Effective Completion Score" serves as an easily obtainable post-metric that offers a reliable anchor for content recommendation pipelines. Collectively, our experiments show that Uniboost not only improves traffic allocation efficiency and recommendation performance at the micro level but also provides macro-level guidance for system iteration. Thus, this work provides an efficient and controllable traffic regulation solution for large-scale industrial recommendation systems.

</details>


### [116] [Is Position Bias in Dense Retrievers Built In-or Learned from Data?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26578)
*Daegon Yu,SeungYoon Han,Woomyoung Park*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 论文研究了训练数据中证据位置分布如何影响密集检索器的位置偏差。研究通过构建位置定向的合成训练集，对8种不同架构的预训练模型进行微调，发现训练分布的位置偏斜会显著影响检索偏差方向，位置平衡训练可将位置敏感性降低57-87%，表明平衡数据策划是缓解位置偏差的实用策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前关于密集检索器位置偏差的研究主要从架构角度解释，但忽视了训练数据中证据位置分布的影响。

Method: 构建了证据位置分别在文档开头、中间或结尾的合成位置定向训练集；对8种架构多样的预训练模型分别在使用位置偏斜和平衡的训练分布下进行微调；在排序层面和表征层面进行多维度分析。

Result: 发现跨模型存在强烈的方向性模式：偏斜的训练分布偏好对应位置的证据；位置平衡训练使位置敏感性降低57-87%，同时保持具有竞争力的平均检索性能；微调通常会重塑学习到的位置偏好，但部分模型中仍保留预训练的架构特异性倾向。

Conclusion: 训练数据的位置分布是影响检索级位置偏差的主要可控因素，平衡数据策划是实际可行的缓解策略。

Abstract: Dense retrievers exhibit positional bias, favoring documents whose query-relevant information appears near the beginning and degrading retrieval performance when the information appears later. While prior work on positional bias in dense retrievers has largely focused on architectural explanations, we study how the positional distribution of evidence in training data affects retrieval-level bias direction. To test this, we construct synthetic position-targeted training sets in which query-relevant evidence appears at the beginning, middle, or end of documents, and fine-tune eight architecturally diverse pretrained models under position-skewed and balanced training distributions. At the ranking level, we observe a strong directional pattern across the examined models: skewed training distributions favor evidence at the corresponding positions. Position-balanced training reduces positional sensitivity by 57--87\% on position-aware benchmarks, with competitive mean retrieval performance in our controlled setting. Representation-level analyses further suggest that fine-tuning often reshapes learned positional preferences, although pre-existing architectural or pretraining-specific tendencies persist in some models. These results identify training-position distribution as a major controllable factor in retrieval-level position bias and suggest balanced data curation as a practical mitigation strategy.

</details>


### [117] [L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26717)
*Pingjun Pan,Tingting Zhou,Peiyao Lu,Tingting Fei,Hongxiang Chen,Chuanjiang Luo*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: L2Rec通过DPMoE机制实现参数级behavioral-semantic统一适配，解决传统方法分布对齐问题，工业验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM推荐方法在input-level或output-level整合behavioral和semantic信号，存在distribution gap或缺乏端到端监督的问题。

Method: 提出Dual-view Personalized MoE (DPMoE)机制，通过 view-specific 低秩扰动实现参数级统一；设计 adaptive cross-view fusion module 整合双视图输出。

Result: 四个数据集实验表明L2Rec一致优于SOTA基线；大规模工业平台A/B测试验证关键 engagement metrics 显著提升。

Conclusion: L2Rec通过单一LLM主干实现 behavioral 和 semantic 双重适应，融合模块有效整合双视图输出，在工业场景验证有效。

Abstract: Adapting large language models (LLMs) for personalized recommendation requires aligning their general-purpose capabilities with user-specific preferences while effectively leveraging both behavioral and semantic signals. Existing approaches typically integrate these signals at either the input level (e.g., injecting behavioral embeddings into the token space) or the output level (e.g., contrastive alignment of separate encoders), suffering from distribution gaps or lack of end-to-end task supervision. In this work, we introduce L2Rec, which unifies behavioral and semantic understanding at the parameter level of LLMs. Our key insight is that the same set of Transformer parameters can serve as a shared medium for both views: by applying view-specific, personalized low-rank perturbations via a Dual-view Personalized Mixture-of-Experts (DPMoE) mechanism, L2Rec enables a single LLM backbone to produce complementary behavioral and semantic adaptations for each user with minimal representation-level misalignment. An adaptive cross-view fusion module further integrates the dual-view outputs into a unified user preference. Experiments on four datasets show that L2Rec consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, and online A/B testing on a large-scale industrial platform validates significant improvements in key engagement metrics.

</details>


### [118] [RAGEAR: Retrieval-Augmented Graph-Enhanced Academic Recommender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26819)
*Francesco Granata,Lorenzo Lamazzi,Misael Mongiovì,Francesco Poggi,Valeria Secchini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: RAGEAR是一种神经符号系统，通过融合讲座文本语义检索与知识图谱结构化推理，实现学术课程推荐。其创新点在于图感知聚合函数，有效整合多层次证据提升推荐准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有课程推荐系统多依赖元数据，缺乏对细粒度教学内容的深度利用，无法有效处理学生对具体学习内容的语义查询需求。

Method: 提出RAGEAR系统，结合密集检索（对完整讲座文本进行语义检索）与符号知识图谱（建模课程、课时、文本块、学分、学习计划等实体及关系）。核心贡献是图感知聚合函数，通过三个因子将文本块级别的证据传播聚合到课程级别：(1)课程相关检索相似度的占比；(2)相关文本块的排名强度；(3)证据在课程各课时中的分布。

Result: 在152个类学生查询上的评估表明：(1)讲座文本转录内容优于仅基于元数据的检索；(2)RAGEAR相较于基于文本的SumP基线方法进一步提升了排序质量，尤其在top-ranked推荐中效果显著。

Conclusion: RAGEAR通过图感知聚合函数有效整合了文本检索与结构化知识，显著提升了课程推荐的质量，特别是在排名靠前的推荐结果上表现更佳。

Abstract: We present RAGEAR (Retrieval-Augmented Graph-Enhanced Academic Recommender), a neurosymbolic recommender system for academic course recommendation. RAGEAR combines dense retrieval over full lecture transcripts with a symbolic Knowledge Graph modelling courses, lessons, transcript chunks, credits, study plans, and curricular information. The Knowledge Graph supports symbolic filtering and contextualisation based on structured constraints, such as credits, academic disciplines, study plans, and prerequisites. Unlike metadata-based approaches, it exploits fine-grained instructional content by retrieving transcript chunks semantically aligned with a student's query. The main contribution is a graph-aware aggregation function that propagates chunk-level evidence to course-level recommendations. The score combines three factors: the share of retrieved similarity associated with a course, the rank-based strength of its relevant chunks, and the distribution of evidence across lessons. We evaluate RAGEAR on 152 student-like queries through a human evaluation sample and a large-scale LLM-based relevance assessment. Results show that lecture transcripts improve over metadata-only retrieval, and that RAGEAR further improves ranking quality over a transcript-based normalized SumP baseline, especially for top-ranked recommendations.

</details>


### [119] [ICICLE: Expanding Retrieval with In-Context Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26902)
*Yu-Chen Den,Yung-Yu Shih,Zhi Rui Tam,Kuan-Yu Chen,Pu-Jen Cheng,Yun-Nung Chen,Eugene Yang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出ICICLE框架，将增量生成检索重新定义为上下文内检索问题，通过COPY路由、偏好校准和大上下文适应实现无需参数更新的新文档索引。实验表明该方法有效，但路由失败是扩展性的关键瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成检索(GR)将查询直接映射到文档标识符，但语料库扩展代价高昂——新增文档需要更新模型参数来编码新的文档-docid关联，导致重复训练和灾难性遗忘问题。

Method: 提出ICICLE框架，采用[COPY]路由机制、偏好校准和大上下文适应，将源感知docid生成与上下文提供的文档-docid对结合，实现新文档的上下文内检索。

Result: 在MS MARCO和NQ320K上，ICICLE改善了新引入文档的检索性能，同时保持了已见文档的保留率，无需针对语料库的重新训练。

Conclusion: ICICLE实现了无需重新训练的增量索引，MS MARCO和NQ320K上的实验表明该方法有效改善了新文档检索同时保留已见文档性能；路由失败是扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) maps queries directly to document identifiers (docids) using parametric knowledge, However, this design makes corpus expansion costly: adding new documents requires updating model parameters to encode new document-docid associations incurs repeated training and catastrophic forgetting of previously indexed documents. In this work, we revisit incremental GR as an in-context retrieval problem, where newly added documents are supplied as inference-time document-docid evidence. We propose ICICLE, an in-context indexing framework that performs source-aware docid generation over both parametric memory and context-provided document-docid pairs. ICICLE combines a `[COPY]`-based routing mechanism, preference-based calibration, and large context adaptation to distinguish context-grounded retrieval from parametric retrieval. Experiments on MS MARCO and NQ320K show that ICICLE improves retrieval of newly introduced documents while preserving seen-document retention without corpus-specific retraining. Our analysis further shows that high-shot degradation is mainly caused by routing failure, highlighting source-selection calibration as a key bottleneck for scaling in-context generative retrieval.

</details>


### [120] [The 2nd EReL@MIR Workshop on Efficient Representation Learning for Multimodal Information Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26941)
*Junchen Fu,Xuri Ge,Xin Xin,Alexandros Karatzoglou,Ioannis Arapakis,Xi Wang,Qijiong Liu,Qian Li,Joemon M. Jose*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: This paper proposes organizing the EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026 to address efficiency challenges when adapting large multimodal foundation models for information retrieval tasks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: While large multimodal foundation models (Qwen, LLaVA, CLIP) achieve strong performance on various multimodal information retrieval (MIR) tasks like web search, cross-modal retrieval, and recommender systems, their massive parameter counts create significant efficiency bottlenecks that hinder practical deployment in real-world IR applications.

Method: The workshop will serve as a platform bringing together academic and industry researchers to discuss and develop solutions, focusing on efficiency challenges in adapting large multimodal models for IR tasks during training, deployment, and inference stages.

Result: Workshop organized at MM 2026 with official website https://erel-mir.github.io/

Conclusion: The proposed EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026 aims to bridge the gap between the impressive capabilities of multimodal foundation models and their practical deployment in IR systems by fostering collaboration, developing efficiency-focused solutions, and establishing new benchmarks and metrics for the field.

Abstract: Multimodal representation learning has attracted increasing attention in AI, driven by the strong performance of large, pretrained multimodal foundation models such as Qwen, LLaVA, and CLIP. These models deliver impressive performance on a range of multimodal information retrieval (MIR) tasks, including web search, cross-modal retrieval, and recommender systems. Yet their massive parameter counts create major efficiency bottlenecks when adapting their representations for IR tasks during training, deployment, and inference. These limitations hinder the practical use of foundation models for representation learning in information retrieval. To address these issues, we propose organizing the EReL@MIR workshop at MM 2026, bringing together researchers from academia and industry to discuss emerging solutions, open challenges, and new efficiency metrics and benchmarks for multimodal IR representation learning in the foundation-model era. The workshop's official website is available at https://erel-mir.github.io/.

</details>


### [121] [MuChator: Enabling Active Music Discovery via Conversational Music LLMs in Douyin Music](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27103)
*Jiahao Liang,Linzhi Huang,Xuannan Liu,Xukai Wang,Xuanpu Luo,Yongchun Zhu,Jingwu Chen,Feng Zhang,Xiao Yang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: MuChator是抖音音乐推出的交互式音乐大模型框架，通过音乐知识预训练、上下文感知指令微调和混合奖励模型偏好对齐三个组件，使LLM能够理解情境化音乐意图，实现主动音乐发现。实验证明其性能优于Gemini-3-Pro，线上A/B测试用户活跃天数提升46.49%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音乐平台（如抖音）采用被动推荐的沉浸式信息流范式，用户被限制在推荐结果中，难以显式表达听歌意图。实际主动音乐发现往往是情境化和口语化的，涉及模糊或不明确的请求。LLM直接应用于音乐发现受限于领域知识不足、缺乏音乐-查询协作推理能力以及对个性化偏好的浅层理解。

Method: MuChator包含三个核心组件：（1）音乐知识预训练，采用三阶段渐进式方案向LLM注入客观音乐知识、主观音乐知识和个性化音乐偏好；（2）上下文感知指令微调，通过自动化合成流水线构建高质量用户-查询-音乐三元组，对齐LLM与主动情境化用户意图；（3）混合奖励模型偏好对齐，联合建模意图相关性、个性化偏好和基本约束，使用GRPO-based强化学习优化。

Result: 在工业级音乐推荐数据集上的评估表明，MuChator优于Gemini-3-Pro等领先专有模型。

Conclusion: MuChator已在字节跳动抖音音乐App中成功部署，在线A/B测试显示用户活跃天数提升46.49%，证明了该交互式MusicLLM框架在主动音乐发现场景中的实用价值。

Abstract: Douyin Music, a large-scale platform with millions of daily users, adopts an immersive, feed-based discovery paradigm, where users passively explore music through continuous recommendations. While effective for passive music discovery, this paradigm restricts users to recommendation results and provides limited support for explicitly specifying listening intents. Unlike conventional search, where users express well-defined intents through explicit queries such as specific songs or artists, real-world active music discovery is often situational and colloquial, involving vague or underspecified requests. While LLMs enable natural language interaction, their direct use in music discovery remains limited by insufficient music-domain knowledge, lack of music-query collaborative reasoning, and shallow understanding of personalized preferences. To address these challenges, we introduce MuChator, an interactive MusicLLM-based framework that enables users to actively express situational music intents in natural language. MuChator incorporates three key components: (1) Music Knowledge Pre-training, a three-stage scheme that incrementally injects objective music knowledge, subjective music knowledge, and personalized music preferences into LLMs; (2) Context-aware Instruction Tuning, which constructs high-quality user-query-music triplets through an automated synthesis pipeline to align LLMs with active and situational user intents; and (3) Preference Alignment with Hybrid RM, which jointly models intent relevance, personalized preferences, and basic constraints, and is optimized using GRPO-based reinforcement learning. Extensive evaluations on industrial music recommendation datasets demonstrate that MuChator outperforms leading proprietary models, such as Gemini-3-Pro. The model has been deployed on Douyin Music App within ByteDance, with 46.49\% improvement of user active days in online A/B test.

</details>


### [122] [Lost in the Evidence? Reproducing Document Position and Context Size Effects in RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27105)
*Jorge Gabín,Anxo Perez,Javier Parapar*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究对RAG系统中的文档排序和上下文大小效应进行了系统性可复现性研究，发现主题采样是方差的主要来源，并证明理想化实验设置中的结论不一定能迁移到现实世界的RAG流程中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior work on position-based effects (e.g., "lost in the middle") in RAG systems shows inconsistent and hard-to-reproduce findings across models, datasets, and evaluation protocols.

Method: Controlled reproducibility study: (1) repeated subset sampling across multiple topic budgets for calibration; (2) fixed topic sets for reproducing position sensitivity results; (3) realistic RAG evaluation with retriever-mediated relevance vs oracle access; (4) analysis of retrieval order and context size effects under imperfect retrieval conditions.

Result: Topic sampling is a major source of variance; small topic sets can mask or exaggerate ordering effects. Conclusions from idealised setups do not always transfer to real-world RAG pipelines. Both retrieval order and context size interact strongly with retrieval quality and model choice.

Conclusion: Released code and configurations for reproducibility and future robust RAG evaluation work.

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems rely on retrieved documents being concatenated into a model's input context, making both document ordering and context size critical yet controversial design choices. Prior work reports position-based effects such as lost in the middle and related long-context phenomena. However, empirical findings remain inconsistent and hard to reproduce across models, datasets, and evaluation protocols. In this paper, we present a systematic reproducibility study that revisits these claims and examines how they evolve with contemporary LLMs under a controlled evaluation framework. We first show that topic sampling is a major source of variance: small topic sets can mask or exaggerate ordering effects. Based on repeated subset sampling across multiple topic budgets, we provide a practical calibration procedure that identifies topic counts yielding stable trends at feasible cost. Using these fixed topic sets, we then reproduce and extend results on position sensitivity, re-evaluating lost in the middle and positional biases in modern LLMs. Then, we also study a more realistic RAG scenario in which relevance is mediated by a retriever rather than oracle access to ground-truth documents. In this setting, we re-examine a recent industry study and identify discrepancies to evaluation choices such as limited topic coverage and reliance on LLM-based judges. Finally, we conduct an analysis of how retrieval order and context size affect downstream LLM performance under imperfect retrieval. Our results demonstrate that both factors interact strongly with retrieval quality and model choice, and that conclusions drawn from idealised setups do not always transfer to real-world RAG pipelines. We release all code and configurations to support reproducibility and future work on robust RAG evaluation.

</details>


### [123] [Rethinking Agentic RAG: Toward LLM-Driven Logical Retrieval Beyond Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27123)
*Yuqi Zeng,Qixiang Deng,Yulei Wan,Ruiquan Jiang,Xiaoqing Zheng,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究提出将控制权更多委托给LLM来主导检索过程，采用轻量级倒排索引后端替代复杂检索架构的Agentic RAG框架，实现成本降低和幻觉减少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前RAG系统过度关注检索后端工程（如稠密检索、混合检索、图检索等复杂架构），而忽视了让LLM主导检索过程的重要性。作者认为应该将更多控制权交给LLM，同时使用提供细粒度控制的轻量级检索接口。

Method: 提出AgentChain框架，让LLM通过逻辑表达式表达检索意图，后端采用轻量级的倒排索引系统。LLM能够多轮交互地迭代优化查询，根据中间结果调整检索策略。

Result: 实验表明该框架在性能上与强大的Agentic混合检索基线相当，同时大幅降低了构建和服务成本。此外，基于逻辑查询锚定检索过程显著减少了生成响应中的幻觉问题。

Conclusion: 该框架通过将检索控制权交给LLM，同时简化后端架构，实现了性能与效率的良好平衡。这一研究为Agentic RAG系统设计提供了新思路，强调简洁的检索接口配合智能的查询控制可能比复杂的检索后端更为有效。

Abstract: Recent advances in RAG have shifted toward an agentic paradigm, where LLMs interact with retrieval systems over multiple turns and iteratively refine queries based on intermediate results. At the same time, LLMs have demonstrated a strong ability to construct structured queries that precisely express their information needs. However, contemporary RAG systems remain heavily focused on engineering complex retrieval backends, including dense, hybrid, and graph-based retrieval architectures. In this study, we argue that agentic RAG should delegate greater control to the LLM to steer the retrieval process, while relying on a lightweight retrieval interface that provides fine-grained control and faithfully executes the LLM's structured intent. Guided by this principle, we propose an agentic RAG framework that enables LLMs to formulate retrieval intents using logical expressions while simplifying the retrieval backend to an inverted-index-based system. Extensive experiments show that our framework matches a strong agentic hybrid baseline, while substantially reducing construction and serving cost. Moreover, we show that anchoring the retrieval process in logical queries substantially reduces hallucinations in generated responses.

</details>


<div id='cs.DC'></div>

# cs.DC [[Back]](#toc)

### [124] [Xe-Forge: Multi-Stage LLM-Powered Kernel Optimization for Intel GPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26118)
*Marcin Spoczynski,Daniel Fleischer,Moshe Berchansky,Gabriela Ben-Melech Stan,Shira Guskin,Weilin Xu,Adam Siemieniuk,Alexander Heinecke*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出 Xe-Forge：一个面向 Intel Xe GPU 的多阶段 LLM 自动化 Triton kernel 优化流水线。它在已功能正确的 Triton kernel 上，自动执行“分析 + 九大优化阶段”（算法重构、开放发现、dtype 修正、算子融合、访存优化、block pointer 现代化、persistent kernel、GPU 专属调优、autotuning），每个阶段由自研的 CoVeR（Chain-of-Verification-and-Refinement，DSPy 实现）代理驱动：生成候选→在真实硬件上按“语法/结构与硬件约束/正确性/性能”四级验证→依据具体错误反馈迭代精修；并以 YAML 知识库编码 LLM 训练数据中缺失的 Intel GPU 约束（warp 数为 2 的幂、GRF 模式、SLM 容量、GROUP_SIZE_M swizzle），由 LLM planner 在硬依赖约束下决定阶段顺序并跳过无问题阶段。在 Intel Arc Pro B70 上对 97 个 KernelBench Level-2 kernel 与 16 组 Flash Attention 配置评测：相对 PyTorch eager 几何均速 1.17×，67% kernel 提升，9 个 kernel 超 5×（最高 82×），Flash Attention 全配置 2–13.3× 且无回退，正确率 100%。核心论点是：面向特定硬件的 kernel 优化中，结构化领域知识 + 硬件在环验证的收益高于单纯扩大模型规模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将深度学习算法迁移到新加速器（如 Intel Arc/Arc Pro）时，开发者必须对代码库中每个 Triton kernel 重复执行同一套底层优化：量化、访存合并、tile 尺寸调优、架构特定 workaround。这些工作高度重复，且每个 kernel 都要经历“试错—剖析—修复”的循环，构成算法落地的主要瓶颈。

现有 LLM-based kernel 工作存在三个空白：(1) 几乎全部聚焦于“kernel 生成”（PyTorch→Triton 或自然语言→新 kernel），而非“对已有 kernel 做目标架构特化优化”；现实中大量组织维护的是功能正确但性能次优的 Triton 库，需要的是精修而非重写。(2) 目标硬件集中在 NVIDIA（少量 AMD），Intel GPU 完全空白。(3) Intel Xe 的关键约束——warp 数量、tile 尺寸、GRF 模式、SLM 容量与层级结构——既不在 LLM 训练语料中，也不被现有智能体的知识库覆盖，导致模型退回到 NVIDIA 中心化启发式（如 num_warps=8、128×128 tile）。此外，传统自动调优器（OpenTuner、Kernel Tuner、Ansor）只能搜索固定 kernel 结构内的数值参数，无法做算法重构、dtype 变更、算子融合或 block pointer/GRF 注解等架构化变换。

Method: 一、总体架构（分阶段流水线）
输入为功能正确的 Triton kernel。先经分析阶段（LLM 分析器输出带严重度 1–5、修复建议与预期加速区间的问题清单，固定分类法 30+ 类），随后由 LLM planner 在“硬依赖约束（语义作用域递减原则）”下决定阶段顺序：Algorithmic/Discovery → Dtype → Fusion；Memory access → Block pointers；Fusion/Block pointers → GPU-specific → Autotuning。planner 失败时回退默认序列 Algorithmic→Discovery→Dtype→Fusion→Memory→Block Pointers→Persistent→GPU-specific→Autotuning。问题类型通过固定路由表确定性映射到唯一阶段，无关联问题的阶段被跳过（降低 LLM 成本与代码震荡）；每阶段结束后重新调用分析器同步问题集（既可消解跨阶段问题，也可发现新引入的如寄存器压力问题）。支持 best-of-k 独立重跑整条流水线并按实测加速挑选最优候选（默认 k=1）。

二、CoVeR 代理
DSPy Module，参数为 signature（原始代码/当前代码/阶段/问题/知识模式/GPU 配置 → 优化后代码）、工具集（compile_and_verify）、成功哨兵字符串。维护增长式 key–value 轨迹（thoughts、工具调用、观测），每步将完整轨迹拼入 prompt。循环 T=5：LLM 产出 next_thought 与候选代码 → 送入所有工具 → 若返回成功哨兵立即返回；否则将结构化错误作为下一步上下文。若耗尽迭代，调用 ChainOfThought 抽取器做 best-effort 输出，并仍经四级验证，验证失败则返回原 kernel（保证流水线不降级已可用 kernel），失败样本连同阶段与时间戳落盘。轨迹超长时按“thought/工具名/参数/观测”四元组从最旧端截断，若仅剩一次调用仍超限则报错而非无诊断上下文运行。

三、四级验证级联
(1) 语法：ast.parse，失败返回行号、错误类型与出错源码行；(2) 结构与硬件约束：Triton/triton.language 导入、@triton.jit 装饰、Model 包装类存在，num_warps 必须为 2 的幂，block 维度为 2 的幂且 ≤256，违规给出可执行修复提示（如 “INVALID num_warps=24…”）；(3) 正确性：原始与优化 kernel 用同一权重（seeded 初始化 + state_dict 拷贝）同输入运行，torch.allclose（rtol=1e-2, atol=1e-5）比对，不匹配时给出可能原因（stride 错误、load 转置、缺边界检查）；(4) 性能：硬件事件计时（含 warmup、L2 cache flush、同步屏障），若变慢则回传两次时间、TFLOPS 与替代优化建议。仅“正确且更快”才返回成功哨兵——按严重度递进避免无效测量。

四、九大优化阶段
(1) Analysis（不改代码，仅产出问题清单）；(2) Algorithmic：利用矩阵对称性、公共子表达式消除、循环不变量外提、代数化简、树形归约替代串行累加等降低 FLOP 与访存；(3) Discovery：处理 open_ended 问题，要求给出变更内容、数学有效性论证、前后代码草图与加速估计（如把 sum(x@W.T, dim=1) 改写为 x@W.sum(dim=0) 以消除 O(MNK) GEMM、跨 forward 缓存权重统计）；(4) Dtype fix：消除 float64 浪费、去除多余精度、冗余输入转换（输入/输出 fp16/bf16、累加 fp32，在敏感边界插 cast）；(5) Fusion：合并独立 kernel 与 elementwise 链、归约与后续 pointwise 折叠、消除 noop，并处理寄存器压力超限与“融合替代厂商库调用”等子类；(6) Memory access：合并访问、边界掩码、prefetch、非连续输入、寄存器生命期与压力（重排 load/store）；(7) Block pointers：将手工指针算术改写为 tl.make_block_ptr，并修正 boundary_check 传布尔（应为整数元组）、tl.multiple_of 误用于标量等误用（shape/strides/order 错误会造成静默正确性失败）；(8) Persistent kernel：固定线程块数遍历全部 tile 以摊薄 launch 开销、支持跨 tile SLM 复用，并把硬编码 program 数改为按 EU 数运行时推导；(9) GPU-specific：Intel 专属调优（32 warps 达到峰值占用、large/small GRF 模式注解、shape-aware tile 尺寸、GROUP_SIZE_M swizzle、权重重排/转置缓存、tile 串行化、sigmoid 慢路径）；(10) Autotuning：基于硬件查询生成至多 12 个架构合法且按预期性能排序的配置网格。

五、知识库
YAML 组织为 constraints / patterns / full-code examples 三类共 84 条、6 个文件（gpu_optimizations、memory_patterns、fusion_patterns、persistent_kernel、correctness、dtype_optimizations）。constraints 编码硬规则（critical/info 分级 + 正误示例），如 boundary_check 必须是整数维度元组、autotune 参数不得在签名中重复声明默认值、启用 swizzle 时 launch grid 必须一维、batch 偏移需转 int64 防指针溢出、Stream-K 原子累加需预清零输出。patterns 为带目标阶段、理由、预期加速区间与适用性列表（gemm/compute_bound 等）的前后变换，其中 memory access 21 条、GPU 专属 20 条最多。examples/ 提供 9 组完整“未优化→已优化”kernel 对（GEMM+激活融合、转置矩阵乘 + block pointer 等），作 few-shot 演示。format_for_llm(stage) 按阶段选择性注入（critical 约束始终注入），加载器归一化阶段别名并跳过未知阶段标签；新增硬件目标只需新增 YAML，无需改代码。

六、GPU 硬件查询系统
主路径 torch.xpu.get_device_properties()，备路 xpu-smi JSON 解析；获取 EU 数、subslice/slice 数、最大 CU、work group 与 subgroup size、全局与 SLM 容量、FP16/BF16/FP64 支持标志，按 GPU 家族（Arc/Arc Pro/集显）选择默认 warp 数、GRF 模式与基础 tile。get_optimal_params() 做形状感知调优：tile 尺寸夹取为不超过对应维度的最大 2 的幂以免 padding 浪费线程；瘦长矩阵用非对称 tile（BLOCK_M 或 BLOCK_N 偏大）；估测 tile 内存 (BLOCK_M×BLOCK_K+BLOCK_K×BLOCK_N)×bytes 超过 GRF 容量（large 64KB / small 32KB）则缩减 BLOCK_K；GROUP_SIZE_M 在 tile 数 <16 时取 1，否则目标每 SM 约 4 组；warp 数与流水级数分别随 tile 与 K 维度伸缩。

七、AI Bench 验证基础设施
将执行、计时、正确性检查与优化逻辑解耦。harness core 定义 YAML 问题契约（inputs 块含符号维度/dtype/取值范围/10 种初始化变换如 scale、softmax、triu、rademacher；variants 块绑定具体维度并以安全 AST 求值器计算 FLOP 与字节公式；ci / bench-cpu / bench-gpu 三档）；runner 层提供 KernelRunner 与 KernelBenchRunner；testing 层提供统一 time(fn,args,device)。GPU 计时流程：warmup（GPU 默认 200 次，迭代间刷新 256MB L2 buffer）、预分配 torch.Event 对、测量循环（默认 100 次，每次先清 L2 cache，再用 1024³ dummy matmul 填充命令流使 CPU 有足够时间入队计时事件，最后统一同步），剔除极值后取均值；CPU 路径用 ProfilerActivity.CPU 同策略。指标含 TFLOPS 与内存带宽（FLOP/字节数可由 spec 声明或用 FlopCounterMode / MemoryCounter 估算，估算值加警告标记）。正确性检查跨后端统一播种、state_dict 拷贝（失败则按形状匹配的位置拷贝）、输入克隆防就地修改、no_grad 下前向，allclose 不匹配时输出最大/平均绝对差、最大相对差与超容元素计数比例，并检查 NaN/Inf。结果经 CSVLogger 落盘为每变体一行（含 TFLOPS、带宽、微秒耗时、维度 JSON、note），并自动捕获 AIBENCH_ 前缀环境变量列以追踪硬件配置。优化器仅通过两个接口消费它：KernelBenchExecutor.compare_kernels() 返回含两次计时、加速比、正确性标志与面向 CoVeR 的反馈信息的 ComparisonResult；spec loader 转换 YAML 为形状/FLOP/dtype。

八、Harness 隔离（对抗性优化防护）
Model(nn.Module) 包装、输入生成与执行路径由 KernelBench 规格与 AI Bench 固定，LLM 只能修改 @triton.jit 函数体与 autotune 配置，无法通过动态导入/字符串拼接（文中给出用 __import__('torch').nn.functional 与 ''.join(['fu','nctional']) 规避过滤的示例）把 kernel 偷换为 PyTorch 分派，从而消除“优化成功信号而非任务本身”的规避面。

九、实验配置
Intel Arc Pro B70（Battlemage，32 Xe2 核、256 XMX 引擎、32GB GDDR6、256-bit、608 GB/s）；Intel Triton GPU 后端经 SPIR-V，PyTorch 2 + torch.xpu；基线为 torch.compile(TorchInductor)；LLM 为 GPT-5.4（temperature 1.0，56k 上下文），DSPy 3.x，AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS=3，MAX_ATTEMPTS_PER_STAGE=5，k=1；初始 Triton kernel 由 KernelFalcon（KernelAgent）生成（其对 250 个 KernelBench 问题 100% 功能正确）。

Result: 1) KernelBench Level-2 共 97 个 kernel（GEMM 19、MatMul 17、BMM 1、Conv2D 21、Conv3D 12、ConvTranspose2D 10、ConvTranspose3D 17），对比 PyTorch eager、torch.compile、未优化 KernelFalcon Triton 三基线：相对 PyTorch eager 几何均速 1.17×，67% kernel 获得提升；9 个 kernel 超 5×（9×–82×，最大为 Matmul_Min_Subtract 的 82×）；GEMM/MatMul 相对最优基线几何均速分别 1.28× 与 1.76×。BMM 家族单例 BMM_InstanceNorm_Sum_ResidualAdd_Multiply 达 23×（torch.compile 仅 1.1×），源于把 post-BMM 归约+归一化链融合为单趟、消除中间张量物化。Conv2D 多数 1.0–2.2×（个别到 2.8×），kernel 44（ConvTranspose2d_Multiply_GlobalAvgPool_Mean）7.5×；Conv3D 带宽受限，0.9–1.3×；ConvTranspose3D 0.5–1.2×；少量卷积 kernel 出现 0.5–0.8× 的温和回退（回退来自 CoVeR fallback 返回原 kernel，而 KernelFalcon 起点本身不适配 Intel）。

2) 正确性 100%：所有 kernel 通过 rtol=1e-2/atol=1e-5 的 allclose 检查，回退均为“正确但较慢”，非正确性失败。

3) Roofline 分析（FP16 峰值 ~160 TFLOPS，带宽 608 GB/s）：GEMM/MatMul 处于计算受限（10²–10⁴ FLOP/Byte），三后端多数聚集在 60–160 TFLOPS；kernel 14/76/68/18/98 等“超峰值”点源于算法重构（如 GEMM+归约折叠为向量–矩阵乘）降低有效 FLOP 而原 FLOP 计数不变，故并非真实硬件吞吐超越。Conv2D 跨越带宽/计算过渡区（10¹–10³），低强度端贴带宽斜率；Conv3D 沿带宽斜率 3–90 TFLOPS；ConvTranspose3D 分布 10⁰–10³，低强度端各后端均远低于 roofline（launch 开销与不规则访问）。

4) Flash Attention（16 组 LLM serving 配置，覆盖 7B–70B 模型、S=2048–32768、非 2 的幂头数 A=71 与非标准头维 D=96、批量 B=2/4/8）：全部配置 2–13.3× 加速且无回退；S≥16384 达 9–13.3×，S=2048–4096 为 2–4.4×；roofline 上原 kernel 仅 5–15 TFLOPS（低于峰值 5–30×），优化后升至 40–90 TFLOPS，残留 1.5–3× 差距；S=32768 时朴素实现每头需约 4GB 分数矩阵（FP16），经 SLM 尺寸约束下的分块与 persistent 阶段改造后 32k 上下文在 32GB 设备上可行。

5) 成本：最坏情况每 kernel 约 40–50 次 LLM 调用（9 阶段×5 次 CoVeR 迭代 + 分析 + 重分析），典型 kernel 因跳阶段降至 10–20 次；按 API 价约 $0.50–2.00/kernel。

6) 失效模式归纳：(a) 训练数据中不存在的新型算法模式（自定义 attention 变体、稀疏算子、新激活）优化质量差；(b) 复杂多 kernel 交互（Level-3 架构中一个 kernel 的优化改变下游 kernel 期望的内存布局）当前 per-kernel 流水线无法跨 kernel 推理；(c) 编译器级失败（某些在 NVIDIA 合法的 Triton 构造如特定 tl.atomic 变体、tl.reduce 分解在 SPIR-V lowering 时失败）在 T=5 迭代预算内无法诊断 opaque 编译器错误。

Conclusion: 本文的核心主张是：面向特定硬件的 kernel 优化中，“结构化领域知识 + 硬件在环验证”的收益高于单纯扩大模型规模——LLM 已掌握 Triton 语法与通用优化原则，仅缺 Intel Xe 特有约束；用数百行 YAML 知识库补齐该缺口（32 warps、large GRF、SLM 容量、swizzle 条件）比在 Intel 专用 kernel 语料上微调更经济。

主要贡献：(1) 提出“Triton-to-Triton 优化”形式化，与既有 PyTorch-to-Triton 生成互补，在保留原语义前提下做架构特化；(2) 首个面向 Intel GPU 的 LLM kernel 优化系统，附硬件感知知识库；(3) 多阶段 CoVeR 流水线，把优化分解为有依赖约束与独立验证标准的子问题；(4) AI Bench 测量框架，将执行/计时/正确性与优化逻辑解耦，支持 PyTorch、torch.compile、Triton 等后端与 YAML 问题契约；(5) kernel harness 隔离，从架构上消除“模型绕过 benchmark 走捷径”的对抗性优化面。

局限与后续：(1) 近期最有价值的方向是降低回退率——引入逐阶段的 pre/post 性能比较与回滚机制；(2) 扩展知识库与 planner 至更多 Intel 架构、Xe 世代与非 Intel 目标以检验阶段分解的通用性，估算移植新 Triton 后端约需 2–3 天工程量（主要花在 pattern 撰写上）；(3) 从优化历史中学习，把成功变换作为未来 kernel 的 few-shot 示例，提升首轮成功率并降低 LLM 成本；(4) 引入跨算子边界的多 kernel/模型图级优化；(5) 引入 SOL-ExecBench 式硬件在环（speed-of-light）指标替代单纯相对软件基线的加速比；(6) 以蒸馏小模型承载流水线决策以压缩每 kernel 成本。

Abstract: Porting deep learning algorithms to new hardware accelerators requires developers to repeatedly apply the same low-level optimizations -- quantization, memory access coalescing, tile size tuning, and architecture-specific workarounds -- to every Triton kernel in their code-base. This manual, repetitive effort is a major bottleneck: each kernel demands the same cycle of trial-and-error profiling against hardware constraints that vary across devices, yet the underlying optimization patterns remain largely consistent. We present Xe-Forge, a multi-stage LLM-powered pipeline that automates this process for Intel GPU. Given a functionally correct Triton kernel, the system applies up to nine optimization stages -- from algorithmic restructuring and operator fusion through block pointer modernization, GPU-specific tuning, and open-ended discovery -- each driven by a Chain-of-Verification-and-Refinement (CoVeR) agent that generates candidates, validates them on real hardware, and iterates on failures. A curated knowledge base encodes Intel GPU constraints (power-of-two warp counts, GRF modes, SLM sizing) that are absent from LLM training data, keeping the model within architecturally valid bounds. We evaluate Xe-Forge on 97 Level-2 KernelBench kernels and Flash Attention on the Intel Arc Pro B70, achieving a 1.17x geometric mean speedup over PyTorch eager with 67% of kernels improving, nine kernels exceeding 5x (up to 82x), and 2--13.3x speedups on Flash Attention across all tested configurations without regression -- demonstrating that structured domain knowledge with hardware-in-the-loop verification can systematically eliminate the repetitive porting effort that currently gates algorithm deployment on new accelerators.

</details>


### [125] [Edge AI Deployment Beyond Models: A BSP-Aware Systems Framework for Industrial Embedded Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26119)
*Pitchai Muthu M*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 论文论证了工业Edge AI部署应被视为系统问题而非后期应用打包练习，并提出了基于五层架构（BSP感知）的工业嵌入式平台部署框架，连接底层平台工作与可测量部署结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前工业Edge AI项目往往先开发模型，后期才考虑平台部署。这种顺序虽便于早期演示，但在面对嵌入式系统的长生命周期、厂商特定内核、异构加速器、安全约束和复杂I/O路径等挑战时失效。此时，模型只是执行链的一个组件，需从传感器经板级支持包(BSP)到生产服务环。

Method: 提出了一个BSP感知的五层框架：(1)硬件层；(2)BSP/操作系统适配层；(3)运行时与加速层；(4)应用/推理层；(5)运维/验证层。该框架基于Android、NXP i.MX、NVIDIA Jetson、ONNX Runtime和TensorRT等厂商架构文档，以及嵌入式AI基准测试、设备不稳定性和异构边缘集群的相关文献。

Result: 提出了一个实用的五层框架，将底层平台工作与可量化的部署结果相连接，涵盖可重复性、可诊断性、持续吞吐量和现场可靠性等关键指标。

Conclusion: 该框架为工业嵌入式平台上的Edge AI部署提供了系统性指导，将底层平台工作与可量化的部署结果（可重复性、可诊断性、持续吞吐量和现场可靠性）联系起来，对工业AI落地具有重要实践意义。

Abstract: Industrial Edge AI programs often begin with the model and only later confront the platform. That sequencing is attractive because it allows early demonstrations, but it breaks down when the deployment target is an embedded system with long product lifecycles, vendor-specific kernels, heterogeneous accelerators, safety constraints, and nontrivial I/O paths. In that environment, a model is only one component of a larger execution chain that begins at the sensor, traverses the board support package (BSP), and ends in a production service loop. This paper argues that robust Edge AI deployment must be treated as a systems problem rather than a late-stage application packaging exercise. The paper presents a BSP-aware framework for industrial embedded platforms organized around five layers: hardware, BSP/operating-system adaptation, runtime and acceleration, application/inference, and operations/validation. The discussion is grounded in vendor architecture documentation for Android, NXP i.MX, NVIDIA Jetson, ONNX Runtime, and TensorRT, and in systems literature on embedded AI benchmarking, device instability, and heterogeneous edge fleets. The result is a practical framework that connects low-level platform work to measurable deployment outcomes such as reproducibility, diagnosability, sustained throughput, and field reliability.

</details>


### [126] [Semantic-aware Token Selection and Resource Optimization for Communication-efficient Split Federated Fine-tuning in Edge Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26120)
*Xianke Qiang,Zheng Chang,Geyong Min*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: ST-SFLora是一种基于语义标记的分割联邦LoRA微调框架，通过语义传输效率(STE)指标和联合资源优化算法，在降低边缘设备计算负担的同时保持模型性能，解决了大规模视觉Transformer在边缘设备部署的通信效率问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型Transformer视觉模型在资源受限的移动边缘设备上部署面临硬件限制和动态无线环境的双重约束；传统联邦学习仅本地微调计算量过大，而现有分割联邦学习(SFL)传输高维激活令牌导致严重的通信开销。

Method: 提出ST-SFLora框架，基于语义传输效率(STE)指标进行令牌选择，并采用交替算法求解混合整数非凸优化问题，联合优化令牌选择、上行带宽分配和传输功率。

Result: 实验结果表明，ST-SFLora在多个基准测试中实现了最低的客户端资源消耗，同时在通信效率和模型性能之间取得了良好的权衡。

Conclusion: ST-SFLora通过语义标记选择机制和资源优化算法，在保持模型性能的同时显著降低了边缘设备的计算负担，为大规模视觉模型在边缘设备上的高效部署提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Deploying large Transformer-based vision models on resource-limited mobile devices at network edge is severely constrained by hardware limitations and dynamic wireless environments. While federated learning (FL) enables collaborative training without sharing raw data, strictly local fine-tuning of such massive models remains computationally prohibitive for edge devices. Split federated learning (SFL) alleviates this burden by offloading deep layers to the edge server, yet it suffers from heavy communication overhead when transmitting high-dimensional activation tokens. To address this bottleneck, we propose ST-SFLora, a semantic token-based split federated LoRA fine-tuning framework. We introduce a new metric, \emph{Semantic Transmission Efficiency} (STE), to balance semantic retention and transmission cost. Based on STE, we formulate a joint resource optimization problem that dynamically determines token selection, uplink bandwidth allocation, and transmit power under latency and energy constraints. The resulting mixed-integer nonconvex problem is efficiently solved via an alternating algorithm. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ST-SFLora achieves the lowest client-side resource consumption among baselines while delivering a favorable trade-off between communication efficiency and model performance.

</details>


### [127] [Agentic AI Workload Characteristics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26297)
*Yichao Yuan,Ankita Nayak,Souvik Kundu,Nishil Talati*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文对 ReAct 式智能体（Claude Code）在 vLLM 上的端到端服务负载做了系统性刻画：在 5 个智能体基准 × 4 种模型配置（Qwen3.6-27B / Gemma4-31B，各含 Thinking 与 Instant 模式）共 20 种组合下，通过自建追踪基础设施把智能体轨迹、vLLM 请求级服务追踪（prefill/decode）与工具级行为关联起来。核心结论是：智能体负载不是"长提示词负载"——在有效前缀缓存下 84.6–99.5% 的输入 token 跨轮复用，执行呈 decode 主导（decode 占 LLM 时间 91.0–98.6%），真正的瓶颈是长生命周期的 KV 缓存状态能否跨轮保留；同时负载具有双重长尾（轮数长尾与上下文长尾），失败驱动的工具重试会同时放大模型重入次数与缓存占用；工具使用存在明确时间结构（早期读/探索 → 后期执行/写入），且"最耗时"与"最易失败"是不同工具集合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作多从智能体能力、进展指标、行为或 CPU 侧执行开销切入，缺少一个系统层面的统一回答：模型服务、上下文增长、工具延迟与失败驱动的重试是如何交互并决定端到端智能体执行效率瓶颈的。传统 LLM 服务优化（长提示 prefill、批处理）默认请求彼此独立，而智能体是带状态的多轮闭环执行：每轮都要重新进入模型、拼接新上下文、维护 KV 缓存状态。若不区分"独立长提示请求"与"增长缓存上的重复模型重入"，就会误判智能体负载的服务特征与优化方向。此外，工具调用并非单一系统类别，其延迟、返回观测大小、失败率与随任务演进的意图变化都直接决定成本。因此需要一套统一的端到端追踪基础设施，把智能体行为、上下文状态演化与服务侧性能在同一时间轴上对齐刻画。

Method: 构建统一追踪基础设施：以 Claude Code 为智能体框架、Harbor 负责任务环境搭建与评测，vLLM v0.20.0（官方 Docker 镜像，TP=2）提供推理服务并开启 OpenTelemetry，Jaeger 收集逐请求 prefill/decode 时序；自研"请求网关"包含转发代理（记录请求元数据并注入 OTEL 标签）与 per-agent 包装器（按 agent 执行分配唯一 API key，实现请求序列重建），将高层智能体轨迹与底层服务指标、工具动作时序、Harbor 执行结果关联。硬件为 2×H100 NVL（NVLink）+ Intel Xeon Platinum 8592+。对象为 ReAct 式智能体：Qwen3.6-27B 与 Gemma4-31B，各含 Thinking 与 Instant（chat template 开关控制）两种模式；基准为 ADE-Bench、DABStep、GAIA、SWE-bench Pro、Terminal-Bench 2.0（DABStep 与 SWE-bench Pro 各随机采样 100 任务），共 20 组配置。形式化定义上下文演化 H_{a,i+1}=H_{a,i}‖Φ(θ,m,u)‖o 与生成三元组 z=(thinking, message, tool-call tokens)，定义 agent turn 为一次工具调用及其结果。分析维度包括：轮数分布、累积上下文长度、输出 token 组成、成功/失败对比、LLM 与工具时间分解、缓存命中（理论/实测）与 append/output 增量比、prefill/decode 分解、并发升高引发的 context thrashing（命中率、生成吞吐、prefill 时间）、工具类型/命令构成/最耗时与最高失败率工具、以及按执行进度四分位的工具意图迁移（Read/Explore vs Execute/Write）。另用 GPT-5.5 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0 与 SWE-bench Pro 上验证失败运行 token 更高的趋势。

Result: (1) 执行行为：多数配置平均 12–62 轮，但长尾显著（Gemma Instant 在 ADE 达 786 轮、DABStep 640、GAIA 617、Terminal Bench 470；ADE 上 Gemma Thinking 平均 18.0±15.3 轮 vs Instant 108.8±178.7 轮），其成因是 Edit 失败循环（2757 次编辑尝试、95.4% 失败率）而非有效长任务；推理模式并不必然增加成本。(2) 上下文：SWE-bench Pro 最重（均值 68.7–80.1K，最大 146–166K），Qwen 在 Terminal Bench 63.5–65.1K、GAIA 52.5–54.5K；轮数与上下文长度是两个不同现象，分别压向调度频率与 KV 缓存占用。(3) 输出组成：Gemma Thinking 45.8–67.6% 为 thinking token，Qwen Thinking 29.0–40.7%；Instant 变体输出几乎全为消息+工具调用，Gemma Instant 工具调用占 87.8–98.2%，说明生成主体是结构化动作而非自然语言。(4) 失败放大负载：失败运行平均上下文最高可达成功运行的 1.8 倍（GAIA 上 Gemma-T 34.6→40.6K、Qwen-I 44.9→62.4K；Terminal Bench Qwen 失败 79.2/76.6K vs 成功 44.4/45.9K），但 SWE-bench Pro 与 Gemma Instant 说明大上下文不必然等于失败。(5) 服务性能：LLM 占端到端时间 71–98%（DABStep 96–98%），工具占 2–29%（GAIA 最高 28.7%/24.9%，SWE-bench Pro 17.7%、Terminal Bench 17.6%）；理论缓存命中 87.9–99.3%、实测 84.6–99.5%，输入/输出比高达 53.9×–559.8× 而 append/output 仅 1.5×–7.3×，故 decode 占 LLM 时间 91.0–98.6%、prefill 仅 1.4–9.0%。(6) 缓存抖动：并发从 15 升至 25（Terminal-Bench）时命中率 98.85%→16.78%、生成吞吐 30.08→10.30 tok/s/req（最多降 66%）、prefill 0.51→3.46s；DABStep 并发 5→15 时命中率 98.53%→25.17%、吞吐 34.13→14.82 tok/s/req。(7) 工具画像：ADE 以 Read(29.8–41.7%)/Bash(23.2–30.0%) 为主（Gemma Instant Edit 占 51.2%），DABStep/Terminal 以 Bash 为主（50.5–87.8% / 53.2–79.5%），GAIA 以 WebFetch/WebSearch 为主（WebFetch 29.4–42.3%）；Bash 内部命令随域变化（ADE dbt 24.7–50.9%、DABStep grep 54.7% / python3 37.2–38.5%、GAIA curl ~25%）。最耗时工具是 Agent 与 TaskOutput（GAIA 上 Agent 均值 321.6s/916.0s，TaskOutput 最高 396.5s 且单次返回 3872 token），最易失败工具则是 Bash/Edit/Read（ADE Edit 95.4%、SWE-bench Pro Edit 77.8%、Bash 39.8%、GAIA Read 48.9%）。(8) 时间结构：多数负载在执行进度上从早期 Read/Explore（首四分位约 0.6–0.8）转向后期 Execute/Write（末四分位 0.8–1.0），GAIA 是主要例外（维持约 40–60 平衡）。(9) 趋势在更大模型上依然成立：GPT-5.5 失败运行 token 比成功高 27.5%（Terminal-Bench）与 20.2%（SWE-bench Pro）。

Conclusion: 智能体服务不能被建模为一串独立的长提示请求，而应视为"在持续增长的缓存上下文上的重复 decode"。高效智能体服务必须联合优化四件事：重复的模型重入（调度与批处理）、跨轮保留的长生命周期 KV/前缀缓存状态（涉及缓存保留、调度、offload 或重算的权衡）、随负载变化的工作量相关工具行为（区分轻量文件检查、shell 执行、web 检索与子智能体委派）、以及失败恢复机制（失败工具调用会追加错误观测并放大轮数与缓存占用，应被显式纳入负载画像）。缓存抖动是该理想 decode 主导假设在实际部署中的主要威胁：并发多智能体、长多轮上下文会超出 GPU 显存，使命中率骤降并使生成吞吐下降最多 66%，系统必须在重算与分层 offload 之间取舍。作者亦指明局限：仅覆盖 ReAct 式（含一层有界子智能体委派）与中等规模开源权重模型，投机/重叠工具执行、动态上下文压缩与摘要、分支/树搜索等高级编排未纳入，未来需在更大模型与更复杂编排下扩展刻画。

Abstract: Agentic AI shifts LLM serving from isolated prompt-generation requests to stateful, multi-turn executions that repeatedly invoke the model, call tools, and grow context over time. This paper characterizes ReAct-style agents from both the LLM-serving and tool-execution perspectives using an end-to-end tracing infrastructure across reasoning and non-reasoning Gemma and Qwen configurations on five agentic benchmarks. Our study shows that agentic workloads are not simply long-prompt workloads: with effective context caching, most input tokens are reused across turns, making execution decode-dominated while increasing dependence on long-lived KV-cache state. We also find that tool use has a clear temporal structure, with agents shifting from read/explore behavior early in execution to execute/write behavior later. These results show that efficient agentic serving must jointly manage repeated model re-entry, persistent context state, and workload-dependent tool behavior.

</details>


### [128] [Totoro$^+$: An Adaptive and Scalable Edge Federated Learning System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26323)
*Cheng-Wei Ching,Xin Chen,Taehwan Kim,Jian-Jhih Kuo,Dilma Da Silva,Liting Hu*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Totoro+ 是一个面向边缘网络的全去中心化联邦学习系统：它把传统的“单主/多从（single master/many workers）”参数服务器架构重构为基于 DHT 的 P2P 架构，为每个 FL 应用分配独立的数据流树（而非共享一个中心参数服务器），任意边缘节点都可充当任一应用的协调器、聚合器、客户端选择器或工作节点。其三项核心创新为：局部性感知的多环 P2P 结构、基于发布/订阅的“森林”抽象（含广告-发现树），以及带 ε-近似纳什均衡保证的博弈论路径规划模型。在 500 台 Amazon EC2 节点上，相比 OpenFL 与 FedScale，训练总时间加速 1.2×–14.0×，模型分发与梯度聚合在百万节点规模下保持 O(log N) 跳，并可有效适应带宽受限、链路不可靠与节点频繁抖动（churn）的边缘环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文面向“智能交通/自动驾驶”等典型边缘场景：数百万终端设备经由数十万边缘节点（服务器、网关、路由器，且分属不同管理方）接入云端，后台需同时运行海量异构 FL 应用（驾驶行为预测、交通流分析、异常检测等）。作者指出当前主流 FL 框架（Meta PAPAYA、LinkedIn FLINT、Google FL、IBM FL、Apple federated task 等）均为集中式或分层的“1 主/多从”架构，存在两大瓶颈：挑战一（可扩展性）——单一 Coordinator 串行调度导致排队延迟，多个应用共享参数服务器造成单点过载；多归属边缘站点缺乏全局负载视图，无法均衡任务，且固定 FL 策略无法按应用定制。挑战二（适应性）——边缘链路时延不可预测、带宽受限、节点频繁失效/掉线、计算存储资源紧张且无背压，静态划分参数服务器（如一机架一服务器）无法快速自适应，straggler 与链路失效只能靠资源冗余或链路复制来掩盖。此外，现有的去中心化 FL（P2PFL）工作多聚焦于聚合算法设计，缺乏任务管理、应用定制、故障恢复等跨层系统支撑。

Method: 系统分为三层。（1）局部性感知 P2P 多环结构：基于 Pastry 实现 DHT 覆盖网络（128-bit NodeId，路由表/叶集/邻域集），将单环按 RTT diameter 用 Ratnasamy & Shenker 分布式分箱划分为 m 个“边缘区”环；NodeId 改为 (m+n) 位（前缀为 zone Id、后缀为区内 NodeId），并设计边界感知的两级路由表，使不同站点的数据路径收敛于站内节点，管理员可据此实现管理域隔离与隐私保护。（2）发布/订阅森林抽象：每个 FL 应用以 AppId=hash(名称、创建者公钥、随机盐)（SHA-1）为键，经 JOIN 消息在 DHT 上汇聚到 NodeId 数值最接近 AppId 的会合节点作为根，形成动态结构数据流树；根即 master（发布者），内部节点承担 coordinator/aggregator/client selector，叶子节点为 worker（订阅者），逐层完成模型广播与梯度聚合（聚合函数可由应用自定义，如 FedAvg/FedProx）。各应用树之外再构建一棵“广告-发现（AD）树”，实现应用发布、发现与加入/退出。故障恢复：worker 失效由子节点发 JOIN 消息重建；master 失效则每轮将训练状态复制到邻域集 k=2 个节点，新 master 取回复本继续训练。（3）高层 API：抽象 Join/CreateTree/Subscribe/Unsubscribe/Broadcast/Aggregate/onTimer 等接口，支持应用级定制（差分隐私、安全聚合、同态加密、客户端选择、同步/半同步/异步更新、跨区多环 m×O(log N) 路由）。路径规划建模为带 bandit 反馈的广义和拥堵博弈：奖励 r_n(p)=r^{p_n}(n^{p_n}(p), θ_{p_n}) 显式依赖同路径上其他节点数量（带宽共享导致速率下降）；算法每 episode 采样 τ 个包，用策略相关矩阵 M(λ) 取行列式最小者为探索策略 ρ（保证无零元素），用线性回归估计势函数梯度，再以 Frank-Wolfe 更新线性组合并混入探索项。理论上 Nash-Regret(T) ≤ Õ(N²T^{5/6} log N)（k≥2/N），推出 ε-近似纳什均衡，异步情形下仅增加次线性遗憾项；每 episode 时间复杂度 O(τ log³N + |Δ(P_n)| log³N)。实现基于 Pastry v2.1 + Scribe（Java）与 PyTorch（Python 封装），另提出“逻辑 P2P 节点”机制按物理资源（CPU/内存/带宽/GPU）映射 1~16 个 NodeId 以适配异构节点。

Result: 在 500 台 Amazon EC2（t2.medium，每 JVM 模拟一个边缘节点，最大模拟 10 万节点）上，用澳大利亚 EUA 数据集（95,271 个基站、12 个州）划分地理分区，评测 CV/NLP 真实任务。(1) 可扩展性：500 棵树时 99.5% 节点担任不超过 3 棵树的 root/master，master 分布随负载自动伸缩，树在跨拓扑节点间分布均衡；节点数从 20 指数增至 5120 时，模型分发与梯度聚合时间仅线性增长（受树深 O(log N) 限制）。(2) 训练效率：Google Speech（ResNet-34）与 FEMNIST（ShuffleNet V2）上，5~20 个应用并行训练达到同等精度总耗时较 OpenFL/FedScale 加速 1.2×–14.0×（Speech 3.0×–14.0×，FEMNIST 1.2×–11.5×）；fanout=32 时训练 1/5/10/20 个模型总时长几乎相同（15.41→15.47 小时）。(3) 通信开销：树数增加 10× 时每节点流量仅增 1.19×(TCP)/1.29×(UDP)，因新建树仅沿覆盖层路由 JOIN 消息、可摊销到既有 overlay 链路。(4) 适应性：相较只看链路质量、忽略带宽容量的 bandit 版 Totoro，博弈论版本在墨尔本 1000 节点（900 终端+100 服务器，带宽 20–100 Mbps）上累计包时延更低（多数响应 <2000 ms）、Nash 遗憾更接近最优并呈次线性、下一跳分布更均匀；单次运行时间稳定在约 50 ms，而 Totoro 因需逐跳凸优化随节点数增至约 1500 ms。(5) 容错：单树失败节点从 1 增至 128 时恢复时间线性增长（仅 O(log_{2^b}N) 节点参与）；多树 5% 节点同时失效时恢复时间保持稳定。附录还表明将 Totoro+ 的路由模型嵌入 ComDML/GossipFL 可缩短 time-to-accuracy，并验证了异构资源下逻辑 P2P 节点能把更多 master 与通信负载分配给高配节点。

Conclusion: Totoro+ 通过“用 DHT-P2P 模型取代集中式参数服务器”这一关键洞见，把 FL 系统架构从 1:n 分解为 m:n 的“许多 master/许多 worker”全去中心化形态，配合局部性感知多环、发布/订阅森林抽象与博弈论路径规划三大利器，在可扩展性（负载均衡、O(log N) 跳、应用发现）、FL 有效性（time-to-accuracy 大幅加速）与边缘适应性（带宽受限、链路不稳、节点抖动、故障恢复）三方面同时优于 OpenFL/FedScale 等现有系统，CPU/内存开销可忽略，具备部署到资源受限边缘节点与开放众包平台的潜力。相对会议版（EuroSys'24）新增了 AD 树、博弈论路径规划（替代 bandit 模型）与 master/worker 双侧故障恢复机制，并补充了 Nash 遗憾、受限异步与多组异构实验。遗留问题与未来工作包括：AD 树的对抗性安全（拟引入类似 CA 的 NodeId/AppId 证书）、多播扩展算法（Algorithm 2）的纳什遗憾上界未定、真实生产环境大规模部署验证，以及非 IID 数据与个性化等应用侧能力需进一步工程化。

Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is an emerging distributed machine learning (ML) technique that enables in-situ model training and inference on decentralized edge devices. We propose Totoro$^+$, a novel scalable FL system that enables massive FL applications to run simultaneously on edge networks. The key insight is to explore a distributed hash table (DHT)-based peer-to-peer (P2P) model to re-architect the centralized FL system design into a fully decentralized one. In contrast to previous studies where many FL applications shared one centralized parameter server, Totoro$^+$ assigns a dedicated parameter server to each application. Any edge node can act as any application's coordinator, aggregator, client selector, worker (participant device), or any combination of the above, thereby radically improving scalability and adaptivity. Totoro$^+$ introduces three innovations to realize its design: a locality-aware P2P multi-ring structure, a publish/subscribe-based forest abstraction, and a game-theoretic path planning model with a guarantee of an $ε$-approximate Nash equilibrium. Real-world experiments on 500 Amazon EC2 servers show that Totoro$^+$ scales gracefully with the number of FL applications and $N$ edge nodes speeds up the total training time by $1.2\times-14.0\times$, achieves $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$ hops for model dissemination and gradient aggregation with millions of nodes, and efficiently adapts to the practical edge networks and churns.

</details>


### [129] [GridPilot: Real-Time Grid-Responsive Control for AI Supercomputers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26384)
*Denisa-Andreea Constantinescu,David Atienza*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GridPilot achieves 97.2 ms grid-responsive GPU power control (6.9x faster than required), enabling MW-scale AI/HPC facilities to provide grid flexibility services with PUE-corrected meter-level accuracy.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Global data center electricity demand is outpacing grid capacity, while grid operators increasingly require large flexible loads to absorb variable renewable generation. The core challenge is quantifying and achieving practical, measurable response times for multi-megawatt AI/HPC facilities to provide grid services.

Method: GridPilot employs a three-tier predictive controller (milliseconds, seconds, hours timescales) with deterministic safety-island bypass for rapid response. Tested on NVIDIA V100 GPU testbed with real hardware validation. Includes instantaneous PUE correction to maintain commitment accuracy at meter level.

Result: Measured end-to-end trigger-to-target response of 97.2 ms on real 3-GPU hardware, achieving 6.9x speedup over Nordic FFR requirement (700 ms). PUE-aware controller reduces cooling-overhead drag by 2.5-5.8 percentage points across six European grid scenarios (Sweden to Poland).

Conclusion: GridPilot provides a practical proof of concept that MW-scale AI/HPC facilities can be engineered as controllable, grid-responsive flexibility resources. The system is released as open source, enabling wider adoption and validation of demand-side grid support from computational facilities.

Abstract: At global scale, data-center electricity demand is growing faster than the grids that supply it, while system operators increasingly require large flexible loads that can adjust power within seconds to absorb variable wind and solar generation. For multi-megawatt AI/HPC facilities, the key unresolved question is practical and measurable: how quickly can the software stack translate a grid request into a real change in GPU power at the facility meter, where commitments are settled? We answer this on real hardware with GridPilot, a three-tier predictive controller operating across milliseconds, seconds, and hours, augmented by a deterministic safety-island bypass for fast response. On a three-GPU NVIDIA V100 testbed, GridPilot achieves a measured end-to-end trigger-to-target response of 97.2 ms, which is 6.9x faster than the 700 ms requirement of Nordic Fast Frequency Reserve. We further incorporate an instantaneous Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) correction so dispatched commitments remain robust at meter level rather than only at IT load level. In replay experiments across six representative European grids (from Sweden to Poland), the PUE-aware controller closes 2.5-5.8 percentage points of cooling-overhead drag. GridPilot is released as open source and serves as a proof of concept that MW-scale AI/HPC demand can be engineered as controllable, grid-responsive flexibility by design.

</details>


### [130] [Configuration-Driven Dynamic API Routing for Resilient Service Integrations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26404)
*Nataraj Agaram Sundar,Tejas Morabia*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文是 eBay 的工业经验报告，提出"配置驱动的动态 API 路由"：以可插拔因子列表（factor list）把第三方供应商选择从应用代码中抽离到运行时决策层，用硬性门控（区域、合规、配额、凭据、熔断状态）判定可用性，再用归一化加权评分（完成率、p95 延迟、成本、事件惩罚、样本置信度）排序，并结合业务结果遥测、滑动窗口指标、决策日志、流量切换上限、冷却、影子模式与熔断开关形成闭环控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代在线服务（登录/注册验证、支付、风控、通知、履约等）在关键用户旅程中依赖第三方 API，但这些依赖不受应用方直接控制，会出现区域性故障、限流、延迟尖峰、配额耗尽或行为变更，表现为用户可见失败。既有工业基线（多供应商 + 主备故障转移 + 超时/重试/熔断/舱壁/runbook）是必要的，但只解决部分问题：熔断状态是二值且本地的，舱壁只隔离资源不决定流量去向，静态主备无法适应部分退化、区域差异、配额耗尽与恢复过程，通用负载均衡也无法纳入业务完成率与合规约束。实践中，当供应商仅在特定区域/运营商/操作类型退化时，最优的流量迁移动作仍依赖事故期间的工程师判断、诊断与配置改动，导致延迟、决策不一致，且每次路由决策的原因未以结构化可查询形式留存，事后分析薄弱。因此需要把"供应商选择"当作受治理的运行时决策，而非静态优先级。

Method: 架构分四层：保护层（超时/重试/熔断/舱壁/回退）、决策层（选供应商）、遥测层（发布调用结果并计算滚动健康指标）、配置控制面（存因子列表与安全设置）。因子列表为按操作（operation）划分的配置对象：先 gates 后 scores。硬门控含 supports_region、compliance_allowed、quota_available、circuit_breaker_closed、metric_fresh_or_safe_default；评分项与权重示例为 completion_rate_5m 0.45、p95_latency_5m 0.20、cost_per_request 0.15、recent_incident_penalty 0.10、confidence_from_sample 0.10，安全项含 max_traffic_shift_per_minute 0.50、primary_probe_share 0.01、primary_recovery_cooldown_seconds 300、require_reason_code。原始指标先归一化为 0–100 索引，代表性策略 score(v)=0.40·completion+0.25·latency+0.15·cost+0.10·incident+0.10·confidence（权重由专家评审→影子模式→灰度→事后复盘调优，如 latency 权重 0.15→0.25、hysteresis 2.0→3.5）。请求时算法：应用→决策层请求→门控筛除→对合格者归一化加权评分→按分数与迟滞余量选择→调用供应商→发布业务事件（operation、provider、region、status、latency、error class、retry count、decision reason、policy version）→异步聚合器更新滚动窗口指标并缓存，请求路径不依赖分析管道。遥测区分 provider-call outcome 与 business-completion outcome（失败阶段标注：调用前/调用中/用户操作/下游逻辑/未知），用请求关联、错误分类、重试阶段分离 provider-attributable 失败。恢复侧使用半开熔断、探测流量（探针份额）、冷却窗口、渐进回切（failback）与限速。治理：因子列表版本化、影子模式并行评估不实际切流、灰度逐步放量、限流上限、kill switch、provider pinning、回滚；所有权划分（服务团队负责因子列表、SRE 负责默认安全控制、合规负责区域门控、运营负责人负责覆盖流程）。评估含合成回放：对比静态主用、传统运营故障转移、仅熔断、因子列表四种策略，6 个场景（完全宕机、延迟尖峰、部分退化、配额耗尽、区域故障、遥测过期），每场景每策略 36,000 合成请求，另做权重/限流/陈旧度敏感性分析。

Result: 去标识化运营证据（Table 11）：相对传统故障转移基线（T-30d，完成率指数 100.0、p95 380ms、重试 370、回退 112），稳定期自适应路由（T+10d）完成率指数升至 104.1、p95 降至 290ms（-23.7%）、重试降至 70（-81.1%）、回退降至 15（-86.6%），流量分布变为 A 68.5%/B 22.0%；退化期（T+14d_inc）将主供应商份额压至 15%、副供应商升至 75%，完成率指数仍维持 100.0。事件时间线（T-30m→T+30m）：检测退化→分数衰减→熔断打开并限速切流→探测发现恢复→半开→冷却后完成全量回切。影子模式记录显示在两次事故中影子推荐 provider_B 而基线仍路由到已退化的 provider_A。合成评估（Table 14）成功率/退化分钟：完全宕机 静态 66.3%/20min、传统 82.7%/10min、熔断 92.7%/4min、因子列表 96.0%/4min；配额耗尽 47.4%/32min、88.5%/7min、88.6%/7min、99.0%/0min；区域故障 90.1%/20min→97.9%/3min；遥测过期 94.0%/17min→98.4%/2min；延迟尖峰场景因子列表成功率略低（98.8%）但退化时长最短（2min）。敏感性分析显示策略对中等权重变化稳健，但对流量上限（scen_04 移出时间增至 12.0min）与遥测陈旧度（osc=3，移出 8.5min）敏感。

Conclusion: 多供应商冗余与常规故障转移本身不构成充分韧性，关键在于把"供应商选择"升级为受治理、可观测、可解释的运行时决策：硬门控表达不可协商约束（区域、合规、配额、凭据、熔断），评分仅在合格候选中表达偏好，业务结果遥测与决策日志（策略版本、门控结果、评分分量、reason code、指标新鲜度）同等重要，影子模式、流量上限、冷却、探测流量与 kill switch 是架构的组成部分而非事后附加。经验教训包括：尽早定义结果指标、把决策日志作为一等需求、在调权重前先厘清策略所有权、像测试故障转移一样测试恢复、明确指出不适合采用的负面场景、不要在可观测性不足时自动化；hysteresis、限流、探测与冷却属于正确性组成部分（防止反馈振荡）。可迁移性取决于操作关键性、是否存在真正合格的替代供应商、流量量级是否足以支撑滚动指标置信度、业务结果是否可埋点、以及组织对策略评审/事故覆盖/合规门控的治理成熟度；低风险或低流量场景更适合超时+重试+熔断+看板+静态优先级+演练 runbook。支付授权、风控、通知与履税等场景迁移需额外引入幂等、对账、审计证据、模型治理与合规门控。局限在于证据为去标识化代表性片段与确定性合成回放，不等同于受控生产实验，完成率并非因果估计；运营风险包括陈旧指标决策、熔断抖动、成本飙升与不稳定流量迁移。作者声明该文基于 eBay 许可授权的匿名化工业经验，论文准备过程中使用了 ChatGPT 辅助评审。

Abstract: Modern online services rely on third-party APIs for authentication, payments, communication, identity verification, fraud detection, observability, and fulfillment. These dependencies are outside the direct operational control of the application owner and may experience regional outages, throttling, latency spikes, quota exhaustion, or behavior changes that surface as user-visible failures. This paper presents configuration-driven dynamic API routing, an architecture for resilient third-party service integration based on pluggable factor lists, real-time telemetry, circuit breakers, bulkhead isolation, and a closed-loop decision engine. A factor list defines operation-specific hard gates and weighted scoring functions that evaluate candidate providers using live metrics, regional policy constraints, quota state, latency, cost, and incident signals. The router separates routing policy from application code, allowing operators to adapt vendor selection at runtime without redeploying applications. We formalize the factor-list model, describe a request-time routing algorithm, present the event pipeline that computes sliding-window provider health metrics, and analyze failover behavior under degraded-provider scenarios. We also describe an anonymized SMS verification case study in which manual vendor switching was replaced by automated routing driven by completion-rate telemetry.

</details>


### [131] [Characterization-Guided GPU Fault Resilience in NVIDIA MPS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26461)
*Rixin Liu,Xingqi Cui,Kaijian Wang,Xinheng Ding,Zirui Liu,Yuke Wang,Jiarong Xing*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对NVIDIA MPS故障韧性弱的问题，通过系统分析GPU故障特征和端到端处理流程，提出了两种互补机制：软件可隔离故障的隔离机制和专有软件故障的快速恢复机制，实现了容错MPS，在保持GPU共享效率的同时保障了故障隔离能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NVIDIA MPS通过允许多进程并发执行于同一GPU实现细粒度GPU共享，可提高GPU利用率。然而MPS存在故障韧性不足的问题：一个进程的故障会导致所有共运行进程终止，限制了其在对弹性要求严格的场景（如多租户GPU集群）中的应用。

Method: 提出两种互补机制：1) 针对主要内存相关故障，设计了可在开源GPU驱动内核模块中通过软件干预完全隔离的故障隔离机制；2) 针对存在于专有软件中的其他故障，设计了基于虚拟内存的GPU驻留状态共享的快速恢复机制。

Result: 实验评估表明，所设计的两种机制能有效处理相应类型的GPU故障，且开销极小。

Conclusion: 设计的故障隔离机制和快速恢复机制能够有效处理相应故障，且开销极小。该方案已在不同GPU和 workloads 上完成评估，展示了在实际部署中的可行性和实用性。

Abstract: NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS) enables fine-grained GPU sharing by allowing multiple processes to execute concurrently on the same GPU, making it an important mechanism for improving GPU utilization. However, MPS has weak fault resilience: a fault in one process can terminate all co-running processes, limiting its adoption in resilience-critical settings such as multi-tenant GPU clusters. In this work, we design fault-resilient MPS to solve this problem. Our design is guided by insights from a systematic characterization of GPU faults and a deep analysis of their end-to-end processing pipeline. Based on these insights, we design two complementary mechanisms. A fault isolation mechanism for the dominant memory-related faults that can be fully isolated by software intervention in the open GPU driver kernel module. For other faults whose process is within proprietary software, we design a practical mechanism -- fast recovery using virtual memory based GPU-resident state sharing. Our evaluation on different GPUs and workloads shows that these mechanisms can handle corresponding faults effectively with minimal overhead.

</details>


### [132] [StreamSplit: Continuous Audio Representation Learning via Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26523)
*Minh K. Quan,Pubudu N. Pathirana*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: StreamSplit解决边缘设备上大规模对比学习(CL)的资源限制冲突，通过分布流式框架和强化学习自适应分割器，在Raspberry Pi 4到Apple M2等异构ARM平台上实现4.7倍延迟降低、77.1%带宽节省和52.3%能耗降低，同时保持精度损失在2.2%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模对比学习（CL）的基础要求与边缘设备资源波动性根本矛盾：本地小批次会降低模型保真度，云端卸载又带来不可接受的延迟和带宽成本。现有静态模型压缩方案无法适应边缘环境运行时波动。

Method: 提出两大创新：(1) 基于分布的流式框架，使用可处理的混合损失函数解耦表征质量与本地批次大小；(2) 不确定性引导的自适应分割器，采用轻量级强化学习策略整合实时资源监控与嵌入不确定性，动态优化精度-延迟权衡。

Result: 在Raspberry Pi 4到Apple M2等多样化硬件上，StreamSplit相比服务器中心基线实现：单样本延迟降低4.7倍、带宽减少77.1%、能耗降低52.3%，精度损失控制在2.2%以内。

Conclusion: 自适应分布式学习是现代边缘生态系统的可行路径，证明流式CL可在异构ARM客户端平台上实际部署。

Abstract: Large-batch Contrastive Learning (CL), the foundation of modern representation learning, is fundamentally incompatible with the volatile resource constraints of edge devices. This conflict creates a dilemma: small on-device batches degrade model fidelity, while offloading to the cloud incurs unacceptable latency and bandwidth costs. Existing solutions often resort to static model compression, which fails to adapt to the runtime volatility of edge environments. To bridge this gap, we present StreamSplit, a novel framework that makes streaming CL practical across heterogeneous ARM client platforms. StreamSplit resolves the conflict between the continuous nature of ambient audio and the discrete batch requirements of models like CLAP and COLA. We introduce: (1) A distribution-based streaming framework that decouples representation quality from local batch size, using a tractable Hybrid Loss to maintain fidelity despite sparse updates; and (2) An Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitter that uses a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy to dynamically partition computation. Uniquely, this policy integrates real-time resource monitoring with embedding ambiguity to optimize the accuracy-latency trade-off on the fly. We evaluate StreamSplit on diverse hardware, from the resource-constrained Raspberry Pi 4 to the high-performance Apple M2. Results demonstrate that StreamSplit reduces per-sample latency by up to 4.7x and cuts bandwidth by 77.1% and energy by 52.3% compared to server-centric baselines. Crucially, it maintains accuracy within 2.2% of server-centric models, proving that adaptive, distributed learning is a viable path for the modern edge ecosystem.

</details>


### [133] [A Formal Semantics of C with OpenMP Parallelism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26527)
*Ke Du,Anshu Sharma,Liyi Li,William Mansky*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: This paper presents a formal semantics for C code with OpenMP directives, built on CompCert's verified compiler, to detect errors introduced by incorrect OpenMP pragmas and guarantee data race freedom.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OpenMP pragmas can easily introduce logic errors and race conditions into otherwise correct programs, and existing OpenMP semantics have obscured subtle interactions between directives and variable state.

Method: Built on the C semantics of the CompCert verified compiler and its extension to concurrency to create a formal semantics capturing subtle interactions between OpenMP directives and variable state.

Result: A formal semantics that captures subtle interactions previously obscured, providing a foundation for detecting both logic errors and race conditions introduced by incorrect OpenMP annotations.

Conclusion: Provides a basis for detecting undesired behaviors introduced by incorrect annotations, guaranteeing successful executions are free of data races.

Abstract: OpenMP is a popular parallelization framework that lets users transform sequential code into parallel code with a few simple annotations. Unfortunately, it is also easy to inadvertently introduce errors by adding OpenMP pragmas into otherwise correct programs, including both logic errors and race conditions. We present a formal semantics for C code with OpenMP directives, building on the C semantics of the CompCert verified compiler and its extension to concurrency. Our semantics captures subtle interactions between OpenMP directives and variable state that have been obscured by previous OpenMP semantics, and provides a basis for detecting undesired behaviors introduced by incorrect annotations: in particular, any successful execution is guaranteed to be free of data races.

</details>


### [134] [Reducing Internal State in Eigenvalue-Only Divide-and-Conquer Tridiagonal Eigensolvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26599)
*Ruiyi Zhan,Shaoshuai Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对对称特征值分解中的Divide and Conquer算法内存瓶颈问题，提出边界行D&C算法。通过观察到征服阶段仅需边界行/列而非完整特征向量矩阵，递归传播边界行，将空间复杂度从O(n²)降至O(n)，同时减少计算量。该方法兼具理论保证（正确性/稳定性证明）和实用价值（优化CPU/GPU实现），在性能和内存效率上优于现有QR和D&C方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Divide and Conquer算法在对称特征值分解中存在一个问题：征服阶段需要实例化或重放大型变换矩阵（即完整的特征向量矩阵），导致内存占用高且计算冗余。虽然D&C天然具有并行性，在现代多核CPU和GPU上很有吸引力，但现有特征值专用例程仍倾向于使用QR方法。

Method: 提出边界行D&C（Boundary-row Divide and Conquer）算法。核心创新在于：征服阶段仅需矩阵边界行/列而非完整的特征向量矩阵，通过递归直接传播边界行，将内存复杂度从二次降至线性，同时消除传统延迟重放方式中的不必要矩阵-向量运算。提供了算法的正确性和稳定性证明，并实现了优化的CPU和GPU版本。

Result: 内存需求从二次降低到线性；消除了传统延迟重放中的不必要矩阵-向量运算；在标准数值库的QR和D&C例程上取得性能提升；GPU实现相比现有方法也有显著加速。

Conclusion: 论文通过理论分析和大量实验验证了该方法的有效性，在保持数值稳定性的同时，显著降低了计算和存储开销。

Abstract: Divide and Conquer (D&C) is a widely used algorithmic strategy for symmetric eigenvalue decomposition. Its natural parallelism makes D&C attractive on modern multicore CPUs and GPUs, but existing eigenvalue-only routines often default to QR-based methods because conventional D&C still materializes or replays large transformation matrices during the conquer phase. This paper proposes a boundary-row D&C algorithm for eigenvalue-only computation. The key observation is that the conquer phase only needs selected boundary rows/columns rather than the full accumulated eigenvector matrix. By propagating these boundary rows directly through the recursion, the proposed algorithm reduces the memory requirement from quadratic to linear space while also eliminating unnecessary matrix-vector work in the conventional lazy-replay formulation. We provide the algorithm, its time and space complexity analysis, correctness and stability arguments, optimized CPU and GPU implementations, and an evaluation against QR and D&C routines in standard numerical libraries.

</details>


### [135] [Autonomic Federated-Market Orchestration for the Edge-Cloud Continuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27106)
*Lauri Lovén,Roberto Morabito,Abhishek Kumar,Susanna Pirttikangas,Jukka Riekki,Sasu Tarkoma*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Neural Pub/Sub 是一个面向边缘-云连续体的联邦代理（federated-broker）自治底座：每个管理域运行一个 broker，各自闭合 MAPE-K 控制环（监控健康与负载 → 边际成本清算价分析 → 多拟阵可行性域上的放置规划 → 联邦跨域派发 → 带界陈旧度的对等订阅摘要与价格信号作为 Knowledge），其自组织行为由市场式价格信号涌现而非中心协调。Plan 步骤锚定一条 Walrasian 收敛命题（树/串并联服务依赖 DAG 上，粗替代估值下分散价格分配达到中心化 oracle 的福利）。在 4-VM/4 域/48 worker 的 1005 次运行实验中：联邦市场相对单进程 oracle 平均时延低 2–4%（45/45 逐种子全胜，符号检验 p≈2.8×10⁻¹⁴，Hodges–Lehmann 中位数 −39.6 ms）；在等进程数的四分片中心化编排器对比下差距保持在 ±1.5% 以内；轮询调度在 λ=5/10/15 pps 下完成率崩塌 98.8%→22.4%→3.3%，而市场保持完成率并可优雅降级；broker 死亡与网络分区下完成率 ≥98.7%（75 个单元）；主权约束带来零可测运行时开销（60 次治理网格运行，偏差 1–3 ms）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘-云连续体（仪器、边缘站点、区域云、中心 HPC）横跨彼此独立的管理域，复杂度与动态性使"自管理"成为关键路径能力：工作负载必须在无人在环、无单一协调者拥有全域可见性的条件下完成监控、分析、规划与派发。现有方案只覆盖问题碎片：Kubernetes/KubeEdge、Kueue/Volcano 等容器与批调度器限于单一控制平面、无联邦；Kafka/Flink/Ray 按主题分区路由而非按服务请求语义内容路由；Kubeflow/Argo/MLflow 在设计期固定 DAG 结构且限于单集群；Pegasus/Parsl/Swift/CometCloud 等科学工作流系统采用中心化单一规划器且无福利保证；经典拍卖/SFC/VNE 机制缺乏语义互联层与主权强制；LLM 多智能体框架在任务层组图，不涉及资源层放置。因此需要一个在跨厂商/跨司法辖区的自治域之间、以形式化福利保证驱动的自组织机制，同时把租户与运营方指定的数据主权（GDPR 传输、EU AI Act、NIS2）作为一等约束纳入自治决策。

Method: 系统模型：AI 流水线建模为服务依赖 DAG，容量约束族在树/两终端串并联结构下构成层状族，可行域为多拟阵（秩函数 f(S)=min over antichains of ΣC_v）；一般 DAG 由 integrator encapsulation 收缩为商图恢复多拟阵性；主权约束作为坐标上界与资源约束求交仍保持多拟阵。理论锚点（命题 3.1，自包含表述见补充材料 S2）：在层状约束 + 粗替代（GS）估值下，Walrasian 均衡存在、社会福利最大化，且可由多面体 clinching 升价拍卖多项式时间计算；原始流水线束估值是 Leontief（非 GS），仅在封装后得到单位需求的 GS 表示。架构：每域一个 broker，组成联邦覆盖层 F=(B,E_F)；broker 交换订阅摘要 σ_k={质心嵌入、簇半径、可用容量}与价格信号 PriceSignal，按语义距离阈值做跨域路由（每次发布比较代价 O(m·p̄)）；覆盖层异步，最终一致，陈旧度上界 B=δ_prop+WAN_max≈10.05 s（δ_prop=10 s 交换周期，k_miss=3 判故障，每 5 轮恢复探测）；派发为 POST-only HTTP RPC（at-most-once，τ_fed=5 s），本地派发为 at-least-once + 幂等阶段处理器，轮内预留账本 ℓ_add 单写者原子提交；因每个 worker 仅注册于一个 broker，跨 broker 预留冲突在构造上不可能。市场机制：worker 按拥塞定价提交 WorkerBid，broker 以 M/M/1 成本 cost_i=b_i/(1−ρ_i)（ρ_i≤0.99 上限）计算按阶段类型的边际成本清算价 π_k,t=d_t 便宜 worker 成本；跨域交易规则为远端 π_k',t+w_WAN < 本地 π_k,t 则远端放置（平局取本地）；总成本超流水线价值预算则拒收。实现含五项工程细化：速度缩放出价 b_i=b_0·s_i、M/M/1 动态拥塞定价、联邦价格交换、轮内负载预留账本、健康探测利用率同步。MAPE-K 映射：Monitor（δ_health=5 s 探测 + 心跳分区检测）、Analyse（M/M/1 清算价）、Plan（多拟阵域上算法 1）、Execute（联邦 HTTP 派发）、Knowledge（订阅摘要 + 对等价格，B 秒陈旧）。比较层级：单进程 oracle、全可见但无成本优化的中心化轮询、四 broker 市场、三个启发式（locality-only、latency-greedy、spillover），以及等进程数的四分片中心化编排器（指定协调者拉取对等状态、在合并拓扑上跑 find_placement）。测试床：5GTNF（Oulu）4 台 VM 各承载一个 O-RAN 域（DU/CU+near-RT RIC/non-RT RIC/SMO），每 VM 12 worker 共 48，4 broker，tc qdisc netem 模拟 50 ms 延迟 + 5 ms 抖动的跨站 WAN，站点内 <1 ms，URLLC 1 ms / eMBB 5 ms 切片 QoS；三个 8 阶段流水线模板（cqi-chain 树、anomaly-sp 串并联、ran-entangled 含钻石，γ>0）；Poisson 到达 λ∈{2,5,10} pps（消融扩展到 5/8/10/15/50），5 个种子，4 分钟预热 + 10 分钟测量；共 1005 次运行、7 个阶段、约 129 小时机时，含基础设施有效性验证、切片、worker 失效、压力、主市场网格与治理网格、联邦鲁棒性阶段。

Result: （1）去中心化与中心化的"反转"：四 broker 市场在全部 9 个（流水线, 负载）单元上平均端到端时延比单进程 oracle 低 2–4%，45/45 逐种子全胜（符号检验 p=2⁻⁴⁵≈2.8×10⁻¹⁴；HL 中位数 −39.6 ms，bootstrap 95% CI [−44.1, −35.3] ms），p50/p95/p99 方向一致；解释为单进程 oracle 在低至 2 pps 即成为状态/队列/派发决策的争用瓶颈。同等进程数的四分片 oracle 差距收敛到 ±1.5% 内（9 单元 5 胜/3 负/1 平），cqi-chain 市场全胜（−26 ms, 1.4%），anomaly-sp 分片略优（+5/+2 ms），ran-entangled 单元级平手；与单进程 oracle 相比仅在树结构上有优势，说明优势是流水线结构条件性的。10 pps cqi-chain 时单进程 oracle 完成率降至 99.4%，市场与分片 oracle 均保持 100%。（2）策略差异只在压力下显现：均匀负载下市场与三启发式在每单元收敛于 ±5 ms，locality-only 全单元具竞争力；饱和时轮询完成率 98.8%→22.4%→3.3%（时延 1.8 s→9.6 s），跨越标定膝点 λ≈13.8 pps（95% CI [12.5, 14.6]），市场在 λ≤10 保持 100%、λ=15 降至 83.3%、λ=50 仍有 25.4%（轮询为 0），且与四分片 oracle 在 sat-5/10/15 仅差 14 ms 与 0.5 个百分点；失效×负载交互中轮询在 8 pps 杀 12 worker 即崩至 33.5%，市场全程 100%；异构场景（边侧慢 2×、云侧快 1.5×）轮询 2508/1544/1251 ms 对市场 1290/851/702 ms，降幅约 46%。（3）优势可分解为三项与 GS 无关、在任何多拟阵域上的市场清算机制都成立的 Walrasian 属性：信息完备性、准入控制、价格发现。（4）联邦鲁棒性：broker 进程 kill、边缘-云网络分区、逐阶段 worker 死亡下 75 个单元完成率 ≥98.7%（联邦/静态 98.7%，其余 100%），时延在基线 1834 ms 的 25 ms 内；两个边缘站 36,098 与 36,092 事件上完成率 ≥99.9%。（5）主权强制零开销：60 次治理网格（4 场景×3 流水线×5 种子）均值与无约束基线差 1–3 ms（≤3 ms 内），因主权是可行性域上的坐标上界，清算自动绕开禁止分配。基础设施有效性：HTTP 与 Kafka 逐种子时延差 <1 ms；切片感知放置降中位时延 15%（1233 vs 1450 ms）并在均衡比较中把吞吐提升 5×；治理开销 0%；worker 失效下 HTTP 完成率 100%，Kafka 因消费者组再均衡损失 1.1%。

Conclusion: 贡献在于：一个在多自治管理域间联邦、以市场价格信号实现自组织的自治分布式底座及其显式 MAPE-K 映射（含五项使经验包络成立的工程细化，但逐组件 leave-one-out 归因留待后续）；等进程数条件下"去中心化 vs 中心化"的经验反转（去中心化在树结构上占优、与理想中心化编排器相差在 ±5 ms 内，同时保留厂商机密性、无需单一协调器并具形式化 Walrasian 保证）；以及自管理策略何时才真正产生差异的结构性分解（饱和/异构/失效下的准入控制、信息完备性、价格发现）。保证的形式是"声明式运行包络"而非封闭形式证明：包络为陈旧度 B≈10.05 s、λ≤13.8 pps（λB≤139 由轮内账本吸收）、k_miss=3 故障切换阈值，安全不变量为无阶段被派发至 ρ_i≥0.99 的 worker、轮内超配不超过单流水线阶段数、主权约束不可被违反，活性依赖有界陈旧下的最终一致收敛；后续可做统计模型检验。局限与未来工作：实现的是边际成本清算而非完整多面体 clinching 拍卖，简化—最优定价差距计入所测效率差；处理时间为标定延迟而非真实 ML 推理，语义匹配层为冻结的预校准组件；测试床为单数据中心 4 VM、单条模拟 WAN，无带宽限制/丢包/重排/路径不对称/跨流量竞争，HPC 层未实测（架构上以批队列端点的 integrator 封装接入，但 10²–10³ s 排队方差需更粗的提交周期）；漏斗故障处理模式（wait/proceed/abort）未覆盖（鲁棒性单元均用树形 cqi-chain）；非模性间隙 γ 在封装前后的度量未做，故"封装恢复多拟阵"与"预留账本抑制超配"两种解释无法区分；异构域（不对称信任/容量/数据质量）下的多层级治理组合理论待检验；后续方向包括异构域实验、EISim 规模验证、面向对抗性多厂商场景的 broker 问责（承诺式定价、跨 broker 审计）、动态可信度自适应、语义通信传输层，以及跨真实 WAN（Oulu↔Tokyo，~150 ms RTT）部署验证。

Abstract: The edge-cloud computing continuum demands self-management mechanisms that scale across autonomous administrative domains while honouring tenant- and operator-specified data sovereignty. We present Neural Pub/Sub, a federated-broker autonomic substrate whose self-organising behaviour emerges from market-based price signals rather than centralised control. Its MAPE-K control loop closes over per-broker health and load monitoring, marginal-cost clearing-price analysis, placement planning over a polymatroidal feasibility region, federated cross-domain dispatch, and shared peer subscription summaries with bounded-staleness price signals. The Plan step is anchored in a Walrasian convergence proposition: under gross-substitutes valuations on tree and series-parallel service-dependency DAGs, decentralised price-based allocation matches the welfare of a centralised oracle. We evaluate the substrate on a 4-VM, 4-domain, 48-worker federated edge-cloud testbed (single data centre, 50 ms emulated WAN) in a 1005-run campaign augmented by a fair-process-count sharded-oracle comparator. The federated market dominates a single-process oracle by 2-4% with 45 of 45 per-seed wins (sign-test p ~ 2.8e-14, Hodges-Lehmann median -39.6 ms); against a four-shard centralised orchestrator at equal process count the gap stays within +/-1.5% across all nine (pipeline, load) cells. Round-robin completion rate collapses 98.8% -> 22.4% -> 3.3% across arrival rates 5/10/15 pps while the market preserves completion; the advantage decomposes into three Walrasian properties (information completeness, admission control, price discovery). Federation withstands broker death and network partition (completion rate >= 98.7% across 75 cells), and sovereignty enforcement adds no measurable runtime overhead across 60 governance-grid runs. Heterogeneous-domain stressors and cross-site WAN deployment remain future work.

</details>


### [136] [Revisiting Bruck: Phase-Efficient All-to-All Communication in Reconfigurable Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26930)
*Anton Juerss,Stefan Schmid*

Main category: cs.DC
