TL;DR: 本文针对光可重构网络(ORN)中 All-to-All 集合通信的效率瓶颈,提出名为 ReTri 的双向 All-to-All 调度算法。ReTri 借鉴 Trivance 的三进制通信模式,用平衡三进制块传播在 ⌈log₃n⌉ 个阶段内完成 All-to-All(相比 Bruck 的 ⌈log₂n⌉ 阶段减少约 33%),并由通信模式直接推导出一条"可复用的三进制子环"重配置策略,使重配置延迟可跨阶段摊销。仿真显示:相对静态 Pairwise All-to-All 最高加速 10×,相对可重构 Bruck(带镜像的 Bridge)最高加速 2.1×,且在毫秒级重配置延迟下仍保持优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布式机器学习(尤其是 MoE)与 HPC 的 All-to-All 通信是端到端性能的主要瓶颈(MoE 训练中占比可达 55%),密集流量持续压迫 scale-up 互连。光可重构网络(ORN)可通过运行时调整物理拓扑来降低路径长度与拥塞,但存在根本权衡:每次重配置都需要全局同步并产生不可忽略的延迟 δ。已有方案的问题在于:(1) Pairwise All-to-All 需要 n−1 个阶段与线性次数的重配置,每次仅服务单个阶段,结构不可复用,固定重配置延迟无法摊销,除 δ≈0 外不可行;(2) 经典 Bruck 算法等分阶段算法在逻辑上按单向设计,无法同时利用双向光链路——理想多端口模型可达 ⌈log₃n⌉ 阶段,但在 2n 端口的 OCS 约束下,单向模式需要每节点 4 条入射链路,且环上流量单向推进导致拥塞与传播延迟上升。因此本文主张:通信模式与重配置策略必须围绕光交换机的端口约束进行协同设计,目标不只是带宽利用率,而是"以尽量少的阶段数 × 尽量少的重配置次数"传输尽可能多的流量,并让双向链路承载双向流量。

Method: 架构模型:scale-up 域内 n 个加速器,每节点 2 个光电收发器,OCS 提供 2n 个端口;保持全连通拓扑要求每节点度数≥2,故最小可行拓扑为若干环(2n 端口仅能建立 n 条双向匹配链路)。算法:ReTri 基于 Trivance(Juerss et al., 2026),在阶段 k 每个节点 r 与 r±3^k (mod n) 两个对称对等节点交换数据,共 s=⌈log₃n⌉ 个阶段。块传播:定义中心化偏移 Δ_{r,d}=ucr_n((d−r) mod n),其唯一的平衡三进制表示 Δ=Σ_k τ_k·3^k(τ_k∈{−1,0,+1})决定块在每个阶段的去向(+1 右传、−1 左传、0 保留);每阶段每节点向左右各发送 m/3 数据,附录 B 证明表示唯一且每阶段恰好 n/3 块分发。重配置策略:阶段 k 前若 x_k=1,则按 E_k={{i,(i+3^k) mod n}} 建立链路,等价于把节点划分为 3^k 个大小 n/3^k 的子环 S_i^(k)={u | u≡i (mod 3^k)};附录 A 证明这些子环在 2n 端口约束下是最小的,且包含所有未来阶段的对等节点,因此拓扑可跨阶段复用并保持连通。代价模型:扩展 Hockney α-β 模型 C = s·α_s + Σ_k(h_k·α_h + m_k·c_k·β) + R·δ,推导得静态代价 C^ReTri(m)=log₃n·α_s+(α_h+βm/3)(n−1)/2;给定 R 次重配置,最优分段长度应相差至多 1,对齐时 C^ReTri(R)=log₃n·α_s+(R+1)(α_h+βm/3)(3^{log₃n/(R+1)}−1)/2+R·δ,最优重配置次数 R*=argmin_R C^ReTri(R)(0≤R≤s−1),即在大 n、大消息、低带宽或高 per-hop 延迟时更倾向于每阶段重配置。评测:使用 Astra-Sim + ns-3 后端,链路带宽 400 Gbps、传播延迟 1 μs、每阶段延迟 1.7 μs,消息大小 1 KB–256 MB,重配置延迟 δ 从 1 μs 到 50 ms(附录扩展至 150 ms);对比基线为静态 Pairwise All-to-All 与可重构 Bruck(Bridge,作者另加镜像使其双向以保证公平)。由于三进制/二进制天然对齐差异,ReTri 用 n=81(n=243)对比 Bruck 的 n=64(n=256),对 Bruck 有利。

Result: 1) 相对静态 Pairwise All-to-All:在 δ=1 μs 时加速最高 10×;小消息在 δ≤10 μs 内重配置仍有收益,≤8 MB 消息可承受至 δ=1 ms,256 MB 消息在 δ=50 ms 时仍有收益。2) 相对可重构 Bruck(Bridge):稳定加速最高 2.1×(尽管 ReTri 网络规模大 26%);小消息阶段因阶段数与路径长度优势获得至少 1.6×,此时 R*=0,收益来自静态模式本身;大消息下加速 1.2×–2.1×。3) 阶段/重配置优势:Bruck 需要 log₂n/log₃n≈1.58 倍的阶段数,其 per-phase 与 per-hop 延迟高约 58%,达成同等拓扑优化还多承受 58% 的重配置延迟。4) 更大网络(附录 n=243 vs 256)中,δ=150 ms、256 MB 时 ReTri 仍比静态基线快 1.2×,而 Bruck 已不再优于静态执行。5) 结论性判断:重配置收益随消息规模与网络规模增大而扩大;ReTri 在"通信昂贵"区间(大消息、高延迟)最有效。

Conclusion: 本文通过在 ORN 物理约束下重新审视 Bruck 的对数阶段结构,提出 ReTri:一个双向、稀疏的 All-to-All 调度,在保留成对双向交换的同时诱导可复用的子环拓扑,以 ⌈log₃n⌉ 阶段完成通信,阶段数较 Bruck 的 ORN 可行实现减少 33%。核心洞见是"通信模式与光拓扑协同设计":由通信模式可确定性推导出最优重配置策略,减少阶段数即减少重配置次数,而稀疏重配置可跨阶段摊销固定延迟。实验证明该方案在现实重配置延迟下优于静态执行与可重构 Bruck,是面向未来 scale-up 域"可重构感知集合通信"设计空间的一个具体实例。作者同时指明研究议程:非 3 的幂规模网络(如 TPU 常见的 2 的幂,当前 ReTri 在 64 节点与 81 节点性能相同)、推广到 d=2q 端口的平衡基数 b=d+1 情形、把重配置与计算重叠、扩展到 AllReduce 等其他集合通信、子环复用时的路由与队头阻塞问题、重配置间的屏障/慢节点同步开销,以及基于真实 OCS 模型的硬件级仿真评估(目前仅为 ns-3 层面的初步仿真)。

Abstract: All-to-All communication is a key performance bottleneck for distributed machine learning (ML) and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads, where dense traffic increasingly stresses scale-up interconnects. While these ML and HPC workloads have driven unprecedented infrastructure demand, optical reconfigurable networks (ORNs) offer a promising path forward. By adapting the physical topology to the active workload, they improve communication cost and bandwidth utilization. However, their benefit is critically contingent on whether the collective consists of structured phases that can be served by sparse and reusable topology states.
  In this paper, we revisit Bruck's All-to-All implementation and demonstrate the benefits of topology optimization in which both communication pattern and reconfiguration strategy are co-designed. We present ReTri, a bidirectional All-to-All schedule for ORNs. ReTri uses balanced ternary block propagation to complete All-to-All in $\lceil \log_3 n\rceil$ phases. The induced reconfiguration strategy from ReTri's pairwise bidirectional exchanges allow reconfiguration delays to be amortized across multiple phases. Preliminary simulations show that ReTri improves completion time by up to $10\times$ over static All-to-All, even for millisecond-scale reconfiguration delays, and improving reconfigurable Bruck by up to $2.1\times$.

</details>


### [137] [Nonlinear spectral clustering with C++ GraphBLAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26975)
*Dimosthenis Pasadakis,Olaf Schenk,Verner Vlacic,Albert-Jan Yzelman*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于p范数(p∈(1,2])的直接多路谱聚类算法的C++ GraphBLAS实现。该实现使用稀疏矩阵和稠密向量，通过共享内存并行方式处理大规模图数据。实验表明该算法在平衡图割指标上表现优异，能有效处理高达800万节点和4800万边的数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Nonlinear reformulations of spectral clustering offer increased numerical benefits and solid mathematical foundations, but the estimation of multiple nonlinear eigenvectors is computationally expensive. There is a need for efficient implementations that can handle large-scale problems.

Method: A direct multiway spectral clustering algorithm in p-norm (p∈(1,2]) implemented using a novel C++ GraphBLAS API. Key operations are expressed in linear algebraic terms and executed over sparse matrices and dense vectors, parameterized in the pertinent algebra. The algorithm is implemented in shared-memory parallel fashion.

Result: The implementation demonstrates effectiveness and accuracy on artificial test cases. Comparative results against competitive methods show the algorithm achieves high-quality clusters. Strong scaling is demonstrated on large datasets.

Conclusion: The proposed implementation achieves high-quality clusters in terms of balanced graph cut metric and demonstrates strong scaling capabilities on datasets with up to 8 million nodes and 48 million edges.

Abstract: Nonlinear reformulations of the spectral clustering method have gained a lot of recent attention due to their increased numerical benefits and their solid mathematical background. However, the estimation of the multiple nonlinear eigenvectors is associated with an increased computational cost. We present an implementation of a direct multiway spectral clustering algorithm in the $p$-norm, for $p\in(1,2]$, using a novel C++ GraphBLAS API. The key operations are expressed in linear algebraic terms and are executed over the resulting sparse matrices and dense vectors, parameterized in the algebra pertinent to the computation. We demonstrate the effectiveness and accuracy of our shared-memory algorithm on several artificial test cases. Our numerical examples and comparative results against competitive methods indicate that the proposed implementation attains high quality clusters in terms of the balanced graph cut metric. The strong scaling capabilities of our algorithm are showcased on a range of datasets with up to $8$ million nodes and $48$ million edges.

</details>

### [138] [From user-understandable to technical process model: a model-driven approach using cuta4bpm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26117)
*Kathrin Kirchner,Siniša Nešković,Dejan Stojimirović*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种参与式正向工程方法，使用块导向的CUTA4BPM语言支持与领域专家的高层过程建模，再通过模型驱动工程自动转换为图导向的BPMN模型用于详细设计，从而弥合可理解性与技术灵活性之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前块导向语言虽结构化程度高、易于领域专家理解，但技术灵活性不足；而图导向语言虽技术灵活却缺乏结构性，双方存在可理解性与技术通用性之间的矛盾。

Method: 采用模型驱动工程(MDE)技术，将CUTA4BPM块导向语言的过程模型自动转换为BPMN图导向模型。

Result: 实现了从CUTA4BPM高层建模到BPMN详细设计的高效平滑过渡，兼顾了领域专家的可理解性需求和技术设计人员的灵活性需求。

Conclusion: 通过CUTA4BPM到BPMN的自动模型转换，实现了从高层领域建模到详细技术设计的平滑过渡，弥合了可理解性与技术灵活性之间的差距。

Abstract: For business process modeling, we can choose between graph-oriented and block-oriented languages. Block-oriented languages are more structured and therefore better understandable for domain experts, while graph-oriented languages allow more modeling freedom and technical versatility for process designers. To bridge this gap between understandability and technical versatility, we propose a participative forward engineering approach. It uses our block-oriented CUTA4BPM language to support high level process modeling together with domain experts, while graph-oriented BPMN is used for further detailed process design and automation. To support smooth transition from the high level modeling step to the detailed one, CUTA4BPM process models are automatically transformed to BPMN models using model driven engineering techniques.

</details>


### [139] [VISTA: An End-to-End Benchmark for Visual Spec-to-Web-App Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26144)
*JunJia Guo,Yuhang Yao,Jiawei,Zhou,Jingdi Chen*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: VISTA是一个评估LLM智能体端到端Web应用生成能力的基准，通过多维度的信息条件和评估方法揭示了视觉保真度与功能正确性的解耦特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有代码生成基准聚焦于算法任务，缺乏对真实UI开发场景的评估；脚本化测试工具（如Playwright）在开放式代码生成场景中存在局限性，无法准确评估视觉保真度和功能正确性。

Method: 设计了5种提示信息条件（沿视觉/结构保真度和技术栈约束两个轴向变化），结合DOM参考匹配、浏览器行为测试和CLIP视觉相似度三种评估方法，对4个智能体系统进行评估。

Result: 发现视觉保真度与功能正确性在输入条件和智能体间呈现部分解耦；智能体的编辑风格差异显著但与任务质量基本正交。

Conclusion: VISTA为LLM智能体在UI开发任务中的能力评估提供了标准化、可复现的基准，推动基于智能体的软件工程研究的发展。

Abstract: We present VISTA (VIsual Spec-To-App Benchmark), a benchmark for evaluating the end-to-end web-app generation capabilities of LLM-based agents. Unlike prior code generation benchmarks that focus on algorithmic tasks, VISTA targets realistic UI-centric development, where agents must produce functional, visually coherent applications from underspecified inputs. We define five prompt-information conditions that vary along two axes, visual/structural fidelity and stack constraint: (1) text only with free stack choice, (2) text with reference screenshots under three specified stacks, (3) text with reference screenshots under free stack choice, (4) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under a single specified stack, and (5) text with screenshots and pruned Figma structure under free stack choice. To enable robust evaluation, each page in the benchmark is manually annotated with interactive UI components and around three visual anchor points, addressing the well-known limitations of script-based testing tools such as Playwright in open-ended code generation settings. Evaluation combines DOM-grounded reference matching, behavior-specific browser tests, and CLIP-based visual similarity, jointly measuring structural alignment, behavioral completeness, and overall visual fidelity. We use VISTA to assess four agent systems drawn from two model families and two harnesses, finding that visual fidelity and functional correctness are partially decoupled across both input conditions and agents, and that agent editing style varies sharply but is largely orthogonal to task quality. VISTA establishes a rigorous and reproducible foundation for advancing agent-based software engineering research.

</details>


### [140] [Augment Engineering: A Methodology for Multi-Tool AI Orchestration Across Professional Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26146)
*Elias Calboreanu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: This paper defines "Augment Engineering" as the discipline of orchestrating multiple purpose-built AI tools across distinct professional domains, leveraging domain-portable meta-skills (prompt engineering and context engineering). A 5-month single-practitioner case study spanning seven domains provides exploratory quantitative evidence supporting the framework's predictions.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Organizations increasingly deploy separate purpose-built AI tools across professional domains, often hiring domain specialists for each, recreating the staffing models AI was expected to transform. The paper identifies that meta-skills (prompt engineering and context engineering) are domain-portable, enabling a practitioner to apply them across any purpose-built AI tool.

Method: 5-month formative case study (November 2025 to March 2026) documenting a single practitioner applying skills across a ten-component orchestration stack spanning seven professional domains. Two quantitative tests: Cochran-Armitage trend test (n=200 interactions across two chat LLMs) and Wright's Law fit (n=82 artifacts). Six-phase orchestration methodology and four portability metrics were developed.

Result: Cochran-Armitage trend test shows first-pass acceptance rising with prompt-sophistication level (p<0.01); Wright's Law fit shows production acceleration across the artifact portfolio (p<0.01). Note: all observations from single practitioner, statistics are exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory.

Conclusion: Augment Engineering completes a three-discipline progression: Prompt Engineering (one tool) → Context Engineering (reproducible pipelines) → Augment Engineering (portfolio of tools across domains). This framework enables a single practitioner to leverage domain-portable meta-skills across multiple purpose-built AI tools in different professional domains.

Abstract: Organizations increasingly deploy separate purpose-built AI tools across professional domains, often hiring domain specialists for each, recreating the staffing models AI was expected to transform. Yet the meta-skills that make these tools effective, prompt engineering (interaction-level optimization) and context engineering (structured input pipeline design), are domain-portable: a practitioner who masters them can apply them to any purpose-built AI tool in any domain. This paper defines Augment Engineering as the discipline of orchestrating multiple purpose-built AI tools across distinct professional domains, applying prompt and context engineering as portable competencies that transfer across tool boundaries. We present a six-phase orchestration methodology and four portability metrics. A 5-month formative case study (November 2025 to March 2026) documents a single practitioner applying these skills across a ten-component orchestration stack spanning seven professional domains, producing work products that would traditionally involve separate domain specialists. Two quantitative observations are consistent with the framework's predictions: a Cochran-Armitage trend test (n = 200 interactions across two chat LLMs, p < 0.01) shows first-pass acceptance rising with prompt-sophistication level, and a Wright's Law fit (n = 82 artifacts, p < 0.01) shows production acceleration across the artifact portfolio. Because all observations come from a single practitioner, the inferential statistics are exploratory and hypothesis-generating rather than confirmatory; portability across the full portfolio awaits multi-practitioner replication. Augment Engineering completes a three-discipline progression: Prompt Engineering (one tool), Context Engineering (reproducible pipelines), Augment Engineering (a portfolio of tools across domains).

</details>


### [141] [Gamified Requirement Elicitation for a Multi-Modal Decision Support System. The Case of SYNCHROMODE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26164)
*Dimitris Tzanis,Alexandros Dolianitis,Viktoria Petkani,Areti Kotsi,Evangelos Mitsakis*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: The SYNCHROMODE project focuses on the requirement elicitation phase for a multimodal transport decision support system. The study compares traditional use case methods with a gamification-based serious game approach for gathering requirements from diverse stakeholders in a workshop setting.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Developing complex multimodal transport management systems requires careful requirement elicitation to establish foundational system needs and expectations, particularly for interconnected services in the SYNCHROMODE toolbox.

Method: The study employs two parallel requirement elicitation approaches: (1) traditional methods using use cases during the design phase, and (2) a gamification-based approach using a serious game conducted during a physical workshop in Thessaloniki (October 2023). Stakeholders from diverse backgrounds (traffic management experts, public transport authorities, MaaS providers, first responders, ITS technology providers, and local authorities) participated in the gamification workshop.

Result: A set of predefined requirements was identified through use cases. A requirement elicitation serious game was designed, developed, and successfully deployed in a workshop with diverse stakeholders.

Conclusion: The paper compares requirements gathered through traditional use case methods with those obtained through gamification-based elicitation, providing insights into the effectiveness of different requirement gathering approaches for complex multimodal transport management systems.

Abstract: SYNCHROMODE is a Horizon Europe project that aims to develop a data-driven ICT toolbox for improving the management of transport operations from a multimodal perspective. This is, in essence, a multimodal decision support system that will take the form of interconnected pieces of software. Developing complex systems requires careful planning and management. Their "life cycle" consists of several phases, starting with the critical stage of requirement elicitation, which establishes the system's foundational needs and expectations. This paper focuses on the requirement elicitation phase of core interconnected services that are to be offered through the SYNCHROMODE toolbox. Elicitation is achieved both through traditional methods and specifically through the use of use cases as well as through the use of gamification. During the design phase of the toolbox and as a result of the use cases a set of predefined requirements were identified. Moreover, a requirement elicitation serious game was designed and developed. Subsequently, the game was presented in person during a physical workshop, which took place in Thessaloniki in October 2023, to a diverse range of stakeholders, including experts in traffic management, public transport authorities, MaaS providers, first responders, ITS technology providers, and local authorities. Both requirement elicitation processes are summarized in the context of this paper. Finally, the requirements generated through traditional means and through gamification are then analyzed and compared.

</details>


### [142] [Tool-Schema Compression Enables Agentic RAG Under Constrained Context Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26165)
*Furkan Sakizli*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是首个系统研究"工具 Schema 压缩 × Agentic RAG 上下文预算"权衡的受控实验：14 个本地模型（1.5B–32B）+ 1 个前沿 API 模型，6,566 次 API 调用，8K/16K/32K 三档上下文，28 个工具定义。核心发现是"二值使能（binary enablement）"效应：在 8K 预算下，原始 JSON Schema（约 11,000 tokens）直接溢出上下文窗口，导致几乎全盘失效（平均 EM 仅 2.6%）；经 TSCG conservative-profile 压缩（节省 44–50% tokens）后可装入 1–2 个检索块，EM 恢复到 23.1%（+20.5 pp，6 个完全使能模型中 +24.7 pp）；在 32K 两种格式均能容纳时，5 个模型中 4 个 |ΔEM| ≤ 1 pp，证明增益纯粹由预算驱动而非格式本身。HotpotQA 外部验证 +48 pp EM；前沿扩展实验显示 JSON Schema 约在 494 个工具处溢出，压缩后超过 800 个工具仍可运行（操作范围 +63%）。结论：工具 Schema 压缩应被视为受限上下文部署下 Agentic RAG 的必要基础设施层，而非可选优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 【研究动机】Agentic RAG 系统需要在同一上下文窗口内同时容纳系统提示、检索块（chunk）、对话历史、输出空间与数十至数百个工具的 JSON Schema 定义，形成"零和"资源冲突。单个工具 Schema 平均 300–500 tokens，28 个工具即约 11,000 tokens，直接超出 8K 窗口；而生产环境通过 MCP 等协议暴露 20–100+ 工具已成常态。现有 RAG 评估普遍默认"工具 Schema 装得下"这一前提，本文证明该前提在仅 28 个工具的 8K 场景下即告失效。同时，既有提示压缩工作（LLMLingua 等）针对自由文本，无法保持 JSON Schema 的语法、参数类型与枚举等结构不变量，也从未在"Schema token 与检索块争夺同一预算"的交互机制下被评估过。【核心假设】若对工具 Schema 做确定性、结构保持的压缩（如 TSCG，节省 44–68% tokens），可在小上下文下恢复 RAG 能力；而在预算充裕时，压缩不应带来任何准确率损失（即"无损"）。

Method: 【方法】1）上下文预算建模：形式化 B_RAG = B − B_sys(350) − B_schema(f,n) − B_hist(1500) − B_out(512)，可容纳块数 k = ⌊B_RAG/c̄⌋（c̄=350 tokens）。28 工具时 B_schema(json)≈11,000 > B=8,192 → B_RAG<0、k=0（溢出）；TSCG 后 ≈5,500，剩余 265–330 tokens，k≥1。2）自建 NovaTech-28 基准：模拟中型科技公司，28 个工具（数据库查询/文档检索/计算/通信，各 3–8 个带类型参数）、40 个检索块（4 类、含相关性标签）、100 道五类问题（单跳文档 25、单跳数据库 25、多跳 20、需工具 20、不可答 10）。3）ReAct 风格 Agent 循环（≤3 步），除 schema 格式外所有提示严格相同，构成配对设计。4）模型：Tier A 4 个（Phi-4 14B、Llama 3.1:8B、Gemma3:12B、Qwen3:14B）、Tier B 3 个（Mistral-Small 24B、Qwen2.5-Coder:32B、Gemma4:26B）、Tier C 6 个（1.5B–7B，仅测 16K）、API 1 个（Claude Sonnet 4，含 200K）；本地模型跑在 2×RTX 5070 Ti/Ollama，合计约 10 GPU 小时、$107 API 成本、0% 错误率。5）指标：EM、Token F1、工具选择准确率、RAG 覆盖率、上下文溢出二值标志；统计采用配对 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Cohen's d、10,000 次 bootstrap 的 95% CI（seed=42），未做多重比较校正。6）外部验证：HotpotQA dev-distractor 集 50 道中/难多跳题（2 gold + 8 distractor 段落），Phi-4 @8K、28 工具。7）前沿扩展：合成 50/100/200/300/500/800 工具集，Sonnet 4 @200K，并以 1 工具粒度扫描溢出阈值。8）机制分析：拟合上下文利用饱和模型 C(k)=C_max(1−e^{−λk})+C_0（网格搜索，n=4,700 个 (k,F1) 对），并做 conservative vs. balanced profile 消融（Phi-4、Llama 3.1:8B，400 次调用）。

Result: 【主要结果】1）8K 二值使能（表 1）：8 个模型 JSON 条件 100% 溢出、EM 0–10（均值 2.6），TSCG 后 EM 12–36（均值 23.1），平均 +20.5 pp；6 个"完全使能"模型平均 +24.7 pp，前六名 p<0.01（Llama 3.1:8B 1→34、Phi-4 14B 2→33、Mistral-Small 24B 4→33、Sonnet 4 10→36、Qwen2.5-Coder 3→18、Gemma3:12B 1→15），Gemma4:26B 因持续输出解析失败仅 0→4（16K 下可达 26–28%）。2）16K"块解放但无增益"（控制实验）：JSON 约 9 块 vs TSCG 26 块（+17–19 块，3× 检索上下文），14 模型中位 ΔEM=−1 pp，12/14 模型 |ΔEM|≤3 pp，无一达 p<0.05（唯一例外 Qwen3:4B −8 pp，p=0.019）→ 说明基准在约 9 块处饱和。3）32K 天花板控制：5 个模型中 4 个 ΔEM∈{−1,0,+1} pp 且不显著；例外 Qwen2.5-Coder:32B +12 pp（p<0.001），作者归因于与预算机制无关的"格式翻译红利"（与先前 TSCG 评测中模型特异的算子敏感性一致）。4）HotpotQA 外部验证：JSON 全部溢出、EM=0；TSCG B_RAG≈421、平均 3.4 块（2–5），EM 48.0、F1 0.645、74% 子串匹配、24/50 精确匹配 → +48 pp，强于 NovaTech 同模型的 +31 pp（因 HotpotQA gold 段落更短更密集）。5）前沿扩展（Sonnet 4 @200K）：50–300 工具子溢出区间两格式相当（~77% EM，|Δ|≤6.7 pp，p>0.10）；JSON 在 ~494 工具处完全溢出（EM=0），TSCG 在 500 工具达 90% EM、800 工具达 100%，超过 803 工具仍可运行，操作范围 +63%；首次检索块丢失阈值 JSON 82 工具 vs TSCG 164 工具；每工具 token 成本 JSON 380–473、TSCG 205–261，节省率 44.7–46.4%。6）上下文利用模型：C_max=0.18、λ=25.9、C_0=0.095、R²=0.011（n=4,700），λ≫1 表明近乎阶跃式饱和——第一块边际增益最大（ΔF1=+0.18，k:0→1），k≥2 迅速饱和，16K 两格式均已在饱和平台。7）复合格式–预算交互（探索性）：Sonnet 4 8K+TSCG（F1=0.406, k=2）反而优于 16K+JSON（F1=0.369, k=11），+0.037 F1，但 p=0.12、d=0.17，仅列为待验证观察。8）干扰稀释：16K 下块增量与 EM 增量负相关 r=−0.50（n=14），14 个模型中 10 个 ΔF1≤0；≤8B 小模型最明显（Qwen3:4B ΔEM=−8 pp、Mistral:7B ΔF1=−4.3 pp 却多拿 18 块），与"lost in the middle"机制呼应。9）分类别结果（表 6）：单跳文档 +13.7 pp、不可答 +14.6 pp（受益于 8K 使能），需工具仅 +0.9 pp（工具选择依赖 Schema 理解而非检索量），多跳 EM 两者均为 0。10）消融：balanced profile（~53% 节省，比 conservative 多释放 395 tokens ≈ 1 块）精度几乎相同（ΔEM=+0.8 pp，无单元 p<0.05），说明模型主要依赖参数名与类型理解 Schema，描述文本可安全剥离。【评价】优点是配对设计严格控制了提示变量、8K/16K/32K 三档构成完整的"溢出–解放–天花板"逻辑闭环，并有外部数据集与前沿扩展双重验证；局限是 NovaTech-28 为合成基准、仅主测 conservative profile 且消融只覆盖 2 模型×2 预算、Tier C 仅在 16K 测、前沿实验仅单模型单预算、静态填充策略未考虑迭代检索，且未做多重比较校正（作者以 p<0.001 与控制条件非独立检验作辩护）。此外拟合模型 R²=0.011 很低，饱和曲线更多是结构性解读而非严格统计证据。

Conclusion: 工具 Schema 压缩应从"可选的成本优化"重新定位为"受限上下文下 Agentic RAG 的必要使能层（enablement layer）"：8K 场景下的改进不是边际提升而是类别性差异——从 2.6% EM 的溢出性失效（完全无法运行、无法通过提示工程或检索调优改进）转为可迭代优化的功能系统。作者同时明确"何时不必压缩"：32K 与前沿子溢出区间两格式精度一致，压缩的收益是纯运营性的（使 RAG 可运行、降低成本、保留预算给更长历史/更大输出），而非引入准确率伪影。作者建议 Schema 压缩与动态工具选择（TinyAgent 式路由到相关工具子集）互补并联合部署，并指出无论压缩与否，任意固定窗口在足够高的工具数量下终将溢出，Schema 压缩只是把这条天花板从 ~494 工具推到 >803 工具。

Abstract: Agentic RAG systems that equip language models with dozens to hundreds of tool definitions face a critical resource conflict: tool schemas consume the same context window needed for retrieval-augmented generation. We present the first systematic study of this tool-context trade-off, evaluating 14 models spanning 1.5B-32B local models plus one frontier API model across 6,566 controlled API calls at three context budgets (8K, 16K, 32K) with 28 tool definitions. Applying TSCG conservative-profile compression (44-50% schema token savings), we observe a binary enablement effect: at 8K tokens, JSON-schema tool definitions overflow the context window entirely, yielding near-zero EM (2.6% average), while compressed schemas restore RAG functionality with +20.5 pp average exact-match lift across all eight models (+24.7 pp among the six exhibiting full enablement). At 32K -- where both formats fit -- four of five tested models show delta <= 1 pp, confirming the effect is purely budget-driven. External validation on HotpotQA (50 multi-hop questions) shows +48 pp EM under the same overflow scenario. Frontier scaling tests demonstrate that JSON schemas overflow at ~494 tools while compressed schemas remain operational beyond 800 tools. Our results establish tool-schema compression as a necessary infrastructure layer for agentic RAG in constrained-context deployments. All code, data, and checkpoints are publicly available.

</details>


### [143] [ESBMC: A Survey of Its Evolution, Integration, and Future Directions in Formal Software Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26169)
*Pierre Dantas,Lucas Cordeiro,Waldir Junior*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于 ESBMC（基于 SMT 的上下文有界模型检查器）的自述式综述，系统梳理了它从 2009 年嵌入式 ANSI-C 验证原型到 2025-2026 年支持 9 种语言、集成 6 个 SMT 求解器、并与 LLM/AI 智能体耦合的自主验证内核的演进轨迹。文章汇总了 43 项 SV-COMP/Test-Comp 奖项、规格化的文献筛选流程（PRISMA，最终语料 107 篇）、经济与产业影响数据（£9.3M+€4.98M 公共资助、VeriBee 衍生公司、洛克希德·马丁部署），并提出覆盖可扩展性、神经符号验证、反例可读性、跨语言验证、DO-330 工具鉴定与开源治理的结构化研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 形式化验证是给出软件正确性最强保证的手段，但学界与工业界普遍缺少一个兼具 SMT 理论表达力、多语言覆盖、工业级性能与可扩展性的有界模型检查（BMC）平台。同时，随着 LLM/AI 智能体在软件工程中的兴起，单一工具的"标准件"叙事已不足以反映技术演进全貌——ESBMC 需要一份文献来记录其从研究原型到工业可用平台的完整脉络，并为其未来研究议程提供定位。作者同时希望以系统化检索流程和独立可核验来源（SV-COMP 官方报告、UKRI/CORDIS 资助记录）支撑单工具综述的可信度。

Method: 采用结构化叙事综述（structured narrative review）而非系统性映射研究，覆盖 2009 年 ASE 首次发表至 2025 年 v7.7 版本。检索策略为 PRISMA 式流程：2026 年 5 月 21 日在 arXiv、DBLP、OpenAlex、IEEE Xplore、ACM DL、SpringerLink 五个库检索，初始约 2136 条记录，去重（重叠约 26%）后 1602 条，全文评估 200 篇，纳入 81 篇主要来源加 26 篇灰色文献，最终语料 107 篇并全部被引用。技术层面按统一 GOTO/SSA 中间表示剖析四大支柱：BMC + k-归纳、增量求解（push/pop）、IEEE 754 原生浮点理论（QF_FP）、上下文有界并发（context-BMC + 部分序约简）。AI 集成部分梳理 ESBMC-AI 修复闭环、LLM 生成循环不变式（由 SMT 校验归纳性）、Lemur 混合推理、SpecVerify 自然语言规格形式化等。比较评估以 SV-COMP 官方报告为排名依据。

Result: 核心结论：ESBMC 已从 2009 年的 SMT 原生 ANSI-C 验证器演化为多语言、多求解器、AI 耦合的平台——SMT 原生编码取代 bit-blasting，支持 9 种语言前端（ANSI-C、C++03、C++11+、CUDA、Solidity、Kotlin/Jimple、CHERI C、Python、Rust），内建多求解器组合（Z3、Bitwuzla、Boolector、MathSAT、CVC5、Yices 2）并按理论自动选路，BMC 与 k-归纳共用同一引擎，浮点与并发验证均无需切换工具。在 SV-COMP 2024 排名第 4（30 个验证器中），且在 10 秒 reachability 任务上为最快；累计 43 项竞赛奖（35 SV-COMP + 8 Test-Comp），另有 ICSE'11 与 ASE'24 杰出论文、ASE'23 最具影响力论文、SBSeg'23 最佳工具论文。AI 侧：ESBMC-AI 以形式化重验证为接受准则，缓冲区溢出/指针解引用修复率最高 80%（5 万 C 程序语料），Lemur 混合管线解出 107 个 SV-COMP 任务 vs 单独 ESBMC 的 68 个、47 个难任务中 25 vs 1；SpecVerify 在 9 个信息物理系统上达 46.5% 验证准确率且误报低于 NASA CoCoSim；FormAI 以 ESBMC 为大规模预言机审计了 7 个 LLM 的 112,000 个程序。产业侧：发现 Ethereum 共识规范（eth2spec）未公开的除零缺陷、DeFi 智能合约基准集零误报全检出、ARM RMM 固件 23 项 CBMC 遗漏的新违规；经济侧确认公共资助 ≥£9.3M + €4.98M（7 项资助，含 EU H2020 ELEGANT €4.98M、Soteria £5.8M），孵化 VeriBee（FuSeBMC，Test-Comp 2025/2026 金牌）。作者同时坦承局限：107 篇语料中 24%（正文引用 23%）为团队自引，SpecVerify 样本仅 9 个系统且准确率指标聚合掩盖了安全违规与误报的成本不对称，Solidity/FormAI 基准存在选择偏差，修复成功率按漏洞类别差异显著。

Conclusion: ESBMC 已被确立为"原生自主验证内核"而非被动校验后端：其差异化优势在于最宽的开源 BMC 求解器组合、原生浮点理论、上下文有界并发、唯一具备已发表且已评估 LLM 集成的开源 BMC 工具，以及可用于 CI/CD 的短超时性能；相对短板是缺乏快速终止不变式时 reachability 类覆盖不足。论文提出结构化未来议程：(1) 扩展组合式验证与抽象解释以对抗状态空间爆炸；(2) 神经符号验证的四类开放问题——LLM 非确定性的可复现性（与 SIL 等级挂钩）、LLM 生成规格的完备性、在 FormAI 等形式语料上的微调、反例自然语言解释的忠实性；(3) 补齐 Java/JavaScript/TypeScript、WebAssembly、VHDL/SystemVerilog、JML/ACSL 等语言空白，并实现多语言接口契约验证（含 FFI 边界语义错配的 blame 归属）；(4) 自主验证智能体架构中的工具接口标准化、信任校准与保证范围推理；(5) DO-178C/ISO 26262/IEC 61508 合规：可追溯证明产物、GSN/AADL 保障案例自动构造、ARINC/AUTOSAR 库操作模型，以及最关键的 DO-330 工具鉴定（建议采用"冻结特性版本 + 未鉴定研究分支"路线，类似 ASTRÉE/GNAT Pro）；(6) 量子软件验证与 SoC 硬件-软件协同验证所需的 SMT 理论扩展；(7) 将 WCET/实时调度约束纳入 BMC，实现功能与时序统一验证；(8) 反例可读性工程（分层可视化、领域模板、可用性指标）；(9) 开源可持续性治理——研究与商业分支分叉风险、贡献者集中度、版本化 API 稳定性。作者强调这些议题是工业规模落地的前置条件，而非外围议题。

Abstract: The Efficient SMT-Based Context-Bounded Model Checker (ESBMC) has grown from a research prototype for verifying embedded ANSI-C software into one of the most versatile and industrially capable formal verification platforms available today. Since its first publication in 2009, ESBMC has undergone persistent evolution: expanding its verification techniques, widening its language support to nine front-ends, integrating industrial-strength SMT solvers, and - most recently - coupling with Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents. This survey traces the full trajectory of ESBMC from its original design principles to the state of the art in 2025-2026, documenting 43 awards at SV-COMP and Test-Comp, its role as a formal verification backend for LLM-driven self-healing software and loop invariant generation, and the first industrial deployment of an integrated agentic model-checking architecture through the NVIDIA-OpenSMA framework, establishing ESBMC as a natively autonomous verification kernel rather than a passive validation backend. We synthesize its economic impact - over GBP 9.3 million and EUR 4.98 million in confirmed public research funding, the VeriBee spin-off, and a defense industrial deployment at Lockheed Martin - and conclude with a structured agenda of open challenges spanning scalability, neurosymbolic verification, counterexample intelligibility, cross-language verification, safety standards compliance, and open-source sustainability.

</details>


### [144] [A Universal Cliff and a Design Fingerprint: Cross-Section Defect Detection Under LLM Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26174)
*Hiroki Fukui*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了LLM编排系统在检测跨文档分区缺陷上的系统性失败：检测悬崖是机制衍生的且不可通过scale解决；最对齐的系统表现出报告标准偏移（漏检减少但误报增加）；集成报告置信度对跨分区缺陷无信息量，自动化检测不可靠。这挑战了"对齐=安全"的假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究多智能体编排系统对单一智能体可见的缺陷类别的影响：文档中两个远距离段落之间的矛盾（跨分区缺陷）。当系统通过不可见的worker agents编排来回答请求并重新组合成一份综合报告时，这种缺陷无法被单一worker检测到。

Method: 固定文档、缺陷机制、评分和种子，仅变化模型——来自同一开发者的五代十种系统，以及来自不同对齐范式的五个提供商。使用信号检测分解分析模型行为，区分报告标准和辨别能力的轴向变化。

Result: 发现两层现象：1）普遍检测悬崖：所有在单智能体下能检测跨分区缺陷的模型，在编排下失去该能力（检测率下降三分之二以上），且该悬崖源于机制本身，不能通过规模化或扩展推理关闭；2）行为分化：六个高于随机水平的模型中，仅有一个开发者的模型沿报告标准轴移动——对齐强化时，漏检减少但误报增加（p<0.001），其他开发者几乎无此现象。底层机制上，模型的私有记录能准确重建结构性故障，但综合报告签字认可其正确性。

Conclusion: 编排架构在跨段落缺陷检测上存在结构性缺陷，无法通过扩展推理或规模化解决。集成报告的置信度无法反映分区跨越缺陷，对齐最强的系统并非最安全的系统。检测器的自动化评判不稳定（精确率17-50%），且无法通过关键词与普通一致性区分。

Abstract: Production language-model systems answer a request by partitioning it across an invisible orchestration of worker agents that recompose one integrated report. We ask what this does to a class of defect no single worker can see: a contradiction in the relation between two distant sections of a document. Holding the documents, defects, mechanism, scoring, and seed fixed, we vary only the model -- ten systems across five generations from one developer and five providers from distinct alignment paradigms.
  Two layers separate. First, a universal detection cliff: every model that finds these cross-section defects under a single agent loses that ability under orchestration, detection falling two-thirds or more across every paradigm tested. The cliff is mechanism-derived and not closed by scale or extended reasoning. Second, how models behave once fallen. A signal-detection decomposition shows that, among the six models discriminating above chance, only one developer's generations move along the reporting-criterion axis: as alignment is strengthened, the model misses fewer defects yet raises more false alarms on clean documents -- two faces of one criterion shift, scaling with generation within that developer (p < 0.001) and near-absent elsewhere.
  At the floor the missed defect is often not out of view: the model's private record reconstructs the structural fault accurately, while the integrated report signs off on its soundness, its concern spent on the artifact and an absent collaborator. This resists quantification -- an automated judge is unstable (precision 17-50%) and keywords cannot separate it from ordinary agreement -- a resistance we report as a finding. We release all runs, probes, defect keys, scorer prompts, and scripts. An integrated report's confidence is uninformative about partition-spanning defects, the most aligned systems are not the safest, and the cliff is structural.

</details>


### [145] [RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26177)
*Hanyu Li,Yichi Zhang,Speed Zhu,Hang Su,Jun Zhu,Yinpeng Dong*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: RepoMirage 是一个基于 SWE-Bench Verified 构建的两阶段扰动式评测套件，用来检验代码智能体（code agents）的"仓库上下文推理"能力是否名副其实。作者发现：仅通过语义保持的仓库级扰动（依赖路径间接化、运行时目标遮蔽、本地值外置），8 个前沿模型的解决率就从平均 66.8% 降到 49.78%；进一步把这些扰动揭示的结构瓶颈改写成显式任务（RepoMirage-Extend）后，成功率降至 25.25%。轨迹分析显示智能体存在"探索漂移"——读更多文件却难以转化为编辑决策。为此作者提出结构优先的 RepoAnchor 工作流，把仓库结构探索与问题求解分离，通过中间 INSTRUCTION.md 传递结构锚点，带来稳定性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码智能体在 SWE-Bench Verified 等端到端仓库级基准上表现出色，但其高分是否真正来自"仓库上下文推理"（跨多文件定位任务相关信息并推理其关系）尚不清楚。初步分析显示：GPT-5 在已解决的实例中 53.8% 只查看了 1 个文件、88.0% 不超过 3 个文件，DeepSeek-V3.2 也有 55.7% 限于 3 个文件内，说明现有成功多依赖局部线索而非真正的多文件推理。若另建新基准又会引入新环境与新任务形式，使失败难以归因。因此作者需要一个受控评测：在保持任务语义与代码库实例不变的前提下，通过改变仓库"被暴露的方式"来选择性提高上下文推理需求，从而检验基准成绩的可靠性。

Method: 以 SWE-Bench Verified 为种子基准，所有模型统一用 mini-swe-agent 的标准 bash-only 设置（最多 250 步），保证框架、提示、执行环境与停止条件一致，仅替换后端模型，评测 8 个前沿模型（GPT-4.1、GPT-5、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-4.6、DeepSeek-V3.2、MiniMax-M2.7、Qwen3-Coder-Next、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B）。

（1）RepoMirage-Perturb：三类语义保持的仓库级扰动，均用 LibCST 基于语法树实现。① 依赖路径间接化：把绝对导入重路由为四层代理链（proxy chain），隐藏真实依赖；② 运行时目标遮蔽：重命名目标文件、原位置建同名包目录并用 __init__.py 动态加载重导出，另植入行为相近的诱饵文件（布尔反转、别名打乱、键名错配等）；③ 本地值外置：把目标文件中的常量抽取到外部 JSON（每 3 个一组），代码改为运行时加载合并。功能保持用 PASS_TO_PASS 脚本验证，可解性用"先打金补丁再扰动"后跑 FAIL_TO_PASS 验证。

（2）RepoMirage-Extend：在已扰动仓库上把每个扰动策略转化为显式任务族：多文件问题解决（保留金补丁跨多文件的实例）、代理链补全（抹掉链中间代理文件，需重建转发逻辑）、运行时目标识别（抹掉包装器对真实文件的引用，需在诱饵中判定真目标）、缺失常量恢复（删除 JSON 中的键但保留值，需从代码语义反推键名）。每个原始实例只归入一个任务族，各任务均有确定性 checker，且限制可修改文件范围以防走捷径。

（3）诊断与缓解：将 shell 命令按 edit/test/search/read 规则分类，合并 search+read 为 explore，计算 explore/edit/test 三状态转移概率、探索文件数与首次编辑前步骤占比；再以"结构提示"（只描述扰动机制与结构事实，不给具体答案）做对照实验；最后设计 RepoAnchor 两阶段流程：第一阶段只做结构探索并把结构摘要写入 INSTRUCTION.md（禁止改代码），第二阶段携带该摘要做实现与补丁生成。

Result: （1）RepoMirage-Perturb：8 模型平均解决率由 66.80% 降至 49.78%，相对降幅 15.96%（Claude-Sonnet-4.6）至 52.6%（GPT-4.1）；平均访问文件数由 4.77 升至 13.24（如 Qwen3-Coder-Next 由 4.66 增至 26.90）。消融显示三类扰动各自有效，叠加后低于任一单项。

（2）RepoMirage-Extend：同实例子集上平均成功率由原始 66.80% 降至 25.25%；分任务均值分别为多文件问题解决 17.86%、代理链补全 17.19%、运行时目标识别 28.26%、缺失常量恢复 33.94%。原任务排名与新任务排名不一致（如 MiniMax-M2.7 原始最强但 Extend 仅 14.80%）。

（3）行为诊断：探索文件数与首次编辑前探索占比显著上升，explore→explore 转移概率上升、explore→edit 下降，四个任务族均呈"探索漂移"；任务间还有差异（多文件任务中 test→explore 上升说明失败测试暴露更多相关文件；运行时目标任务更依赖运行时探针；常量恢复任务 test→explore 大幅上升）。

（4）结构提示干预显著提升：GPT-5 平均 27.60%→62.60%，DeepSeek-V3.2 39.80%→76.80%，其中代理链与常量任务提升最大。RepoAnchor 在 4 个模型、全部任务族上均带来稳定增益，且在多文件问题解决上优于仅给提示，说明结构摘要本身有效。

Conclusion: 代码智能体在仓库级问题解决基准上的高分并不等价于仓库上下文推理：基准成功往往来自文件名/路径/本地常量等局部线索，而非跨文件理解与推理。RepoMirage 通过语义保持的受控扰动把这一差距量化（66.8%→49.78%→25.25%），并揭示机制性瓶颈——探索漂移：智能体能获取更广上下文却难以把多文件证据组织成可用的结构脚手架，因而停留在反复探索而缺少编辑决策。提供结构提示与结构优先的 RepoAnchor 两阶段工作流（结构摘要作为中间锚点传递给求解阶段）均能显著提升性能，说明显式的结构感知建模是改进代码智能体上下文推理的可行方向。局限：当前仅支持 Python 仓库（语法树变换与运行时验证可行性所限）；任务形式仍偏经典的问题求解式修改，未来可扩展到代码评审、仓库级测试生成、重构与维护任务；工具以可执行生成/评测套件形式发布，不重新分发 SWE-Bench 仓库与镜像。

Abstract: Code agents are currently having skillful performance on repository-level software engineering benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether success on end-to-end tasks such as issue resolution truly reflects repository context reasoning, the ability to identify the task-relevant information across multiple files and reason over the relations among them. To investigate this question, we introduce RepoMirage, a two-stage evaluation suite built on SWE-Bench Verified that adopts perturbation as a diagnostic tool to increase the demand for context reasoning by transforming how the repository is exposed. First, RepoMirage-Perturb applies three types of semantics-preserving repository-level perturbations, revealing a clear performance drop when correct solving requires broader context access. RepoMirage-Extend further turns perturbation-targeted structural bottlenecks into explicit tasks beyond issue resolution, where the average performance declines from 66.8% in the original setting to 25.3%, indicating a significant deficiency in repository context reasoning. Further trajectory analysis reveals an exploration drift, where agents access broader repository context but fail to turn it into effective structure information. Motivated by this observation, we propose RepoAnchor, a structure-first prototype workflow that separates repository exploration from downstream problem solving, and show that explicit structural scaffolding yields notable gains. These results uncover an previously overlooked gap in repository context reasoning for code agents and suggest that stronger structure-aware methods are potential to improve them.

</details>


### [146] [SetupX: Can LLM Agents Learn from Past Failures in Functionality-Correct Code Repository Setup?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26186)
*Zihang Zhou,Ziqian Ren,Yukai Wu,Yingjie Xiong,Wei Zhou,Chao Peng,Dong Zhang,Bingheng Yan,Xuanhe Zhou,Fan Wu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: SetupX is an experiential learning-based framework for automating repository setup configuration. It addresses three key limitations of existing LLM agents through dual-modality experience representation (XPU), speculative execution with Docker-based rollback (LIFO snapshot stack), and a separated verification protocol (Prosecutor-Judge). The system achieves 92% pass rate with 19% improvement over state-of-the-art baselines.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Functionality-correct repository setup presents significant challenges due to diverse repository-specific failures (dependency incompatibilities, missing toolchains, incomplete installations, verification-strategy mismatches). Existing LLM agents fail to robustly resolve these issues in three aspects: cross-repository experience transfer, multi-step trial-and-repair under non-invertible state changes, and robust verification to distinguish setup-induced failures from repository bugs.

Method: SetupX proposes three core mechanisms: (1) XPU (Self-Evolving Experience Representation) - a dual-modality knowledge unit encoding setup signals, textual guidance and executable actions for cross-repository knowledge transfer; (2) Experience-Augmented Speculative Execution backed by LIFO Docker snapshot stack for safe trial-and-repair with rollback capability; (3) Prosecutor-Judge Verification Protocol separating evidence collection from final judgment for robust outcome verification.

Result: SetupX achieves 92% pass rate on carefully-crafted benchmarks, outperforming the strongest baseline by over 19%. The framework particularly excels in complex multi-repository setup requiring coordination of multiple interconnected services across different containers.

Conclusion: SetupX demonstrates significant practical value for automating complex repository setup tasks, particularly excelling in multi-repository scenarios requiring coordination of interconnected services. The open-source availability of the framework enables further research and application.

Abstract: Functionality-correct repository setup aims to configure execution environments (e.g., dependencies, build scripts) to successfully execute a repository's documented features. It presents significant challenges due to diverse, repository-specific failures, including dependency incompatibilities, missing toolchains, incomplete installations, and verification-strategy mismatches. Existing LLM agents struggle to robustly resolve these issues, specifically failing to support (1) cross-repository experience transfer, (2) multi-step trial-and-repair under non-invertible state changes, and (3) robust verification of setup outcomes to distinguish setup-induced failures from repository bugs. To address this, we introduce SetupX, an experiential learning-based setup framework. First, we construct a Self-Evolving Experience Representation (XPU), a dual-modality knowledge unit encoding setup signals, textual guidance, executable actions to dynamically transfer verified environment fixes to unseen repositories. Second, we employ Experience-Augmented Speculative Execution backed by a LIFO Docker snapshot stack, enabling the agent to proactively trial fixes and safely roll back to known-good states. Third, we introduce a Prosecutor-Judge Verification Protocol that separates evidence collection from final judgment, enabling more reliable setup verification beyond superficial build-time metrics. Evaluation results on carefully-crafted benchmarks show SetupX achieves highest performance (e.g., 92% pass rate) and outperforms the strongest baseline by over 19%. Crucially, SetupX excels in complex multi-repository setup requiring coordinating multiple interconnected services across different containers. The code repository is available at https://github.com/OpenDataBox/SetupX.

</details>


### [147] [Workflow Closure Is Not Scientific Closure in Auto-Research Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26200)
*Shuai Wang,Xinyuan Tian,Pangpang Liu,Yize Zhao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文（position paper），主张自动科研系统（auto-research systems）实现"工作流闭合"（workflow closure）并不等于"科学闭合"（scientific closure）。作者通过综述100+篇论文与仓库、并对21个代表性系统做结构化审计，诊断出"三层坍塌"（three-level collapse）模式：目标坍塌（L1，多目标科学目标被单一代理指标取代）、验证坍塌（L2，独立验证被系统内部自评取代）、验收坍塌（L3，基准分数或论文形态产出取代领域级批判、复用与整合机制）。三者互为因果，构成"为自主性而闭合"（closure-for-autonomy）的结构性代价。作者主张可信自动科研应追求"非自主认识论控制下的自主执行"，并给出目标账本、验证者溯源记录、声明包三项具体设计建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动科研系统（以 Karpathy 的 autoresearch、Nature 发表的 AI Scientist 为代表）已能内部完成"想法生成—实验执行—论文撰写—自评"的端到端闭环。当领域开始以"工作流完成度"和"基准分数"作为科研成功的代理指标时，一个危险的推论正在自然化：闭环即等价于科学成立。本文并非指责任何具体系统夸大，而是要指出这种结构性代理一旦被制度化，就会使系统持续优化"它能测量、验证和封装的东西"，而对科学成立所必需的外部条件（竞争目标、独立验证、领域采纳）暴露不足。作者希望在这一代理被自然化之前提醒社区，并说明这种坍塌是可纠正的设计选择而非自主性的固有极限。

Method: 方法上采用"综述+审计+设计建议"三段式：(1) 系统综述附录A，涵盖2025–2026年为主的100余篇论文与开源仓库，按基础模板、出版物形态端到端流水线、元层自改进、多智能体协作四大类梳理，并单独讨论技能系统、记忆系统、领域应用与边界系统；(2) 结构化审计表1/表2，对21个具有充分公开文档、可支撑完整L1/L2/L3编码的系统，按"Strong（完全由内部信号支配）/Weak（以边界内机制模拟外部介入）/Mitigated（真正外部操作被整合为循环有效性的约束条件）"三值编码规则判定，编码仅基于公开材料；(3) 立场性讨论部分界定诊断范围、反驳五类反对意见（工程里程碑论、基准可扩展性论、多样性即独立性论、科学一直依赖代理论、经典系统反例论），并把观测到的共现关系表述为"信息性不对称"而非因果证明或普遍性断言。

Result: 审计结果显示三层坍塌在结构上高度不对称：L1-strong 占81.0%（17/21），L2-strong 占71.4%（15/21），L3-strong 占90.5%（19/21）。即验收坍塌是补救最少的层（仅9.5%为weak），验证坍塌是补救尝试最多的层（28.6%为weak，多集中于跨模型评审、引用核验、留出对抗性检查等验证侧措施），目标坍塌居中（19.0%为weak，常见于反思式批判、多目标聚合、并行搜索等扩大决策前信息量的机制）。21个受审系统中无一在任一维度获得mitigated标签。边界对照案例显示，只要外部操作成为循环有效性的架构性组成部分，至少一层坍塌可被缓解：VML均衡半自主形式化（Lean 4验证器+在环数学家监督）缓解L1/L2，Latent-Y（湿实验验证）缓解L2，Robin（体外实验回路确认ripasudil与KL001）缓解L2，CRISPR-GPT（关键节点专家签署）亦为L2缓解路径。现有补救的两大共同缺陷是"未系统化"（逐系统各自定义、无通用协议）与"事后而非在环"（外部信号不进入主循环的纠正通道），且单维补救易被另两维的闭合结构重新吸收——加第二指标若验证仍在内部无效，加外部检查若不门控循环无效，加强基准若无外部批判通路亦无效。Zhang等人的实证发现（117篇智能体生成论文在纯稿件评审下达ICLR 2025加权均值水平，而在含产物的评审下分数骤降、实验严谨性为主要失效模式）与本文预测一致。作者亦审慎界定：本文不主张所有自动科研系统都存在坍塌，Coscientist、FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、ERA因云实验室/可执行评估等构成性外部约束而不属于该范式，Co-Scientist与Deep Research则属不同类别。

Conclusion: 核心结论是：从工作流闭合推断科学闭合在结构上不成立。可信自动科研不应追求认识论上的自足，而应追求"非自主认识论控制下的自主执行"——保留自主执行能力，放弃认识论自足性，把循环从"闭合于自身"改为"经由世界闭合"。三项对应设计建议：(1) 目标信号设计上把多目标当作架构原语而非在决策时被聚合掉的对象，采用不可约目标的Pareto前沿并维护"目标账本"（记录待满足目标、各项证据、冲突权衡、冲突未决时的决策规则，如ML论文可分列预测性能/校准/鲁棒性/算力成本/可解释性/可复现性，生物医学可分列机制合理性/实验可行性/安全约束/临床相关性）；(2) 验证者设计上使外部验证既"架构上必需"又"在环内"，维护"验证者溯源记录"（谁/什么验证了哪个主张、与生产者的独立性关系、检查了什么证据、结果是否改变了后续搜索），同族LLM评审在未绑定外部约束时不得计为独立验证；(3) 输出通道设计上产出"声明包"而非仅论文形态产物，含原子主张、证据链、代码与数据溯源、失败案例、已知局限与敏感性、外部用户复现/质疑/扩展的路径，高利害领域还须包含"停止规则"（何时必须让位、请求外部评审或拒绝视其为已可被领域采纳）。最终元原则是：接受是一个过程而非一个分数。

Abstract: This paper argues that workflow closure is not scientific closure in auto-research systems. Current systems can increasingly complete research-like loops internally, moving from idea generation to experiment execution, writing, and self-evaluation. That achievement is real, but it does not by itself give the resulting outputs scientific standing. We argue that trustworthy auto-research should not aim for autonomous self-sufficiency, but should aim for autonomous execution under non-autonomous epistemic control. Based on a survey of more than 100 recent papers and repositories in this rapidly emerging area, together with a structured audit of 21 representative systems, we diagnose a recurring and structurally connected failure pattern: objective collapse, in which single-proxy targets replace multi-objective scientific aims; validation collapse, in which internal self-evaluation replaces independent validation; and acceptance collapse, in which benchmark scores or publication-shaped artifacts replace mechanisms for domain-level critique, reuse, and integration. These collapses are not inherent limits of autonomy but correctable design choices. Accordingly, we outline potential remedies across objective signal, validation, and output pathway to spark community discussion.

</details>


### [148] [Verus-SpecGym: An Agentic Environment for Evaluating Specification Autoformalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26457)
*Anmol Agarwal,Natalie Neamtu,Pranjal Aggarwal,Seungone Kim,Jannis Limperg,Cedric Flamant,Kanna Shimizu,Bryan Parno,Sean Welleck*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文研究规范自动形式化问题，即LLM智能体能否将非形式化编程问题转化为忠实形式规范。提出Verus-SpecBench（581个任务）和Verus-SpecGym环境，通过exec_spec机制实现自动化评估。Gemini 3.1 Pro达77.8%准确率，开源模型仅21-25%。研究表明前沿模型的规范生成能力已可实用，但在边缘情况和评判机制上仍存在显著缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI编码智能体虽能生成带形式化证明的代码，但形式化规范本身可能偏离用户意图。规范自动形式化(spec autoformalization)——将非形式化编程问题转化为忠实的形式化规范——缺乏系统性研究，主要瓶颈在于评估困难：专家编写参考规范成本高，LLM评判可能遗漏细微错误。

Method: (1) 构建Verus-SpecBench基准：581个源自Codeforces问题的规范编写任务，基于Rust验证器Verus；(2) 开发Verus-SpecGym智能体环境，支持模型与Verus、bash及文件系统交互；(3) 扩展Verus的exec_spec机制使生成的规范可作为Rust代码执行；(4) 利用官方Codeforces测试用例及"hacks"对抗性用例进行自动化评估，规避依赖专家参考规范和高成本LLM评判的问题。

Result: Gemini 3.1 Pro解决77.8%任务，其他前沿模型51.1-57.8%，开源模型仅21.5-25.5%。失败模式包括：遗漏关键输入假设、接受错误输出、拒绝正确输出。LLM评判机制会遗漏评估器捕获的26%失败案例。

Conclusion: Spec autoformalization对于前沿模型已可实现（Gemini 3.1 Pro达77.8%），但对开源模型仍有较大差距（21.5-25.5%）。生成的规范存在遗漏输入假设、接受错误输出、拒绝正确输出等问题，且LLM评判机制会遗漏26%的失败案例，表明该任务在模型已能生成正确代码的问题上仍具脆弱性。

Code: https://github.com/formal-verif-is-cool/verus-spec-gym

Abstract: AI coding agents are increasingly used to write real-world software, but ensuring that their outputs are correct remains a fundamental challenge. Formal verification offers a promising path: an agent generates code together with a machine-checked proof, guaranteeing that the code satisfies a formal specification. However, there is no guarantee that the formal spec itself matches the user's intent. In this work, we study specification autoformalization: whether LLM agents can translate informal programming problems into faithful formal specifications. We introduce Verus-SpecBench, a benchmark of 581 spec-writing tasks derived from Codeforces problems targeting Verus, a verifier for Rust, and Verus-SpecGym, an agentic environment in which models interact with Verus, bash, & the filesystem to develop these specs. The central challenge is evaluation: expert-written reference specs are expensive to write, & LLM judges can miss subtle mistakes. We address this by (a) extending Verus's exec_spec mechanism so that generated specs can be executed as Rust code, & (b) testing them against official Codeforces tests & adversarial cases extracted from Codeforces "hacks", which are edge cases written by competitors to break incorrect solutions. On Verus-SpecBench, the strongest model, Gemini 3.1 Pro, solves 77.8% of tasks, other frontier models solve 51.1--57.8% & OSS models reach only 21.5--25.5%. Our analysis of failure modes shows that model-generated specs can omit important input assumptions, accept incorrect outputs, & reject valid ones. We also find that LLM-as-a-judge evaluation misses 26% of the failures our evaluator catches. Overall, our results suggest that spec autoformalization is within reach for frontier agents but remains brittle even on problems where they can already generate correct code. The code, data, & logs can be found at https://github.com/formal-verif-is-cool/verus-spec-gym

</details>


### [149] [Testing Agentic Workflows with Structural Coverage Criteria](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26521)
*Nafiseh Kahani,Mojtaba Bagherzadeh*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对多智能体工作流规格的结构测试方法，通过协调图覆盖率驱动与DSPy场景实现，验证工作流声明的结构（智能体、工具访问规则、限制、委托路径）是否被实际执行，为多智能体测试提供除语义和端到端评估之外的充分性评估层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多智能体系统评估主要依赖端到端任务成功率、基准分数或最终响应质量，缺乏对声明式协调结构（智能体、工具、访问规则、限制、委托路径）是否真正被执行的有效验证，难以评估测试套件充分性或检测结构性的工具访问、退避和智能体间委托回归。

Method: 将工作流表示为类型化协调图（typed coordination graph），从中导出覆盖义务（包括可达智能体、可允许工具边、受限工具边和委托边）；采用覆盖率驱动的生成方法，利用DSPy框架实现场景生成，将这些义务转化为自然语言场景，并通过运行时检查验证见证者（witnesses）。

Result: 在10个SDK衍生基准上测试（49个可达智能体、47个工具、403个结构义务），生成场景在有限优化预算内见证了54/75个可允许工具义务和36/48个委托义务；对抗性受限工具标准触发23/248个受限调用违规，成功区分了限制在探测下成立的系统与存在具体错误路由故障的系统。

Conclusion: 结构覆盖率（structural coverage）为多智能体工作流测试提供了一个有用的充分性评估层。它并不替代语义或端到端评估，但能揭示所声明的智能体、工具访问规则、限制和委托路径是否真正被执行。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems increasingly expose explicit workflow structure: agents, tools, tool-access rules, restrictions, and delegation paths. Existing evaluations rely largely on end-to-end task success, benchmark scores, final-response quality, or prompt-level checks, which provide limited evidence that this declared coordination structure has actually been exercised. This makes it difficult to assess test-suite adequacy or detect structural regressions in tool access, restrictions, and inter-agent delegation. We address this gap with a structural testing approach for multi-agent workflow specifications. The approach represents each workflow as a typed coordination graph, derives coverage obligations over reachable agents, allowed tool edges, restricted tool edges, and delegation edges, and uses coverage-driven generation with DSPy-based scenario realization to produce executable tests. The graph fixes what must be covered; DSPy realizes those obligations as natural-language scenarios whose witnesses are checked at runtime. We implement the approach for OpenAI Agents SDK-style workflows and evaluate it on ten SDK-derived benchmarks comprising 49 reachable agents, 47 tools, and 403 structural obligations. Generated scenarios witness 54/75 allowed-tool obligations and 36/48 delegation obligations within a bounded refinement budget. The adversarial restricted-tool criterion elicits 23/248 restricted-call violations, separating workflows whose restrictions hold under probing from workflows with concrete misrouting failures. These results show that structural coverage provides a useful adequacy layer for multi-agent workflow testing: it does not replace semantic or end-to-end evaluation, but reveals whether declared agents, tool-access rules, restrictions, and delegation paths have been exercised.

</details>


### [150] [FuzzPilot: Plateau-Triggered Recipe Validation for Structured Text Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26539)
*Zhiyi Yao*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: FuzzPilot 是包裹在 AFL++ 外层的一个"平台期触发"控制器：当覆盖率停滞时，它把语料库做快照，把昂贵的推理（LLM 提议、Ghidra 静态分析）移出变异热路径，生成候选"变异配方"（JSON 数据而非生成代码），在短时独立微基准 campaign 中验证，仅当奖励为正时才提升到主循环。该预印本仅在 cJSON 上做窄范围评估：cJSON 在中位 2,524 s 即触及 269 边上限（饱和），因此无法证明 LLM 提议能提升覆盖率。结论是吞吐基本持平（中位 execs/s 约 1.06×）、平台期中位数描述性变短（1,384 s vs 2,532 s，Mann–Whitney p=0.42 不显著），验证门评估 20 个模型配方全部因 R=0 被拒、零提升，消融反而指向"控制器快照/重启机制"而非模型或配方变异器是主要驱动。作者自我定位为可审计的实现报告与后续非饱和目标评估的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灰盒模糊测试的突变循环必须保持高速（小解析器上可达每秒数十万次执行），因此任何逐输入的 LLM 推理都会主导运行时间；已有 LLAMAFUZZ、FuzzCoder、Fuzz4All 等"在环内"方案要么接受这一代价，要么仅把模型放到并行辅助进程。G²FUZZ 确立了"把昂贵推理放在粗粒度时点、让产物可被原生复用"的设计契约，但它的中间表示是可执行 Python 生成器，只适用于二进制格式。针对结构化文本解析器（JSON/XML/SQL/ASN.1），语法级编辑用小型数据（操作码、偏移、字面量）表达比用代码更自然，且执行模型生成的代码带来网络/文件 I/O/死循环等运行时安全风险。由此本文提出三个开放问题：Q1 中间表示用代码还是数据；Q2 如何验证候选提议值得投入数小时主循环；Q3 无源码时静态上下文从何而来。

Method: 架构围绕单一不变式组织：任何 AFL++ 逐次变异路径上都不出现外部推理调用，仅在平台期检测器判定窗口停滞或微 campaign 完成需要裁决时调用模型。组件包括：(1) 平台期检测器，用滑动窗口 W=10 s、θ_e=50 execs、θ_p=1 path 判定停滞并冻结语料快照；(2) 黑板 JSON，汇聚快照、fuzzer_stats 与 Ghidra 静态上下文，作为 LLM 唯一视图；(3) 9 个角色特化的 agent（coordinator、plateau-diagnosis、scheduler、cmp-hint、dictionary、format、mutator、corpus、crash-triage）产出配方；(4) 配方存储，schema 校验的 JSON（≤2 KB），字段含 id、selector、priority/ttl、operator_weights、focus/protect_ranges、dictionary_tokens、expected_signal，序列化为 CompactRecipe 二进制缓存；(5) 7 个闭集字节级算子（BitFlip、OverwriteRange、InsertToken、Arith、Splice、DeleteBlock、DictionaryOverwrite）由原生自定义 mutator 按权重采样分派，无解释器、无嵌套控制流；(6) 微 campaign 门，每轮用 K_cand=4 个候选（default/dictionary/seed_focus/per_seed_recipe）在私有目录跑 N=20 s 隔离 AFL++，奖励 R=α·Δedges+γ·Δcrashes+δ_h·h−δ_m·m（α=1.0、γ=10、δ_h=1e-3、δ_m=5e-4，无 bitmap 时 β=0.5 替换 Δedges），仅 R>0 才提升，否则输出 winner_decided:no_significance 与 promotion_skipped:no_successful_micro_campaign；(7) Ghidra headless 静态通道，一次性提取 top-20 危险函数（危险分 = 10×{gets,system,popen}+5×{strcpy,strcat}+4×{sprintf}+3×{malloc,free,memcpy,memmove}+2×{printf}）、≤150 magic_tokens、≤100 cmp_constants、≤150 branch_constraints、top-5 函数反编译 C（各截 4 KB），同一份 static_context.json 同时供给 agent 黑板与微 campaign 的 -x 字典。实验：4 核 Xeon E5-2699 v4 / 8 GB / Ubuntu 24.04，AFL++ v4.21c，AFL_MAP_SIZE=65536，26 个手选 JSON 种子，每轮 14,400 s；主臂 baseline-afl 与 full-agent 各 N=5，消融 rule-only/no-mutator/no-static-analysis 各 N=3，公平性基线 baseline-afl-dict 与 baseline-afl-cmplog 各 N=3；模型为 deepseek-chat（T=0，API 花费 $0.002/4h campaign）。统计用双侧 Mann–Whitney U（exact, N≤8）、Vargha–Delaney A12、10,000 次百分位 bootstrap 中位数 CI；微基准用 SIGSTOP 隔离 AFL worker 串行运行。

Result: (1) 覆盖率：两种模式都收敛到 269 边上限（bitmap_cvg 23.21%），baseline 5/5 达到、full-agent 4/5 达到（r02 仅 266），无任何模式超过上限——cJSON 饱和。(2) 平台期：baseline 中位 last_find 11,911 s、平台期 2,532 s；full-agent 13,059 s、1,384 s，描述性 −45.3%（−1,148 s），但 Mann–Whitney U=8、p=0.42、A12=0.68，bootstrap 95% CI（[539,3,970] vs [238,3,226]）几乎完全重叠，不显著。(3) 端点自由指标：到 264/268 边各模式几乎相同（60/660 s vs 120/662 s），到 269 边 baseline 中位 2,524 s 反而早于 full-agent 的 6,702 s——"平台期更短"实为"更晚才触顶"。(4) 吞吐：full-agent/baseline 中位 execs/s 比 1.059×（13,816/13,049），通过 ≥0.85 门限；微基准 fp-active/fp-empty 中位比 1.016×、均值比 0.869×（Welch p=0.45），TOST ±5% 等价性 p=0.68 未建立；fp-empty/vanilla 中位 1.529× 通过 ≤5× 门限。(5) LLM 层：45 次调用中 43 次 schema 合法（95.6%），2 次非法且未触发回退；每轮仅触发 1 次平台期，共评估 5×4=20 个候选，全部 Δedges=Δpaths=Δcrashes=0，故 R=0、零提升，主循环全程运行默认 DictionaryAgent 配方 {FUZZ, MAGIC, TOKEN}——这验证了门的"无误报"一半，但未验证"能区分好坏"一半。(6) 消融（描述性，均不显著）：no-static-analysis 234 s < no-mutator 930 s (p=0.14, A12=0.87) < rule-only 1,165 s (p=0.39) < full-agent 1,384 s < baseline 2,532 s；若配方变异器是主因，移除它应变差而非变好，排序与该假设矛盾；no-static-analysis 呈双峰分布 [187, 234, 4,454]，中位不可靠。(7) cycles_done：baseline 中位 797 vs full-agent 140（约 5.7× 少），no-mutator 671 接近 baseline，rule-only 119，说明差异源于配方变异器导致每轮执行次数变多而非 LLM；但作者强调 cycles_done 是派生量，不能当作"进度"指标。(8) 公平性：AFL++ -x 字典臂中位平台期 2,256 s (p=0.79)、cmplog 臂 2,367 s (p=1.00)，均未缩小差距，但 cmplog 三次全部达到 270 边，比 FuzzPilot 的 269 多一条边——绝对覆盖轴上的负面结果。(9) 成本：DeepSeek API 全 5 轮共约 ¥0.07（≈$0.01），单次调用 $0.0002、单个 4 h campaign $0.002，远低于约 $1.60 的计算成本。

Conclusion: 本版本只能读作"可审计的实现报告 + cJSON 概念验证"，而非性能提升的证据。核心结论有三：(1) 控制路径可以被工程化——把昂贵推理完全移出 AFL++ 逐次变异热路径，吞吐不降反微升（中位 1.06×），且全链路（黑板状态→提议→配方→奖励→提升判定）可从 append-only 审计日志逐条重放，便于验证零提升是 R=0 的真实证据而非控制器缺陷；(2) 在饱和目标上，模型提议层的价值完全未被证明：20 个候选全部零奖励、零提升，这既说明门是保守的（无误报），也说明其"可区分好坏"的核心能力仍未验证；消融的点估计排序（移除配方变异器反而缩短平台期）反而把归因指向控制器的平台期检测与语料重组/重启机制，但缺少 controller-only 消融臂使其只能停留在假设层面；(3) 存在明确的负面结果：cmplog 能多覆盖 1 条边，说明 FuzzPilot 并未改善绝对覆盖；两者作用轴不同（墙钟时间轴 vs 覆盖轴），可互补但当前 CLI 不支持组合。主要局限：单一饱和目标、统计功效不足（N=5/3，远低于 Klees 等建议的 N≥20）、调参与评测共用同一 26 文件种子语料（无 hold-out 划分，存在数据泄漏可能）、字节级而非 AST 级的算子词汇、无语法感知的修复算子、缺少 controller-only/ai-direct/random-recipe 消融与超参敏感性扫描。后续工作为最重要：非饱和目标（libxml2 ~30k 边、sqlite3 ~150k 边、openssl X.509 ~80k 边，60 s 冒烟已可达 2,776/6,922/3,635 边）的矩阵、N≥20/≥10 重复数与正式秩和检验、controller-only 消融、以及与 G²FUZZ 的正面对比。

Abstract: FuzzPilot is a controller for AFL++ that moves expensive reasoning out of the mutation hot path. When coverage plateaus, it snapshots the corpus, prepares candidate mutation recipes, evaluates them in short isolated AFL++ micro-campaigns, and promotes only recipes with positive validation reward. Recipes are JSON data, not generated code: a native custom mutator consumes operator weights, byte ranges, corpus-selection rules, and dictionary tokens. Candidate recipes can come from local rules or from a language-model agent, with Ghidra-derived constants and decompiled context as target hints. This preprint reports a deliberately narrow cJSON evaluation. We compare vanilla AFL++ and the full FuzzPilot agent over five 14,400 s repetitions per arm. cJSON is saturated: baseline AFL++ reaches the exposed 269-edge ceiling at a median of about 2,500 s. The experiments therefore do not show that language-model proposals improve coverage or generalize beyond cJSON. Within this scope, FuzzPilot preserves throughput (median execs_per_sec about 1.06x baseline), shows a descriptively shorter median plateau (1,384 s versus 2,532 s), but the difference is not statistically significant at N=5 (Mann-Whitney p=0.42). The validation gate evaluated 20 model-proposed recipes and promoted none because all rewards were zero. The observed plateau reduction is more likely due to controller snapshot and restart machinery than to the model or recipe mutator. This version is best read as an auditable implementation report and baseline for ongoing non-saturated-target evaluation.

</details>


### [151] [Governed Evolution of Agent Runtimes through Executable Operational Cognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27328)
*Mariano Garralda-Barrio*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: This paper addresses the governance gap in agentic systems where code is treated as executable runtime substrate. It proposes a framework for governed runtime evolution, formalizing agent artifacts as persistent capabilities and introducing HarnessMutation as a lifecycle-aware adaptation mechanism with validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prior work (Code as Agent Harness) treats agent-generated artifacts as runtime entities, but governance, lifecycle management, and operational evolution remain under-specified.

Method: Formalizes agent-generated artifacts as persistent runtime capabilities; introduces HarnessMutation as a governed mechanism operating under validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints; models evolution as bounded and observable process over persistent operational memory.

Result: Proposes a framework enabling runtime adaptation while maintaining explicitness, auditability, and constraints.

Conclusion: Provides a conceptual foundation for adaptive infrastructures whose evolution remains explicit, auditable, and constrained; operationalized through modern agent runtimes and governance-oriented orchestration systems.

Abstract: Recent advances in agentic systems increasingly treat code as an executable operational substrate rather than as a disposable output artifact. Prior work such as \emph{Code as Agent Harness} frames validated agent-generated artifacts as runtime entities that can be created, executed, revised, persisted, and reused within long-running cognitive loops. However, the governance, lifecycle management, and operational evolution of such artifacts remain under-specified.
  This paper proposes a framework for governed runtime evolution in multi-agent systems through executable operational cognition. We formalize agent-generated artifacts as persistent runtime capabilities that progressively become part of the operational substrate rather than transient intermediate outputs. Building on this perspective, we introduce \emph{HarnessMutation} as a governed mechanism for lifecycle-aware runtime adaptation operating under explicit validation, traceability, evaluation, and rollback constraints.
  Rather than treating runtime adaptation as unrestricted self-modification, the proposed framework models evolution as a bounded and observable process over persistent operational memory. It further shows how these ideas can be operationalized over modern agent runtimes and governance-oriented orchestration systems, providing a conceptual foundation for adaptive infrastructures whose evolution remains explicit, auditable, and constrained.

</details>


### [152] [TrajAudit: Automated Failure Diagnosis for Agentic Coding Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26563)
*Minxing Wang,Xiaofei Xie,Yintong Huo*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出TrajAudit，首个用于仓库级编码轨迹的失败诊断框架。该框架通过信息过滤和先验知识注入解决长轨迹噪声问题，实验表明其在准确率和效率上均显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化失败诊断方法在轨迹长度和复杂度增加时效果显著下降。仓库级编码任务轨迹充满噪声（冗余程序结构、冗长代码上下文），且轨迹非常长，而长上下文推理正是LLM的已知弱点。

Method: TrajAudit框架包含一个调查员智能体(investigator agent)，配备两个核心模块：(1)通过模式匹配和关键词检测过滤失败无关信息；(2)从测试失败报告中生成初步诊断作为先验知识。调查员智能体还可按需调用工具检索过滤后的内容，保留关键信息同时最小化噪声。

Result: 在RootSE基准测试上，TrajAudit在定位准确率上超过所有基线方法24.4个百分点以上，同时将token消耗降低至少18%。

Conclusion: TrajAudit demonstrates practical effectiveness for failure diagnosis in agentic software engineering, outperforming baselines while reducing token consumption. The work draws community attention to failure management in agentic SE and provides RootSE as a foundational resource for future research.

Abstract: Agentic systems have been widely studied to automate software engineering jobs such as bug fixing. As these systems increasingly tackle complex tasks, understanding where and why they fail becomes essential for iterative refinement and operational reliability. Existing automated failure diagnosis approaches leverage task execution trajectories, yet their effectiveness degrades substantially as trajectory length and complexity increase. For repository-level coding tasks specifically, trajectories are laden with noise, such as redundant program structure and verbose code context. Moreover, these trajectories are very long, while long-context reasoning remains a known weakness of LLMs.
  To address these two challenges, we propose TrajAudit, the first failure diagnosis framework for repository-level coding trajectories. TrajAudit employs an investigator agent supported by two modules: one filters failure-irrelevant information through pattern matching and keyword detection, and the other generates a preliminary diagnosis from test failure reports as prior knowledge, helping the agent handle noisy long contexts. The investigator agent can further invoke tools to retrieve filtered content on demand, ensuring that critical information is preserved while noise is minimized. We also introduce RootSE, a benchmark of 93 real-world agentic failure instances sourced from software maintenance tasks, representing the most complex trajectory diagnosis benchmark to date. Experiments on RootSE show that TrajAudit outperforms all existing baselines by over 24.4 percentage points in localization accuracy, while reducing token consumption by at least 18%, demonstrating its practical effectiveness. We hope this work draws community attention to failure management in agentic software engineering and provides a foundational resource for future research.

</details>


### [153] [Energy-Aware Decision Making in Software Stack Upgrades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26609)
*Mirko Stocker,Michael Wahler*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 本文提出一种系统化方法，通过自动化基准测试测量Spring Boot和JVM等核心软件组件不同版本对应用能耗的影响；研究发现能耗在不同版本间差异显著，较新JVM版本和虚拟线程可带来显著节能，表明软件升级决策应纳入能耗考量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软件栈升级虽常见，但升级对能耗的影响尚不清晰，而能耗正成为组织追求可持续发展的关注重点。

Method: 通过自动化基准测试评估框架版本、运行时版本和执行平台的组合，使用Spring Petclinic REST应用作为案例研究。

Result: Spring Boot和JVM版本间的能耗存在显著差异，部分情况下出现意外的能耗回退；较新的JVM版本和虚拟线程（Java 21和23引入）带来显著节能，无需修改应用代码。

Conclusion: 软件升级会对能耗产生实质影响，能耗测量为软件维护和演进的决策提供了有价值的数据支撑；组织在进行软件栈升级时，应将能耗纳入评估维度。

Abstract: Software stack upgrades are a routine part of software maintenance and evolution, typically motivated by improved performance, stability, or functionality. Yet their impact on energy consumption - a growing concern for organizations pursuing sustainability - remains poorly understood. This paper presents a systematic method for measuring how different versions of core software stack components, such as Spring Boot and the Java Virtual Machine (JVM), influence the energy consumption of applications. Our approach evaluates combinations of framework versions, runtime versions, and execution platforms through automated benchmarking. Using a case study based on the Spring Petclinic REST application, we show that energy consumption varies substantially across Spring Boot and JVM versions, in some cases producing unexpected regressions. Notably, newer JVM releases and virtual threads (introduced in Java 21 and 23) yielded significant energy savings without requiring application changes. These results demonstrate that software upgrades can meaningfully affect energy usage and that measuring energy consumption provides valuable evidence for decision making in software maintenance and evolution.

</details>


### [154] [Software Engineering Podcasts: An Empirical Study of Their Potential as a Research Resource](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26793)
*Marvin Wyrich,Marcos Kalinowski,Adolfo Neto,Sven Apel*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 研究系统性地探索软件工程播客领域，分析其内容，并对研究人员进行调查，以评估播客作为推进实证软件工程研究的资源价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 播客在软件工程社区中日益流行，但目前对SE播客的实际内容以及研究人员如何看待和使用它们知之甚少，亟需系统性的了解。

Method: 系统性地分析SE播客内容，并对研究人员进行调查。

Result: 分析SE播客景观，评估其作为研究资源的潜力。

Conclusion: SE播客不仅是从业者的有价值资源，也可能成为研究人员理解该领域演变的有效工具。

Abstract: Podcasts have become an increasingly popular medium for knowledge sharing within the software engineering (SE) community, offering insights into industry developments and the perspectives of professionals with different backgrounds. As this medium grows, it presents a potentially valuable resource not only for practitioners but also for researchers seeking to understand the evolving field. However, little is known about the actual content of SE podcasts or how they are perceived and used by researchers. This study systematically explores the SE podcast landscape, analyzing its content and surveying researchers to assess how podcasts can serve as a meaningful resource for advancing empirical software engineering research.

</details>


### [155] [HTMLCure: Turning Browser Experience into State Guided Repair for Interactive HTML](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26807)
*Jiajun Wu,Jian Yang,Tuney Zheng,Wei Zhang,Haowen Wang,Yihang Lou,Xianglong Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: HTMLCure通过交互式浏览器评估和闭环修复机制，将97K提示词扩展为63K质量清理页面并最终筛选出40K高质量SFT数据，使27B模型达到与Kimi-K2.6/GPT-5.4相当的性能水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM生成的HTML页面仅在初始渲染时正确，但在滚动、悬停、点击、调整大小或交互操作时容易失败。基于截图的评估方法无法检测这些交互故障，而简单过滤会丢弃大量仍可修复的页面。

Method: HTMLCure是一个浏览器体验框架，包含评估引擎和闭环修复引擎。评估引擎在多种视口和交互状态下执行页面，记录确定性浏览器证据并提取curated keyframes；修复引擎基于诊断结果选择状态特定的修复方案，对候选页面进行迭代测试和筛选。

Result: 从97K提示词扩展到63,703个质量清理后的候选页面，最终构建40K高质量SFT数据集。在HTMLBench-400上达到50.6分（45.2%确定性测试通过率），在MiniAppBench验证集上达到81.2平均分，较原始27B SFT提升15.3点。

Conclusion: HTMLCure enables a 27B model to reach performance comparable to strong reference systems (Kimi-K2.6, GPT-5.4) through quality-cleared SFT data, demonstrating that systematic interaction evaluation and targeted repair significantly enhance generated web pages without architectural changes.

Abstract: LLMs can now produce full HTML pages, but many of those pages are only superficially correct: they render once, then fail under scroll, hover, click, resize, or gameplay. Evaluation from screenshots can miss these failures, and filtering discards many pages that are still repairable. We introduce HTMLCure, a browser experience framework that evaluates HTML after the system has interacted with it. The evaluator executes the page across viewports and interaction states, records deterministic browser evidence, and gives the VLM curated keyframes from the executed trajectory rather than isolated screenshots. The same state signal drives a closed loop repair engine: HTMLCure diagnoses the current page, chooses a state specific repair family, runs each candidate again, and exports quality cleared pages for SFT. On a 97K prompt corpus, this expands the directly usable seed into a candidate pool of 63703 quality cleared pages, from which we construct the final refined SFT set of 40K pages. Under the same backbone and training recipe, HTMLCure-27B-Refined reaches 50.6 on HTMLBench-400 with 45.2% deterministic test case pass, placing it in the same performance band as strong reference rows such as Kimi-K2.6 and GPT-5.4. On the released MiniAppBench validation split, it reaches 81.2 average, improving raw 27B SFT by 15.3 points and approaching the level of strong reference systems.

</details>


### [156] [On the GitHub Actions Language: Usage, Evolution, and Workflow Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26825)
*Aref Talebzadeh Bardsiri,Alexandre Decan,Tom Mens*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该研究通过对49K仓库中260K个工作流进行大规模实证分析，揭示GitHub Actions语言构造的使用模式和演化趋势，为改善工作流自动化实践提供实证依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发者在维护GitHub Actions工作流配置时面临困难，近期研究表明工作流执行失败现象频繁发生，亟需深入理解语言特性对工作流可靠性和可维护性的影响。

Method: 对49K GitHub仓库中的260K个工作流进行定量分析，时间跨度从2019年7月到2025年8月。将197个语言构造映射到14个功能特性，分析其使用模式及演变趋势。

Result: 仅少量语言构造和特性被高频使用；更大更复杂的工作流关联更高失败率和更多维护工作量；识别出与可靠性和可维护性风险相关的特定特性。

Conclusion: 研究发现，只有少部分语言构造和特性被高频使用，而更大更复杂的工作流与更高的失败率和维护成本相关。识别出特定特性与可靠性和可维护性风险相关，为从业者和研究人员提供了改进GitHub Actions自动化实践的见解。

Abstract: Developers often struggle with maintaining GitHub Actions workflow configurations in GitHub-hosted repositories, with recent studies showing frequent execution failures. This paper empirically explores how the adoption and evolution of GitHub Actions language constructs impacts workflow reliability and maintainability. To do so, we quantitatively analyse 260K workflows from 49K GitHub repositories to understand how they are used in practice and how their usage has evolved from July 2019 to August 2025. We identify 197 language constructs available in the GitHub Actions language and map them to 14 features reflecting workflow capabilities. We observe that only a small set of constructs and features are used very frequently, and that larger and more complex workflows are associated with higher failure rates and more maintenance effort. We identify specific features that are more likely to be linked with reliability and maintainability risks. These insights can help practitioners and researchers improve their understanding and usage of the GitHub Actions language, which can help in improving and sustaining workflow automation practices.

</details>


### [157] [LLM-based Mockless Unit Test Generation for Java](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26851)
*Qinghua Xu,Guancheng Wang,Lionel Briand,Zhaoqiang Guo,Kui Liu*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: MocklessTester通过上下文增强和约束强制修复策略解决了LLM生成无模拟器单元测试时的幻 hall闭问题，在多个基准上显著提升覆盖率但计算成本较高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的Java单元测试生成方法仍依赖模拟框架，而无模拟器测试可执行更多真实底层代码，但面临幻 hall闭生成、语言约束不遵循、依赖感知不足等挑战，这些挑战源于"不知道"（缺乏足够上下文）和"不遵循"（即使提供约束也无法遵守）两类问题。

Method: 提出MocklessTester，采用上下文增强生成策略（从现有代码中挖掘真实使用模式）和约束强制修复策略（符号级、协议级、迭代级三层约束的两阶段修复），并结合ClassIndex、Markov类型状态模型和经验记忆库。

Result: 在Defects4J和Deps4J上，MocklessTester分别提升行覆盖率19.99%/22.69%、分支覆盖率24.90%/15.78%、突变评分13.67%/0.17%；额外覆盖依赖类378和55行代码；Defects4J上平均每方法耗时108.97秒/26.59k tokens，Deps4J上69.85秒/25.46k tokens；消融实验验证各主要组件均正向贡献。

Conclusion: MocklessTester显著提升了无模拟器测试生成的质量，覆盖率和突变评分均大幅改善，虽然计算成本较高但仍在实际范围内，且各主要组件均对性能有正向贡献。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong potential for automated test generation, yet most approaches to generating Java unit tests still rely on mocking frameworks to handle dependencies. Mockless test generation could exercise more real low-level code, but it faces challenges such as invalid test code generation due to hallucination, strict language constraints, and inadequate dependency awareness. We identify two causes behind these hallucinations: not knowing, where the LLM lacks sufficient context, and not following, where the LLM fails to comply with constraints even when they are provided.
  We present MocklessTester, a mockless unit test generation approach built around two strategies: context-enriched generation and constraint-enforced fixing. To mitigate not knowing, context-enriched generation mines real usage patterns from existing code to generate tests. To mitigate not following, constraint-enforced fixing performs two-stage repair under symbol-, protocol-, and iteration-level constraints, using a ClassIndex, a Markov typestate model, and experience memory.
  We evaluate MocklessTester against the state-of-the-art baseline on Defects4J and Deps4J. Results show that MocklessTester improves line coverage by 19.99% and 22.69% and branch coverage by 24.90% and 15.78% on the two benchmarks, respectively, and improves mutation score by 13.67% and 0.17%. Beyond the class under test, MocklessTester also exercises more real dependency code, covering 378 and 55 additional lines in dependency classes, respectively. The improvement in test quality comes with higher total token and time costs than the baseline. Nevertheless, the cost per method remains practical, averaging 108.97 seconds and 26.59k tokens on Defects4J, and 69.85 seconds and 25.46k tokens on Deps4J. Ablation results confirm that all major components contribute positively to the final performance.

</details>


### [158] [Strategies for Guiding LLMs to Use Software Design Patterns: A Case of Singleton](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26898)
*Viktor Kjellberg,Farnaz Fotrousi,Miroslaw Staron*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: 该论文研究了如何引导LLM在生成的代码中融入设计模式，以Singleton模式为案例，在13个LLM上测试了四种提示策略。结果表明迭代二元反馈总体效果最佳，且即使简单策略也能有效指导LLM应用设计模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽能根据自然语言提示生成功能性源代码，但往往无法一致地遵循高层架构结构或设计模式。随着LLM在软件工程领域的应用日益广泛，其将既定设计原则应用于生成代码的能力对软件产品的长期成功至关重要。

Method: 设计计算实验，在164个Java编码挑战题（来自HumanEval-X）上评估13个LLM使用四种提示策略生成符合Singleton设计模式代码的能力。四种策略包括：指令式、二元自动反馈、扩展自动反馈，以及结合少样本提示的扩展反馈。

Result: 最佳引导策略高度依赖于模型类型。总体而言，迭代二元反馈在保持或提升代码功能性同时，实现了与Singleton模式的最佳对齐。Llama 3.3通过指令引导在100%的情况下生成Singleton类，测试通过率提升34.1个百分点。Qwen 3 (8B)使用二元反馈后，Singleton对齐度达99.2%，功能性达58.6%。

Conclusion: 即使简单的策略也能有效引导LLM在生成的代码中使用设计模式。研究表明，不同模型对策略的响应差异较大，但迭代二元反馈总体上能实现Singleton模式对齐与代码功能性的最佳平衡。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate functional source code from natural-language prompts, but often fail to consistently follow higher-level architectural structures or design patterns. Since LLMs are increasingly used in software engineering, their ability to apply established design principles to generated code is crucial to the long-term success of software products. Therefore, the goal of this paper is to identify strategies for guiding LLMs to incorporate design patterns into the generated source code. We designed a computational experiment to evaluate the ability of 13 LLMs to generate code that follows the Singleton design pattern, using four prompting strategies: instructions, binary automated feedback, extensive automated feedback, and extensive feedback with few-shot prompts, in 164 Java coding challenges from HumanEval-X. Our results shows that the optimal strategy to guide LLMs to include design patterns depends heavily on the type of model. Still, overall, iterative binary feedback provides the best alignment with Singleton while preserving or improving the code's functionality. With guiding with instructions, Llama 3.3 generated Singleton classes in 100% of cases and improved code functionality, increasing the number of tests passed by 34.1 percentage points. It achieved a similar result with guidance through instructions and binary feedback. Qwen 3 (8B) increased the alignment with Singleton to 99.2% and the functionality to 58.6% using binary feedback. Our result suggests that even simple strategies can be used to guide LLMs to use design patterns.

</details>


### [159] [ConVer: Using Contracts and Loop Invariant Synthesis for Scalable Formal Software Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.27051)
*Muhammad A. A. Pirzada,Weiqi Wang,Yiannis Charalambous,Konstantin Korovin,Lucas C. Cordeiro*

Main category: cs.SE

TL;DR: ConVer 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的自顶向下组合式 C 程序形式化验证工具：从 main() 的系统级断言出发，由 LLM 合成各函数契约（前置条件/后置条件/assigns），在 CEGAR-CEGIS 循环中交替执行系统级检查（调用替换为契约桩）与函数级检查（实现对契约的符合性检查），失败时通过 SMART ICE 学习（正例/负例/蕴含例分类）驱动契约精化，并在需要时按需合成循环不变式；还提出 ESBMC-LF 预处理器把 Lingua Franca 模型转成保留验证属性的 C 代码。实验覆盖 Frama-C(45)、LF2C-Simple(17)、X.509(6)、VerifyThis(11)、LF-Hard(24) 共 79+24 个程序，在 Qwen-Plus、Claude Haiku 4.5、GPT-OSS 120b 三种后端下分别取得 82–96%、82–88%、33–50%、55–64% 与 46–62% 的验证成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型 C 程序的形式化验证受制于状态空间爆炸：有界模型检查（BMC，如 ESBMC、CBMC）必须将程序展开到预设界限并编码整个状态空间，函数调用与循环嵌套都会使求解器负担迅速增长，导致超过数百行的程序基本无法验证。传统缓解手段是手写函数契约，但这一工作专家密集、实践中采纳率低（即便 AWS 的 s2n-tls 等资源充足项目也需专职验证工程师投入大量标注），且自底向上逐个函数写规格的负担极大。作者希望：①以自顶向下的属性分解降低规格负担——只需契约刻画系统属性所要求的内容，而非函数全部语义；②用 LLM 自动化契约的生成与精化，把人从标注工作中解放出来，同时保持验证决策由模型检查器承担以确保可靠性（soundness）；③扩展到循环密集、递归密集及真实世界的指针密集型代码（如 X.509 解析器）这类 BMC 难以直接处理的场景。

Method: 1) 自顶向下属性分解：以 main() 中单一顶层 assert() 为系统属性 φ，抽取函数集合 F，按复杂度阈值 τ 将函数分为低复杂度集 F_L 与高复杂度集 F_H；低复杂度函数由 LLM 合成精确契约，高复杂度函数生成“sound but loose”的过近似抽象契约（较弱的 ensures 如空指针安全、值域界，加上覆盖所有可能被修改全局量的 assigns），LLM 失败时用启发式回退生成平凡 ensures 与基于函数体扫描的 assigns。

2) 双层验证（基于 ESBMC 8.1.0 的函数契约与循环不变式机制）：系统级（Replace 模式）将调用替换为抽象桩 abs(P,Q,s0)={s | P(s0) ∧ Q(s0,s)}，仅 havoc assigns 指定位置，不探索函数内部；函数级（Enforce 模式）假设前置条件、执行真实实现、断言后置条件，即证明 ∀s0. P(s0) ⇒ ⟦f⟧(s0) ∈ abs(P,Q,s0)，等价于标准 Hoare 三元组。两级皆通过即由替换（substitution）得出端到端可靠性。

3) CEGAR 主循环（最多 5 轮）：每轮根据反例精化契约并重新验证；函数级失败指示 LLM 放松契约，系统级失败指示 LLM 加强契约，二者方向相反；出现停滞时以 Delta Debugging 变体作为“停滞破除器”，逐条删除停滞函数的后置条件子句直至通过。

4) CEGIS 升级（再最多 5 轮，累计 10 轮预算，超出则判为 inconclusive）：构建约束数据库 D，累积正例 E+（通过配置）、负例 E−（必须排除的状态）、蕴含例（由程序行为与函数体结构模式推断的归纳关系），每次合成都在完整约束集条件下进行，并从 CEGAR 迁移已有反例。

5) SMART ICE 反例处理管线：解析 ESBMC 原始输出，区分工具级失败（超时/内部错误/解析拒绝，单独记录）与语义反例；后者再分类为语法错误、未解析、工具错误、未受约束初始化、语义违反，仅将“语义违反”与“未受约束初始化”纳入 E− 以抑制噪声；对系统级失败将变量映射到责任函数，计算 gap 分数并标记最弱环节函数，最终渲染为结构化诊断块（轨迹 + E+/E− 分析）注入 LLM 提示。

6) 循环不变式按需合成：ESBMC 的 __ESMC_loop_invariant() 以基例+保持性+退出蕴含三步归纳论证替代循环展开，嵌入 CEGIS 循环，作为有界检查不足时的补充。

7) Pre-Abstraction（预抽象）五阶段流水线：1a 生成高复杂度函数的过近似抽象；1b 并发为低复杂度函数合成精确契约；2 用抽象作为函数摘要做快速系统级过近似检查；3 逐函数原子化验证（无条件执行）；4 用已验证的精确契约替换对应抽象，未验证者保留保守抽象；5 若替换后仍不满足系统属性则升级到 CEGAR/CEGIS。复杂度评分由正则静态分析得出的循环数/嵌套深度、递归与无界循环（大额惩罚）、动态内存分配（中等）、分支与指针操作（较小）等指标的加权和决定，映射为 minimal(<5)、low(≥5)、medium(≥10)、high(≥20) 四个爆炸风险层级。

8) ESBMC-LF 预处理器（7 步）：用 LFC 将 LF 编译为语义等价 C；平台路径/头文件归一化；将 reactor-c 运行时替换为“运营模型”（stub 调度器、事件队列、token 生命周期）并扁平化为单一翻译单元；从原始 LF 源码抽取 MTL 属性并映射符号到 C 位置；用九种仪表化模板将 MTL 编码为 __ESBMC_assert/__ESBMC_assume 与跟踪变量；解析输出拓扑构建级联图，用带 is_present 守卫的直接函数调用替换调度分发，按定时器周期与属性时间域推导有限可完全展开的循环界；后处理剥离死代码、固定预处理常量、传播动作值、去除行指令。产物构成 LF-Hard（24 个 1998–4328 LOC 的单体 C 程序）。

9) 实验设置：ESBMC 8.1.0 后端，每程序最多 5 次 CEGAR 迭代；LLM 后端为 Qwen3.5-Plus（DashScope 云 API）、Claude Haiku 4.5（Anthropic 云 API）、本地 Ollama 部署的 GPT-OSS 120b（4×RTX A6000）；超时 Frama-C/LF2C-Simple/X.509 为 600 s、VerifyThis 为 900 s；策略对比 SmartICE（完整 CEGAR+ICE）与 No-ICE（消融），VerifyThis 专用 Pre-Abstraction。

Result: RQ1（验证有效性）：Frama-C 45 个程序：GPT-OSS 120b 43/45（96%）、Qwen-Plus 40/45（89%）、Claude Haiku 4.5 37/45（82%），且 93–95% 的收敛程序仅需一次 CEGAR 迭代；LF2C-Simple 17 个程序：82%–88%（14/14/15）；X.509 6 个程序明显更难，33%–50%（3/3/2），反映当前 LLM 为指针密集底层代码合成可靠契约的能力缺口，且三种后端均无法弥合。

RQ2（ICE 学习贡献，消融）：ICE 并非普遍增益，而是“能力条件化的放大器”。GPT-OSS 120b +2 个程序（96% vs 91%），Qwen-Plus +1（89% vs 87%）；Claude Haiku 4.5 反而少收敛 2 个（37 vs 39）。原因有二：模型产出语法畸形的契约（如在需 C 整数表达式处使用布尔字面量）导致解析错误被当作负例入库，使后续精化远离表面模式却持续产出畸形表达式直至耗尽迭代预算；以及 ESBMC 反例格式无法被解析时，语义空条目进入 E− 并以“具有结构含义”的姿态回灌给模型，噪声伪装成信号。较强后端能更稳定产出语法良好的契约与结构化反例，使 ICE 数据库保持干净、反馈真正有效。

RQ3（复杂程序可扩展性）：LF-Hard 24 个程序（Pre-Abstraction，600 s）：无契约的直接 ESBMC 基线为 10/24（42%），ConVer 提升至 Qwen-Plus 11/24（46%）、Haiku 4.5 12/24（50%）、GPT-OSS 15/24（62%），增益来自 Election、ADASModel、ProcessMsg 等单体展开会超时、而契约分解可把每个函数级 SMT 实例降到可解规模的程序；ProcessSync 因 ESBMC 在系统级检查阶段即拒绝其结构而在所有后端统一 FAILED（不计入收敛数）。大多数收敛程序无需 CEGAR 精化（迭代 0）。VerifyThis 11 个程序（900 s）：Haiku 4.5 7/11（64%）与流水线作者的手工配置参考结果持平，Qwen-Plus 与 GPT-OSS 均 6/11（55%）；四个全后端失败的程序（MultCommutative、duplets、prefixsum、prefixsum_rec）涉及超出当前契约合成能力的复杂过程间不变式。

与 SOTA 比较：与 ACSE 在同一 Frama-C 与 X.509 基准上直接可比，ACSE 支持量化循环不变式（如 ∀i. a[i]≥0）而 ConVer 因 ESBMC 契约机制不支持 requires/ensures 中的一阶量词被限制在无量词的 45 个程序子集；ConVer 优势在于以形式化反例迭代精化而非一次性符号推断。与 PolyVer 互补：PolyVer 在 LF 源级用 UCLID5 达到 22/22，ConVer 则在包含完整运行时的 1998–4328 LOC 翻译 C 上达到 15/24（GPT-OSS，全部运行合计 16/24），二者不可直接比较。此外跨全部四种配置有 4–5 个程序处于“仅系统级通过”的持续状态，原因是 LLM 反复生成过强契约而 5 轮预算不足以放松之。已知可靠性保留点：ESBMC 不支持指针解引用目标形式的 assigns（如 assigns *instance_args），这类子句被剥离，指针参数所修改状态的框架条件未被机械验证——这是 ESBMC 后端限制而非组合方法本身的缺陷，requires/ensures 与标量 assigns 均正常验证，方法可靠性论证对契约中被验证的部分成立。
