From our result we obtain a general-purpose PAC-Bayes generalization bound in which the necessary prior distribution can be learned by DP-SGD, as well as a generalization bound for DP-SGD-trained models themselves, with a complexity term that is fully explicit and controlled by the optimization hyperparameters.

</details>


### [270] [Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26243)
*Zhishuai Guo,Wenhan Wu,Chen Chen,Lei Zhang,Olivera Kotevska,Ravi K Madduri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CE-FedGNN：面向跨机构耦合图（如银行间反洗钱交易网络）的联邦图神经网络框架。其核心是以低频（仅在通信轮次）交换"边界节点"的聚合嵌入而非原始数据或逐轮嵌入，并通过节点嵌入与随机梯度的滑动平均（moving-average）估计器缓解跨客户端依赖与陈旧性偏差；同时首次将度量差分隐私（metric-DP）引入联邦 GNN 训练，在嵌入空间 L2 距离上对释放嵌入给出 (ε,δ)-metric-DP 保证（公开队列威胁模型，RDP 组合）。理论上达到 O(1/√T) 收敛率、O(T^{3/4}) 通信复杂度；在合成反洗钱基准与 Cora/Citeseer/PubMed/MSAcademic 引用网络上一致优于 FedAvg、Swift、FedGCN、FedGNN-ST 等基线，并在噪声下保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图数据常分散在不同组织（如银行间交易网络），受 GDPR/CCPA 等法规约束无法共享原始数据。现有联邦 GNN 存在根本权衡：(1) 忽略跨客户端边导致表示不完整有偏、精度下降；(2) 每轮交换嵌入通信开销巨大；(3) 低频交换又无法适应表示漂移（representation drift）。此外，联邦学习中交换的嵌入本身可能泄露敏感信息，而针对逐节点嵌入释放的最坏情况 L2 敏感度等于嵌入球直径，使标准 DP 在实用噪声水平下变得空洞（vacuous）。因此需要一个同时实现跨客户端建模精度、低通信成本与可证明隐私的方案。

Method: 方法分三部分。①问题设定：消息传递式 GNN（GCN/GraphSAGE-mean/GIN），节点或边级预测头，跨客户端边对双方可见（边属性共享）但节点特征私有。②通信高效算法（Algorithm 1, CE-FedGNN）：服务器维护全局嵌入缓冲区，客户端本地做 K 步小批量训练；前向使用滑动平均嵌入估计器 H̃=(1-γ)H̃+γW·mean(邻居)（仅对节点、不对边，因为边数远大于节点数）；梯度用滑动平均估计器 G=(1-β)G+β∇̂F；跨客户端边只回传自己端点的梯度分量、另一端嵌入按最近一次共享值（陈旧）视为固定输入，通过两客户端的对称采样/再加权使聚合梯度对 W^e 无偏；仅需一跳跨客户端交互，无需多跳采样。③隐私扩展：仅在通信时对共享嵌入注入高斯噪声 σ0、对聚合模型参数与梯度注入 σ1、σ2；采用 Chatzikokolakis 等人的 metric-DP（Pr[M(x)∈S] ≤ e^{ε·d(x,x')}Pr[M(x')∈S]+δ，d 为嵌入空间 L2 距离）；用 Rényi DP 组合（无放回放大，样本率 1）给出 R' 轮组合后的 (ε(ρ),δ) 保证；ρ 由 k-匿名式构造取第 k 近邻距离分布的 q 分位数。

Result: 理论结果：Lemma 3.2/3.3 分别刻画嵌入估计误差与梯度估计误差；Theorem 3.4 给出平均梯度范数 O(1/(ηRK)+1/(βRK)+1/(γpRK)+β/N+γ/p+β²K²)，取 γ=β=η=Θ(R^{-2/3})、K=Θ(R^{1/3}) 得 R=Θ(T^{3/4}) 时 O(T^{-1/2}) 收敛率，迭代复杂度 O(ε^{-4})、通信复杂度 O(ε^{-3})，且 p 随 N 增长时可得 O(N^{-1}ε^{-4}) 的线性加速。Theorem 3.6 给出组合高斯机制的 (ε(ρ),δ)-metric-DP 保证（ρ 取嵌入球直径时退化为标准 DP）；Theorem 3.7 表明噪声下收敛界以 σ0² 二次形式进入，而 σ1、σ2 以 1/β 进入，说明更强的嵌入扰动可被容忍。实验：AML 六个 HI/LI×Small/Medium/Large 设置中 CE-FedGNN-PNA 全部最优（如 HI-Large 0.7114 vs 次优 0.6461），LI 极端不平衡下多数基线崩溃而本方法保持优势；引用网络四数据集全部第一（Cora 0.4701、Citeseer 0.4343、PubMed 0.6517、MSAcademic 0.8497）；通信间隔 K 增至 1024 时性能几乎不降；σ0 增大时呈清晰的效用-噪声权衡但仍可与 FedAvg 竞争；消融显示去掉全局嵌入共享或改用陈旧嵌入均显著变差；属性推理攻击下重建误差高于 1% 最近邻距离基线；单轮运行时间与基线相当。

Conclusion: CE-FedGNN 通过低频交换滑动平均节点嵌入，在保持跨客户端全局结构建模能力的同时显著降低通信量，并首次为联邦 GNN 的逐节点嵌入释放给出公开队列威胁模型下的 (ε,δ)-metric-DP 形式化保证，从而在标准 DP 已变得空洞的中等噪声水平上仍获得有意义的隐私。实验验证其在 AML 与引用网络任务上的精度、极低通信频率下的稳健性及噪声下的效用保持能力。局限与展望：该类系统具有双重用途（检测能力提升亦可能被用于缺乏监督的监控），因此形式化隐私保证尤为重要；由于公开可观测的释放队列无法利用子采样放大，隐私增益受限，作者指出可结合安全聚合或匿名洗牌进一步改进；AML 实验因监管限制使用合成数据，真实交易数据上的验证仍待补充。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) achieve strong performance on relational data, but real-world graphs are often distributed across organizations that cannot share raw data due to privacy and policy constraints. Existing federated GNN methods either ignore cross-client links, leading to degraded accuracy, or require frequent embedding exchanges, incurring substantial communication and privacy costs. We propose CE-FedGNN, a communication-efficient and privacy-preserving federated GNN framework for learning over such coupled graphs. Our approach avoids sharing raw data or per-round embeddings by infrequently exchanging aggregated node representations. To handle cross-client dependency and staleness, we introduce a moving-average estimator that continuously tracks node representations and enables their stable reuse across rounds. To provide formal privacy guarantees for the released representations, we adopt the metric differential privacy (metric-DP) framework, which measures privacy with respect to distances in the learned embedding space rather than worst-case input perturbations. This yields meaningful guarantees at noise levels where standard differential privacy becomes overly conservative. We establish convergence to a stationary point at a rate of $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ with $O(T^{3/4})$ communication complexity. In addition, we derive $(\varepsilon,δ)$-metric-DP guarantees via Rényi differential privacy composition under a public-cohort threat model. Experiments on synthetic interbank anti-money laundering benchmarks and citation networks demonstrate that CE-FedGNN achieves strong performance while significantly reducing communication and maintaining robustness under privacy-preserving noise.

</details>


### [271] [The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26246)
*Guanghui Wang,Kaiwen Lv Kacuila,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Jin-Wen Wu,Longtao Huang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文揭示hard/soft标签混合优于单独使用的本质原因——减少暴露偏差而非更好的教师匹配；提出Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论解释该现象，并基于此开发自适应混合监督方法，在模型压缩任务中实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏中，soft标签看似信息更丰富，但单独使用hard或soft标签都存在局限：hard-only避免风险但缺乏多样性，soft-only保持多样性但可能偏离关键节点。

Method: 提出Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论，将生成步骤分为必须精确的Bridges和可灵活的Gardens；开发自适应平衡hard和soft标签的混合监督方法。

Result: 混合策略同时处理Bridges和Gardens，降低了序列级别的暴露偏差；在7个师生模型对（Qwen、Llama、Gemma、DeepSeek）的推理和编码基准测试中优于基于散度的on-policy KD基线，训练效率提升9.7倍。

Conclusion: Bridge-Garden Decomposition理论揭示了hard/soft标签混合优于单独使用的根本原因；基于此理论提出的混合监督方法在7个师生模型对和推理/编码任务上显著优于基线，同时将训练成本降低9.7倍。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student. In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (hard labels) or the teacher's full next-token distribution (soft labels). Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results. Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training. Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias, the mismatch between training and inference distributions. To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge-Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: Bridges, where the next token must be exact, and Gardens, where it can be flexible. We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens. A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence. Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge-Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels. Across a primary suite of seven teacher-student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by 9.7x, enabling efficient model compression. Code is available at https://github.com/ghwang-s/bridge_garden_hybrid_kd_release.

</details>


### [272] [Unified Neural Scaling Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26248)
*Ethan Caballero,Priyank Jaini,David Krueger,Irina Rish*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The paper introduces a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL) — a functional form that jointly models scaling behaviors of neural networks across multiple simultaneously varying dimensions (parameters, data, compute, steps, hyperparameters) — and demonstrates its superior extrapolation accuracy over existing scaling law approaches on large-scale vision, language, math, and RL tasks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing neural scaling laws typically model scaling behavior with respect to only one or a few variables at a time. In practice, however, multiple dimensions vary simultaneously during training and deployment, and a unified framework is needed to accurately capture and extrapolate these complex interactions.

Method: The authors propose a unified functional form that jointly models how evaluation metrics vary as multiple dimensions (model parameters, dataset size, training steps, inference steps, compute, and hyperparameters) are varied simultaneously across diverse architectures and tasks.

Result: The UNSL functional form yields considerably more accurate extrapolations of scaling behavior compared to other functional forms tested across large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning tasks.

Conclusion: The proposed Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL) provides a more accurate functional form for extrapolating scaling behaviors compared to existing approaches, applicable across diverse architectures and task domains at large scale.

Abstract: We present a functional form (that we refer to as a Unified Neural Scaling Law (UNSL)) that accurately models and extrapolates the scaling behaviors of deep neural networks as multiple dimensions all vary simultaneously (i.e. how the evaluation metric of interest varies as one simultaneously varies the number of model parameters, training dataset size, number of training steps, number of inference steps, amount of compute, and various hyperparameters) for various architectures and for each of various tasks within a varied set of upstream and downstream tasks. This set includes large-scale vision, language, math, and reinforcement learning. When compared to other functional forms for neural scaling, this functional form yields extrapolations of scaling behavior that are considerably more accurate on this set.

</details>


### [273] [Quantized Keys Steal Attention: Bias Correction for KV-Cache Compression in Video Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26266)
*Tuna Tuncer,Felix Becker,Thomas Pfeil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KV cache quantization in video diffusion models introduces a systematic bias in attention weights (Jensen bias) due to quantization noise inflating cached key contributions. The paper derives a per-attention-score correction using second-order Taylor approximation that removes this bias with negligible overhead, recovering near-BF16 quality at INT2 quantization while saving 50% memory vs INT4.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Long-form video generation with chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models suffers from KV cache memory bottleneck. Existing low bitwidth KV cache quantization methods degrade video quality, limiting their practical applicability.

Method: A per-attention-score correction derived from quantization step sizes and query norm, using a second-order Taylor approximation for on-the-fly computation. No additional memory beyond the existing cache.

Result: At INT2 quantization, the correction recovers most quality lost to aggressive quantization, approaching near-BF16 video quality. It can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

Conclusion: The Jensen bias correction effectively recovers quality lost to aggressive KV cache quantization, achieving near-BF16 quality at INT2 while potentially outperforming INT4 with 50% less memory. The method incurs negligible computational overhead and requires no additional memory.

Abstract: Chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion models rely on a KV cache of previously generated chunks to avoid redundant computation, but this cache quickly becomes a memory bottleneck as videos grow longer. Methods that quantize the KV cache to low bitwidths reduce memory pressure but degrade video quality. We show that a key driver of this degradation is a systematic bias in attention weights: due to the convexity of the exponential in softmax attention, quantization noise inflates the contribution of cached keys, a phenomenon we call the Jensen bias. This effect causes quantized keys to steal attention mass from the unquantized current chunk. We derive a per-attention-score correction that removes this bias in expectation, computed on the fly from the quantization step sizes of the cached keys and the query norm. Using a second-order Taylor approximation, the additional computational overhead is negligible, and no additional memory is needed alongside the cache. Evaluated on MAGI-1, SkyReels-V2, and HY-WorldPlay at INT2 quantization, our correction recovers most of the quality lost to aggressive quantization, reaching near-BF16 video quality, and can outperform INT4 quantization while using 50% less memory.

</details>


### [274] [Scaling World-Model Reinforcement Learning Through Diffusion Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26282)
*Xiaoyuan Cheng,Wenxuan Yuan,Zhancun Mu,Yuanzhao Zhang,Yiming Yang,Hai Wang,Zhuo Sun,Che Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出模型式 RL 的真正瓶颈并非模型误差累积，而是"搜索"与"价值学习"之间的结构性错配（价值函数由非搜索策略的数据训练，策略改进却依赖 MPPI 搜索轨迹），并提出 MBDPO（Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization）：把策略优化重构为潜空间世界模型中"对想象轨迹的扩散过程"，用从缓冲区学习的隐式能量函数充当 KL 信任域锚点，通过得分匹配直接实现策略优化，从而统一搜索与策略优化。在 4 大基准共 121 个任务上，MBDPO 全面超越 SAC/DreamerV3/TD-MPC/TD-MPC2，并呈现随模型容量（1.7M→340M）单调提升的扩展曲线，训练开销与 TD-MPC2 相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型 RL 被认为有希望规模化，但实践中仍难超越无模型方法。既有解释多归因于模型偏差与误差累积（提升精度、不确定性估计、截断/分支 rollout 等），而作者引用并推进了"模型精度不等于规划效果"的观点，指出更关键却少被探索的瓶颈是搜索与价值学习的结构性错配：价值函数 Q̂ 只在非搜索策略 β（离线为行为策略，在线为回放缓冲区的混合策略）采集的数据上训练，而策略改进与执行依赖世界模型上 MPPI 采样搜索产生的轨迹。二者分布不一致导致 Q̂ 在 OOD 状态-动作对上被查询并系统性高估，搜索进一步"利用"这些误差，形成"分布偏移—价值高估—误差放大"的自我强化循环，理论上对应两条不等式：Value Iteration Gap（‖T^π Q̂ − T^β Q̂‖∞ ≤ γ‖Q̂‖∞√(2 D_KL^max(π‖β))）与 Policy Improvement Gap（真实改进 ≥ 估计改进/(1−γ) − C₁D_KL^max − C₂‖Q^β − Q̂‖∞），说明"策略改进本质上是局部（信任域）过程"。MPPI 从高斯先验出发的启发式搜索既无单调改进保证，也不满足分布一致性，因而无法真正规模化。

Method: 1) 潜空间世界模型：沿用 TD-MPC 框架，编码器 E、潜动力学 F、潜奖励 R、可学习任务嵌入 e（支持多任务），全部优化在潜空间进行。
2) 策略目标重构：不再显式构建规划器，而是求解带 KL 约束（s.t. D_KL(π_φ‖β) ≤ ε，且 z_{h+1}=F(z_h,a_h)）的策略优化问题（Eq.8），以获得真正的单调改进保证。
3) 隐式能量函数 E_θ：由于 β 的密度不可解，用 InfoNCE 式对比损失从缓冲区学习 E，使得 −E(z,a) ≈ log β(a|z) + C(z)，从而把 KL 约束吸收进奖励：R̃ = R − (η/γ^{h−t})E；η 为能量正则因子，κ 为温度。
4) 扩散策略（DDPM over 动作块 a_{t:t+H}，receding-horizon 执行）：不建显式规划器，score 由世界模型的想象轨迹估计——从 DDPM 后验高斯提议 q_τ 采样干净动作序列，在潜动力学中 rollout H 步，用能量正则化累计回报 G̃ 计算归一化重要性权重 w = exp(G̃/κ)/Z，用加权 Monte Carlo 估计得分（Lemma C.1 给出解析推导），再以 L² 得分匹配损失训练 score 网络（Eq.16）；推理时用摊销的 score 网络做迭代反向扩散，避免在线 rollout 开销。
5) 理论：定理 3.2 证明 KL 约束最优策略为 Gibbs 分布 π* ∝ (∏β(a_h|z_h))·exp(G/κ)·∏1{z_{h+1}=F(z_h,a_h)}，且"得分匹配条件成立 ⇔ 达到该最优"，即反向扩散等价于模型式策略优化；误差相对 Gibbs 分布以 Poly(N, T, L_φ) 衰减（N 扩散步、T 采样数、L_φ score 的 Lipschitz 常数）。
6) 实现：交替联合训练——(i) 世界模型 + 一步 TD 价值迭代 + 能量对比损失（联合损失 Eq.14，CE 处理稀疏奖励，EMA 目标网络）；(ii) 扩散策略优化；支持在线从零、离线多任务预训练、离线到在线微调三种模式。

Result: (1) 在线从零训练：在 DMControl/MetaWorld/ManiSkill2/MyoSuite 共 121 任务及 10 个视觉控制任务上全面优于 SAC、DreamerV3、TD-MPC、TD-MPC2；训练早期更快提升、方差更低；PickYCB 成功率 >75%（基线无法学习）。
(2) 扩展性：30/80 任务多任务离线预训练中，模型从 1.7M→6M→21M→54M→340M 性能单调上升；小模型优势最大（更大模型使 TD-MPC2 的轨迹搜索受益，差距收窄）；30 任务数据集在 340M 时因数据容量饱和略有下降。η=0（去掉能量约束）仍优于 TD-MPC2（75.29 vs 57.1）。
(3) 机制验证：MBDPO 的 cross TD error 更低更稳定，相对动作漂移显著更小并在 1M 步后趋近 0，而 MPPI 全程高漂移，印证错配诊断与理论分析。
(4) 离线到在线：70 任务预训练 + 10 个未见任务每任务仅 40k 交互微调，显著优于从零训练；"Hopper Hop"失败归因于任务嵌入孤立导致的表征分布偏移。
(5) 效率：在线训练每环境步耗时与 TD-MPC2 持平（Visual RL 3.55→3.04 ms），离线 30→80 任务仅增 1.02–1.32×，340M 模型 202.9 h vs 206.8 h；代价是推理/评估时间约为 TD-MPC2 的 2 倍（扩散多步采样）。
(6) 消融：η 在 [0.3,1] 稳定，η=5 时因行为克隆效应过强跌至 70 以下；增大扩散步数 N 与 Monte Carlo 样本数 T 均单调提升性能，与 Poly(N,T,L_φ) 误差界一致；T 可并行故几乎不影响耗时，N 线性影响推理耗时。
(7) 表征分析：MBDPO 的潜轨迹呈周期性闭环/目标导向平滑结构，TD-MPC2 更散乱；任务嵌入 t-SNE 显示域级分离与语义相关任务聚簇。

Conclusion: MBDPO 通过"扩散策略 + 潜世界模型 + 隐式能量锚定"的组合，把启发式搜索改造为带 KL 信任域约束的真正策略优化，证明得分匹配与模型式最优策略等价，从而消除搜索—价值学习错配，释放世界模型的可扩展策略学习潜力，并实现"性能随模型容量单调提升"。三点洞见：①扩散模型是世界模型与策略优化之间的天然接口，潜在联合训练还能诱导具有物理一致性的因果潜结构；②世界模型中的策略学习应重新思考——KL 约束目标同时承载了离线 RL 的保守性与 TRPO/PPO 的信任域原理，规模化不应依赖更复杂的搜索启发式；③表征质量是前提，物理合理的潜空间是规模化的先决条件（离线到在线迁移依赖通用表征，退化表征会直接瘫痪策略优化）。局限：受算力限制未扩至基础模型规模、仅在仿真中验证、尚需接入视觉/多模态预训练编码器；未来方向包括真机部署与更大规模预训练世界模型。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) can be effectively supported at scale through the use of world models. However, in practice, scaling such approaches remains fundamentally limited. A commonly recognized challenge is model bias and error compounding, which degrade long-horizon predictions. Beyond these issues, we identify a more critical yet underexplored bottleneck: a structural misalignment between search and value learning in existing world model approaches. In particular, policy improvement often relies on value functions induced by a separate, non-search policy, resulting in training inconsistency and ultimately suboptimal learning. To address this limitation, we propose Model-Based Diffusion Policy Optimization (MBDPO) in world models, a framework that unifies search and policy optimization through diffusion policy representations, thereby unlocking the potential of world models for scalable policy learning. Instead of constructing an explicit planner over a learned world model, we reformulate policy optimization as a diffusion process over searched trajectories in latent world models. In this view, we extract an implicit energy function from the collected dataset that anchors the policy, enabling MBDPO to refine the score field for policy optimization while mitigating misalignment. We evaluate MBDPO across a wide range of settings, including multi-task offline pretraining, online learning, and offline-to-online fine-tuning. In the offline regime, we further investigate its scaling behavior by pretraining on large-scale datasets, observing consistent and monotonic performance gains with increasing model capacity.

</details>


### [275] [Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26285)
*Paul Schwerdtner,Tobias Blickhan,Benjamin Peherstorfer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于两参数流的概率密度动态学习方法，无需轨迹标签即可在高维环境下学习物理时间动力学，并能自然处理旋转或循环等非梯度物理现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决高维概率密度动态学习问题，传统方法依赖标记轨迹数据，但实际场景中常缺乏轨迹信息仅有未标记样本。

Method: 提出两参数流（two-parameter flows）方法：(1) 学习从基分布到各边缘分布的采样时间传输；(2) 通过回归耦合合成轨迹提取物理时间速度场。构建于条件流匹配技术之上。

Result: 证明物理时间动力学唯一性，且继承采样时间传输的正则性；在高维场景可扩展，同时支持非梯度动力学。

Conclusion: 通过条件流匹配技术实现高维概率密度动态学习，避免逐步最优传输耦合，支持非梯度动力学（如旋转/循环现象），同时保证物理时间动力学的唯一性和规律性继承。

Abstract: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information. We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories. We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports. Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.

</details>


### [276] [Stateful Inference for Low-Latency Multi-Agent Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26289)
*Victor Norgren*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种状态化推理架构，将多智能体工具调用场景中每个轮次的O(n_t)成本降至O(Δ_t)增量成本，通过跨轮次持久化KV缓存、基数前缀缓存和提示查找推测解码器实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理框架将每次工具调用视为独立请求，即使85-95%的提示内容在前一轮保持不变，仍从头重新处理整个对话，造成大量计算资源浪费。

Method: 提出状态化推理架构：(1) 持久化KV缓存跨轮次保持，仅摄入新增token推进状态；(2) 基数前缀缓存扩展支持交错多智能体流量场景；(3) 提示查找推测解码器加速结构化输出。

Result: 在全新生成的工作负载上，相比vLLM和SGLang：6轮智能体工作流提速2.1倍；35轮工作流中位轮次提速4.2倍；端到端wall time减半。性能优势源于状态化复用和推测执行，而非传统缓存机制。

Conclusion: 状态化推理架构能有效解决多智能体工具调用场景中的重复计算问题，通过增量处理机制实现显著的性能提升，为LLM系统的实际部署提供了高效的推理范式。

Abstract: Multi-agent tool calling is becoming the dominant interaction pattern for LLM-based systems, yet existing inference frameworks treat each tool call as an independent request, re-processing the entire conversation from scratch even though 85-95% of the prompt is unchanged from the previous turn.
  We present a stateful inference architecture that converts the $O(n_t)$ per-turn cost of conventional serving into an $O(Δ_t)$ delta-only cost: a persistent KV cache lives across turns and advances by ingesting only the new tokens, while a radix prefix cache extends this across interleaved multi-agent traffic and a prompt-lookup speculative decoder accelerates structured output. Against vLLM and SGLang on novel, fully-generated workloads, the reference implementation is $2.1\times$ faster per turn on a 6-turn agentic workflow and $4.2\times$ on the median turn of a 35-turn one, halving end-to-end wall time. The advantage comes from stateful reuse and speculation, not caching.

</details>


### [277] [Dynamic Link Prediction with Temporally Enhanced Signed Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26290)
*Derek Regier,Andrew Polyak,Aresh Dadlani,Khosro Salmani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化、可插拔的时间增强框架（核心为历史上下文整合模块 HCIM），通过可学习的近因感知时间加权、LSTM 嵌入轨迹建模与多头时间注意力捕捉短期与长期的符号化交互动态，并以全局或节点自适应权重将历史信息与当前节点表示融合；在保持可解释性的前提下将框架实例化于 SE-SGformer（自解释符号图 Transformer），在 Bitcoin OTC/Alpha、Reddit 及小世界合成网络上取得相对静态基线一致且统计显著的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态/无符号图的链接预测中 GNN 已表现良好，但在时序符号图（TSN）上仍存在核心困难：符号关系的正负极性、图结构的持续演化，以及平衡理论（balance theory）约束之间的复杂耦合，使得现有静态架构难以有效建模。时间符号网络广泛出现在社交媒体分析、信任与声誉系统、金融交易网络等场景，其中边的符号（合作/对抗）与时间戳同时变化，静态方法丢失了行为演化的时序线索。此外，许多符号 GNN 强调可解释性，改造其内部结构困难，因此需要一种架构无关、无需重写主干模型即可注入时间感知能力的方案。

Method: 框架层面的三部分技术栈：1）可学习的近因感知（recency-aware）时间加权，使衰减/衰减型时间核的参数端到端学习而非手工设定；2）基于 LSTM 的节点嵌入轨迹建模，捕捉嵌入随时间的演化路径以刻画长期依赖；3）多头时间注意力，在不同子空间并行聚合多个时间尺度的交互信息。HCIM 将历史上下文与当前节点表示融合，融合策略分为全局加权与节点自适应加权（node-adaptive）两种，以适应异质的时间行为模式。框架整体与主干解耦（architecture-agnostic），可插入现有符号 GNN；论文将其实例化到自解释符号图 Transformer（SE-SGformer），保留其注意力权重驱动的可解释性，仅额外引入时间感知组件，从而在时间化与可解释性之间取得平衡。实验在真实时序符号网络（Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit）以及小世界合成网络模型上进行，与静态基线对比并做统计显著性检验。

Result: 在 Bitcoin OTC、Bitcoin Alpha、Reddit 及小世界网络模型上，集成 HCIM 的模型相对静态 SE-SGformer 基线取得一致且统计显著的改进，说明历史时间信息对符号链接预测具有实质增益；模块化设计未破坏原模型的可解释性属性，且全局/节点自适应两种融合方式对不同数据集各有适用性，表明框架能容纳异质时间行为。（摘要未披露具体指标数值与提升幅度。）

Conclusion: 时序符号图的学习瓶颈主要在于缺乏对演化历史与符号极性的联合建模；将历史上下文作为可插拔模块注入静态符号 GNN 是一条低侵入、高收益的路径。HCIM 通过近因加权、LSTM 轨迹与多头时间注意力的组合，同时覆盖短期与长期的符号交互动态，并以全局/自适应权重解决节点间时间行为的异质性。面向真实金融与社交网络及合成网络的实验支持该框架的有效性，且保留了符号模型的可解释性优势；后续可进一步扩展到更多符号架构（不限于 Transformer）、多关系/多极性场景与更大规模图，并探索时间信息与平衡理论约束的显式耦合机制。

Abstract: Temporal signed networks (TSNs) model the time evolution of cooperative and adversarial relationships that arise in applications such as social media analysis, trust and reputation systems, and financial transaction networks. While graph neural networks (GNNs) perform well for static or unsigned link prediction, effective learning in temporal signed graphs remains challenging due to the interaction of signed relations, evolving structure, and balance-theoretic constraints. To address this gap, we propose a \emph{modular} temporal enhancement framework for signed GNNs that integrates historical context into otherwise static architectures. The framework introduces a Historical Context Integration Module (HCIM) that combines learnable recency-aware temporal weighting, LSTM-based embedding trajectory modeling, and multi-head temporal attention to capture both short- and long-term signed interaction dynamics. Historical information is fused with current node representations using either global or node-adaptive weighting, allowing the architecture-agnostic framework to accommodate heterogeneous temporal behaviors. We instantiate the approach on the Self-Explainable Signed Graph Transformer (SE-SGformer), preserving interpretability while extending it with temporal awareness. Experiments on real-world and synthetic TSNs, including Bitcoin OTC, Bitcoin Alpha, Reddit, and small-world network models, demonstrate consistent and statistically significant improvements over the static baseline.

</details>


### [278] [Classification and detection of multiple UAVs using rational Gaussian wavelet neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26310)
*Ungvári Gergő,Ferenc Braun,Attila Ámon,Péter Kackstädter,János Volk,Péter Kovács,Tamás Dózsa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于「有理高斯小波卷积」(RGW convolution) 的模型驱动小型神经网络，用于基于麦克风声音信号的无人机检测、型号分类与蜂群识别。该方法把可学习形态的有理高斯小波作为卷积核嵌入神经网络端到端训练，能自适应提取具有物理意义的频率特征，在室内纯净与室外强噪声两种场景下均优于随机森林、SVM、朴素贝叶斯与全连接网络，并在多数指标上超过结构相近的 CNN，同时参数更少、可解释性更强，代码已开源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机威胁使低成本、可信（可解释）的检测与分类技术成为刚需。现有四类检测手段各有局限：雷达成本高且小目标雷达截面积小、视觉受天气与视线限制、射频方案无法识别自主飞行或非无线控制的无人机、声学方案虽低成本且不受视线约束但易受风与背景噪声干扰。已有基于声音的 AI 方案主要有两类问题：(1) 深度学习模型参数无物理意义，在安全关键场景不可解释，且需专用硬件、部署维护成本高；(2) 采用固定时频变换（如 STFT）作为静态特征提取器，无法适应不同机型、机动状态与环境变化，导致信号表示次优。此外，多机蜂群协同飞行的出现使防御更难，作者希望同一套系统能区分单机、噪声与多机共存。作者的目标是：以 MEMS 麦克风构建低成本声学前端，用数学上可解释的模型驱动机器学习（model-driven ML）替代黑箱深度学习，在小数据、少参数条件下同时实现无人机存在检测、机型分类与蜂群识别。

Method: 方法核心是提出一个新的 RGW 卷积层并构造轻量可解释网络。

(1) 信号处理与数据：音频切分为 100 ms 不重叠片段（室内 192 kHz/24-bit → 每段 19200 点；室外 8 kHz/16-bit），仅做逐段零均值单位方差归一化。设备为 PIX 270i + Apogee Big Ben 主时钟 + Focusrite RedNet/Pro Tools + Brüel & Kjær 4006 与 Schoeps MK2(CMC5) 压电传声器；室外用共 PCB 的 4 通道 MEMS 阵列，环境含直升机掠过、公路车流、人声与强风。机型覆盖 Mavic Pro(734 g)、Mavic Pro 2(907 g)、Mavic Mini(249 g)、Mavic 3 Pro(958 g)、Avata 2(377 g，涵道三叶高转速 9000–12000 RPM)、Matrice 30T(3.7 kg，2500–4200 RPM)，以覆盖宽频声学谱。

(2) RGW 小波：沿用 Ámon 等(2025) 的有理高斯小波 ψ^η(t)=C(η)P^η(t)v^η(t)e^{-t²/2}，其中 P^η 为带实零点 t_k 的多项式项、v^η 为由共轭极点 z_k 构成的有理项，参数向量 η∈C^{p+n} 决定母小波形态，已证明满足可容许性条件。

(3) RGW 卷积层（本文主要创新）：不学习平移参数，只把缩放/尺度 λ_k(k=1..m) 与 η 作为可学习参数，用离散卷积近似小波系数 W_ψ(λ,τ)（替代依赖信号周期性的 variable projection 算子，后者对非周期音频无效）。层输出 T_η f ∈ R^{m×(N+M-1)}，Jacobian 可由 ∂ψ^η_{λ_k}/∂η 解析给出。实验中取 p=1、n=10、m=10 个尺度滤波器，室内核长 32（输出 10×19169），室外核长 64（输出 10×4347）。

(4) 网络结构与可解释性：卷积输出先按尺度做均值/方差标准化，再经特殊 top-Q 最大值池化（每个尺度保留 Q 个最大 |小波系数|），语义上等于“输入信号在 λ_k 定义频带内的最大幅值”；后接 2 层带 ReLU 的全连接层（分类块 200 神经元），输出端用 sigmoid（二分类）或 softmax（多类）。总训练 300 epoch、batch 64、5 折交叉验证（每折 80/20 划分），超参由大规模网格搜索确定。

(5) 三个实验场景：① 室内多机/蜂群检测（背景噪声、单机、多机共 3 类，机型 Mavic Pro/Pro 2/Mini，每类 1790 段）；② 室内单机机型分类（3 类，每类 1000 段）；③ 室外强噪声下单机存在检测（二分类，机型 Avata 2、Matrice 30T、Mavic Mini、Mavic Pro 3，每类 1050 段）。基线为 RF、SVM-L、SVM-RBF、朴素贝叶斯、FCNN 与结构对齐的 CNN，指标为准确率 Acc=(N_tp+N_tn)/N_total。

Result: 场景1 室内蜂群检测（3 类）：WG-NN（RGW 网络）均值 92.52%（90.50–96.00），优于 CNN 90.57%、SVM-RBF 90.62% 附近、RF 78.94%、SVM-L 50.32%、NB 41.49%、FCNN 48.13%，且参数远少于 CNN。
场景2 室内机型分类（3 类）：RGW 网络 99.20%（98.33–99.83），CNN 99.97% 略优，SVM-RBF 96.37%、RF 91.53%，而 NB 48.10%、SVM-L 38.00%、FCNN 47.63% 基本失效。
场景3 室外噪声检测（二分类，任务最难）：RGW 网络 90.55%（87.75–94.75）为最优，CNN 89.60%、RF 80.40%、SVM-RBF 77.71%、SVM-L 62.34%、FCNN 55.90%、NB 49.48%。
总体结论：传统 ML 基线（尤其线性 SVM、朴素贝叶斯、纯 FCNN）明显不足；RGW 模型在三项任务上取得与 CNN 相当或更优的精度，并借助“可解释的频带最大幅值特征”可在噪声场景下检验模型有效性；python 实现已公开于 GitLab（gitlab.com/aele02/drone-classification-and-detection），原始数据因许可限制需向 HUN-REN 能源研究中心申请。

Conclusion: 本文贡献在于：把新提出的有理高斯小波族构造为可学习的卷积核，形成部分可解释的模型驱动神经网络；用该网络从声信号中提取具有物理意义（对应伪频率/频带最大幅值）的小波系数，从而在室内与室外强噪声环境下同时完成无人机存在检测、机型分类与多机（蜂群）识别，且参数少、可在受限硬件上实时运行。作者指出在某些任务上可超越 CNN 并在小数据集上取得高精度。展望方面：后续将针对具体任务使用更专门/更精细的模型以进一步提高精度，并将训练好的模型用于实时检测与分类。
可改进之处（作者与读者视角）：评估指标仅为整体准确率，未报告每类精确率/召回率、F1 或混淆矩阵，类别不平衡与漏检代价（如漏检蜂群）未被刻画；训练/测试按随机切分片段而非按录音会话切分，存在同源片段泄漏导致精度偏高的风险；室内 192 kHz 与室外 8 kHz 采样率不一致且核长需分别调参，尚未证明跨环境统一模型的可行性；蜂群规模上限为 3、机型与飞行机动（不同高度/速度）对特征稳定性的影响尚未系统量化；与各基线的参数量/计算量对比仅定性给出，缺乏显式的效率与鲁棒性（如风速、距离、信噪比）消融实验。

Abstract: The detection of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is important for the protection of civilian and military infrastructure. In this paper we propose a cost effective UAV detection system using sound signals obtained from microphones. The recorded signals are passed through a signal processing pipeline which employs interpretable adaptive feature extractors using so-called rational Gaussian wavelets. These adaptive wavelet transformations are embedded into and trained together with an underlying small neural network which detects and classifies UAVs based on the obtained features. This leads to a physically interpretable machine learning algorithm that in addition to classifying UAVs is also capable of detecting UAV swarms. We demonstrate our results using data collected in indoor studio and noisy outdoor environments. We conclude that the proposed method outperforms traditional machine learning approaches for detecting and classifying single UAVs as well as drone swarms, while retaining a high degree of interpretability. Our implementation of the proposed methods is made publicly available for reproducibility.

</details>


### [279] [Curriculum Learning for Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26315)
*Sandeep Kumar,Virginia Smith,Chhavi Yadav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper proposes Staged-Competence, a curriculum learning framework to improve DPO-based safety alignment robustness. By organizing preference data by difficulty, using competence-based sampling, and progressively updating the reference model, the method achieves significantly better OOD generalization—reducing harmful response rates by 16% and jailbreak success rates by 20%—while being data-efficient (75% of training data) and extensible to other DPO variants.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO is widely used for safety alignment in LLMs but is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.

Method: Staged-Competence: a curriculum-based framework with three key mechanisms—(1) organizing preference data by difficulty, (2) competence-based sampling, and (3) progressive reference model updates during training.

Result: Across three model families: (1) reduces OOD harmful response rates by 16%, (2) reduces jailbreak attack success rates by 20%, (3) preserves general capabilities with near-zero over-refusal, (4) achieves baseline-level safety with only 75% of training data, (5) yields better separation between safe and unsafe responses.

Conclusion: Staged-Competence is agnostic to policy optimisation loss and extensible to other DPO variants and alignment domains, with code and data publicly available.

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) is widely used for safety alignment in large language models. However, prior work shows it is brittle and exhibits poor out-of-distribution (OOD) generalisation. In this paper, we investigate whether Curriculum Learning can improve the robustness of DPO-based safety alignment. We propose Staged-Competence, a curriculum-based framework that organises preference data by difficulty, employs competence-based sampling, and progressively updates the reference model during training. Averaged across three model families, Staged-Competence reduces OOD harmful response rates by 16% and jailbreak attack success rates by 20%, while preserving general capabilities with near-zero over-refusal. We further show that Staged-Competence (1) matches baseline safety with only 75% of the training data and (2) yields better separation between safe and unsafe responses. Staged-Competence is agnostic to the policy optimisation loss and can extend to other DPO variants and alignment domains. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Sandeep5500/curriculum-learning-for-safety.

</details>


### [280] [MULTISEISMO: A Multimodal Seismic Dataset and Model for Cross-Modal Seismic Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26320)
*Sai Munikoti,Ian Stewart,Chengping Chai,Lisa Linville,Scott Vasquez,Sameera Horawalavithana,Karl Pazdernik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发布 MultiSeismo：一个覆盖 2010–2023 年、逾 1.6 万次地震事件的多模态地震数据集（波形时序＋强度/人口暴露地图＋结构化文本元数据，统一 JSON 格式），并配套 17 类、50 万条指令集 MISCE/MICSE。在其上，作者为 Unified-IO 2 接入预训练 Chronos-T5 时序编码器并微调，得到首个面向地震分析的多模态模型 SeisModal。评测显示通用多模态模型（Unified-IO 2、Phi-4）在地震跨模态推理上普遍得分极低，尤其时序模态最差；SeisModal 在文本/时序上大幅领先，验证了领域化数据与架构改造的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用多模态模型（GMM）在专业科学领域的落地受制于领域多模态数据的极度稀缺。地震学尤其如此：理解一次地震需要融合时序波形、地理空间图像（ShakeMap 强度图、PGA/PGV 图、人口暴露图）与文本元数据（构造背景、矩张量、震源参数），而现有数据资源（如 SeisBench 下的 STEAD、INSTANCE、NEIC 等）基本是单模态的，以波形＋元数据为主，缺少图像、缺少自然语言指令，无法支撑跨模态多模态语言模型的训练与评测。同时通用 GMM 对时序信号的编码能力薄弱，无法直接处理地震波形。因此需要一个面向地震的结构化多模态数据集＋指令基准，并探索“通用架构＋专用时序编码器”的领域适配路径。

Method: （1）数据构建：从 USGS NEIC ShakeMap 归档抓取 2010-01-01 至 2023-12-31、M≥2.5 的全球事件，下载 Event page（Regional Information、PAGER、Origin、Moment Tensor，HTML/PDF）与 ShakeMap 图片（PNG），通过 NSF IRIS/Obspy Web 服务下载 HDF5 波形；经过滤清洗管线后聚合为统一 JSON（含 metadata、Regional_Information、Origin、Moment-tensor、onepager、shakemap、waveforms 等约 1130 字段，27.3 个唯一字段）。得到 16K+ 事件、91,313 张图（宏观烈度图 26.9%、仪器地震动图 22.5%、衰减/对比曲线图 50.6%）、平均每事件 51 个台站、约 990 s 波形。（2）指令生成：与地震学专家共同定义 17 个指令模板（文本 11 类/112K 条、图像 3 类/14K 条、时序 3 类/67K 条），共 50 万+ 条，覆盖信息检索到数学推理的多难度层次，形成 MICSE（正文）与 MISCE（摘要）指令集。（3）模型：在 Unified-IO 2 上加入预训练 Chronos-T5 时序编码器＋投影层，按文本→图像→时序顺序在留出训练集上顺序微调，仅解冻模态投影层与解码器 LLM，得到 SeisModal；Phi-4 因难以改造则以文本形式输入时序（128K 长上下文，时序降采样至 1024 步）。（4）评测三部分：按模态统计指令测试集上的 BLEU/ROUGE/BERTscore；Phi-4 在 1024/2048/4096/8092 不同波形粒度上的“地震波 vs 噪声”分类；CLIP 与 ImageBind 的图像-图像、文本-图像检索（MRR、R@10），并与随机基线对比。

Result: （1）指令评测：两个预训练模型在三个模态上得分普遍很低（Phi-4 文本 BLEU 0.0299/ROUGE 0.0549/BERT 0.403，图像 0.0924/0.124/0.491，时序 0.0218/0.0407/0.389；Unified-IO 2 文本 0.0111/0.0243/0.350，时序 0.0445/0.0187/0.352），时序模态最难；图像模态表现最好，Unified-IO 2 在图像上最优（BLEU 0.545、ROUGE 0.501、BERT 0.786），部分得益于 Phi-4 回答过于冗长降低文本重叠分。SeisModal 在文本（0.213/0.209/0.232）与时序（0.675/0.664/0.824）上显著优于两者，图像上 BLEU/ROUGE 最高（0.642/0.630）但 BERT 反而下降（0.683 vs 0.786），作者归因于数值类任务（如数图中台站数）出现随机化猜测。（2）时序粒度实验：序列长度从 1024 增至 8092 时 BLEU 仅由 0.0159 升至 0.0201，收益递减；模型输出显示明显不确定与犹豫。（3）检索实验（N=7887）：ImageBind 全面优于 CLIP（图-图 MRR 0.0173 vs 0.00840；文-图 0.00834 vs 0.000889），但均显著高于随机基线（~1e-4）却仍很低，说明仅凭“震级+位置”标题与事件图像之间的关联很弱。

Conclusion: MultiSeismo 是首个系统化的地震多模态数据集与指令基准，验证了“领域数据标准化＋专用时序编码器”的方法论：SeisModal 作为首个地震领域专用多模态模型证明通用架构可经定向结构改造适配专业科学领域，且时间序列编码器是瓶颈所在；当前所有模型在地震跨模态推理上都很弱，MultiSeismo 可作为衡量多模态地震推理能力的严格基准，并向其他科学领域提供可迁移的指令数据集构建模板。局限包括：图像与时序指令模板过少（受限于缺乏城市级烈度真值、波形仅有 P 波信息）、M<2.5 事件被过滤导致人为/非构造事件缺失、答案缺少推理解释（不利于可解释推理模型训练）；未来方向为 CNN/对抗自编码器时序编码器、多台站统一表征、与已有数据集融合、异常检测与检索子任务细化。

Abstract: The application of generalist multimodal models (GMMs) to specialized scientific domains remains limited due to the scarcity of comprehensive domain-specific datasets that integrate multiple data modalities beyond text and images. In seismology, understanding earthquake phenomena requires the synthesis of timeseries waveform data, geographical imagery, and contextual metadata, a multimodal integration absent in existing seismic datasets. We present MultiSeismo, a large scale structured multimodal seismic dataset, comprising over 16K seismic events spanning 13 years (2010 to 2023) across diverse geographical regions. Each event data integrates waveform recordings from global station networks, intensity maps, population exposure visualizations, and a comprehensive textual description within a standardized JSON format. We additionally develop MISCE, a multimodal instruction set on top of raw data to enable supervised training and evaluation of GMMs on seismic reasoning tasks ranging from basic information retrieval to complex cross modal analysis. We leverage MISCE to finetune an existing multimodal model (Unified IO 2) enhanced with a specialized timeseries encoder, which yields SeisModal, the first domain specific multimodal model for comprehensive seismic analysis. Evaluation of state of the art multimodal models on MultiSeismo reveals significant challenges, particularly with time-series data processing for general purpose models, while demonstrating SeisModal's superior performance on seismic multimodal reasoning tasks. These results prove that MultiSeismo provides a rigorous benchmark for future multimodal research in seismology and validate the success of our domain specific architectural adaptations.

</details>


### [281] [Semigroup Consistency as a Diagnostic for Learned Physics Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26324)
*Lennon J. Shikhman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"半群一致性"（semigroup consistency）作为学习型物理模拟器的后验、模型无关的评估诊断量：通过比较模型直接预测 G(u,s+t) 与复合预测 G(G(u,s),t) 的归一化差异（半群误差 E_sg），无需额外真值求解即可度量学习到的演化映射是否满足 S_{t+s}=S_t∘S_s 必要结构条件。在一维热方程与粘性 Burgers 方程、time-conditioned ConvNet 与 FNO1D 两类基线上，unseen 半群误差与 rollout 退化呈正相关（轨迹级 Spearman ρ=0.635，95% CI [0.621, 0.649]）；而显式的半群正则化（λ_sg=0.01）效果混杂、聚合上无可靠提升，因此半群一致性主要应作为评估诊断而非普适训练目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型物理模拟器（PDE 代理模型、神经算子）通常用单步或短时程预测误差来评估，但这可能掩盖时间复合结构上的失效：模型可能在固定时间步长上表现良好，却在自回归 rollout、时步外推、边界/参数偏移等场景下退化，甚至学到"脆性"的、依条件索引的插值解族而非连贯的演化规则。作者指出，对于自治（autonomous）且状态完备（state-complete）的系统，其精确解映射必然构成单参数半群 S_{t+s}=S_t∘S_s、S_0=I，这是"跨时间细分保持连贯预测"的结构性必要条件，可作为无需额外真值求解的轻量自洽性检验，从而补充单步误差、rollout 误差与能量/谱诊断。

Method: 1) 定义归一化半群误差 E_sg(u;s,t)=‖G(G(u,s),t)−G(u,s+t)‖₂/(‖G(u,s+t)‖₂+ε)，ε>0 防止耗散系统中状态范数近零导致不稳定。2) 诊断协议：在留出状态上采样满足 s,t>0 且 s+t 在时程内的 (s,t) 对，分别计算直接与复合预测并求相对差异，区分"seen"（训练式时间增量）与"unseen"（更大/更少见的分解）两种情形；对状态、时间对、随机种子、系统与模型类做平均。3) 实验系统：一维热方程（ν=0.05）与粘性 Burgers 方程（ν=0.02），周期边界条件，网格 N_x=128、21 个时间点、128/32/64 训练/验证/测试轨迹，初值为衰减随机 Fourier 级数；分布外测试包括 unseen (s,t)、初值谱偏移、Burgers 黏性 ν→0.03。4) 模型：时间条件化残差 ConvNet（TC-Conv）与紧凑 FNO1D，均用正弦时间嵌入、Δt/T 输入、残差预测；每个家族训练预测基线与半群正则变体。5) 指标：relL2 单步误差、rollout AUC 误差、末时刻 rollout 误差、seen/unseen 半群误差及逐轨迹 Spearman ρ；统计用 2000 次 bootstrap 95% CI、配对 bootstrap 差值区间、Wilcoxon 符号秩检验、Cohen's d，5 个随机种子。

Result: 在所有留出轨迹、系统、架构与训练变体上，unseen 半群误差与 rollout AUC 误差正相关，轨迹级全局 Spearman ρ=0.635，95% CI [0.621, 0.649]（Figure 2）。unseen 半群误差平均比 seen 高 0.0165，说明更大的时间复合会暴露额外不一致（时间复合偏移）。单步误差与 rollout/半群行为并非一一对应：FNO1D 的单步误差普遍低于 TC-Conv，但其半群与 rollout 行为随系统与正则化设置仍有明显差异（如 Burgers TC-Conv ρ=0.414→0.592，而 Heat FNO1D 加 SG 后 rollout 从 0.585 恶化至 0.956）。半群正则化的聚合效应不可靠：未见过半群误差的配对基线减 SG 差值为 0.0017（CI [−0.0123, 0.0156]），rollout AUC 差值为 −0.0633（CI [−0.2408, 0.1171]），两者区间均含零。

Conclusion: 半群一致性是一个可在训练后直接应用、无需架构改动或重训练、也无需额外真值求解的时序自洽性诊断量，能揭示被单步误差掩盖的 rollout 不稳定、时步外推失败、固定步长过拟合与过度阻尼等失效模式。作者强调它是单向警告信号：大半群误差表明违反必要结构条件，但小半群误差不构成正确性证明（模型可能内部自洽却解错方程），因此应与单步误差、rollout 误差及物理专属诊断并报。局限包括仅在一维简单系统上验证、非自治/受控/随机/历史依赖系统需改用演化族或 cocycle 一致性条件（附录C给出 G_θ(u,r,t) 版本的推广）、强耗散下归一化可能敏感、混沌系统长时程需配合分布/统计量度量；未来工作为更高维 PDE、更真实模拟器与更丰富的复合感知训练方法。

Abstract: Learned physics simulators are often evaluated by one-step or short-horizon prediction error, but these metrics can miss failures in temporal composition and long-horizon rollout. For autonomous, state-complete systems, exact solution maps satisfy a semigroup law: direct evolution over $s+t$ should agree with evolution over $s$ followed by $t$. We propose normalized semigroup error as a post hoc, model-agnostic diagnostic comparing these direct and composed learned predictions. On one-dimensional heat and Burgers dynamics with time-conditioned ConvNet and FNO baselines, semigroup error is positively associated with rollout degradation, with trajectory-level Spearman correlation $ρ= 0.635$ and $95%$ CI $[0.621, 0.649]$. Semigroup regularization has mixed effects, supporting semigroup consistency primarily as an evaluation diagnostic rather than a universally beneficial training objective.

</details>


### [282] [Reparametrizing Shampoo and SOAP for Subspace Basis Updates and BFloat16 Storage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26327)
*Alan Milligan,Zikun Xu,Simon Lacoste-Julien,Felix Dangel,Wu Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对Shampoo类优化器在高精度要求和BFP16存储下性能下降的问题，提出了一种预条件器重参数化方法，通过子空间部分QR更新在保持性能的同时提高内存和时间效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shampoo类方法（KL-Shampoo、SOAP等）虽性能优异，但依赖QR分解，存在计算开销大、内存占用高的问题。现有QR实现需要FP32精度，当预条件器矩阵较大时导致时间和内存成本高，而使用BFP16存储虽能减少内存但会降低性能。

Method: 提出了预条件器的重参数化方法：支持BFP16存储；通过结合更新的基向量与未更新的基向量形成完整基；仅通过子空间中的QR分解更新部分基向量。

Result: 在BFP16存储下提升了SOAP和KL-SOAP的性能，使KL-SOAP能达到或超越KL-Shampoo的效果，同时降低了计算开销。

Conclusion: 该方法使Shampoo类方法更加高效、实用，且可广泛应用于所有使用QR分解的Shampoo变体。

Abstract: Shampoo-based methods, such as KL-Shampoo and SOAP, have demonstrated strong performance in training neural networks and rely on QR decomposition. Because existing QR implementations require single-precision (FP32) arithmetic and remain computationally expensive, these methods become time- and memory-intensive when their preconditioning matrices are large. Moreover, using BFloat16 (BFP16) storage to reduce memory usage can degrade the performance of Shampoo-based methods. We propose a reparametrization of the preconditioner that supports BFP16 storage and forms a complete basis by combining updated basis vectors with unchanged ones. By updating only part of the basis through QR decomposition in a subspace, our approach reduces computational overhead while mitigating the performance degradation caused by BFP16 storage. Our approach applies broadly to Shampoo-based methods that employ QR decomposition, including KL-Shampoo, SOAP, and KL-SOAP. In particular, it improves the performance of SOAP and KL-SOAP under BFP16 storage, enabling KL-SOAP to match or exceed KL-Shampoo. Overall, our approach makes Shampoo-based methods more memory- and time-efficient.

</details>


### [283] [QAM-W: Joint 2D Codebook Quantization for LLM Weights via Hadamard Rotation and Activation-Aware Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26339)
*Preetam Sharma,Kacper Dobek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: QAM-W引入块Hadamard旋转与2D联合编码，恢复权重行内坐标结构，在5-6 bpw质量保持区间内达到FP16 perplexity的±0.4%误差，较SmoothQuant W8A8节省32%权重比特。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scalar post-training quantizers discard pairwise coordinate structure within weight rows, leading to suboptimal compression.

Method: Block-Hadamard rotation + 2D coordinate pairing + Lloyd-Max codebook on circular Gaussian + activation-aware per-channel scaling

Result: At ~5.5 bpw: ±0.4% BF16 perplexity deviation; matches SmoothQuant W8A8 at 32% fewer bits; 2D coding outperforms polar by 2-15pp; KL-BF16 correlation ρ=0.99

Conclusion: QAM-W establishes a quality-preserving 5-6 bpw band, achieving SmoothQuant W8A8 quality at 32% fewer weight bits. Joint 2D coding with activation-aware scaling enables consistent perplexity within ±0.4% of FP16 across diverse architectures.

Abstract: Scalar post-training quantizers discard pairwise coordinate structure within weight rows. We introduce QAM-W (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation for Weights), a codec that recovers this structure: each row is L2-normalized, block-Hadamard rotated, paired into 2D coordinates, and quantized against a single Lloyd-Max codebook trained on the unit circular Gaussian, with activation-aware per-channel scaling. In a cross-model study spanning five LLMs from four families (1.1B--13B parameters) and eight quantized configurations, the activation-aware variant at $\approx 5.5$ bpw stays within $\pm 0.4\%$ of BF16 WikiText-2 perplexity on every model, matching the SmoothQuant W8A8 quality envelope at $32\%$ fewer weight bits. Joint 2D coding outperforms polar (amplitude $\times$ phase) coding by 2--15~pp $Δ$PPL at equal bitrate, and paired KL against BF16 tracks $Δ$PPL\% at Spearman $ρ= 0.99$ across 37 (method, model) rows, consistent with a monotone composite bound from codec distortion to KL divergence. A 3.5~bpw variant is competitive on quantization-tolerant architectures. At strict 4~bpw, the rotated-codebook frontier method QTIP outperforms QAM-W; the contribution is the quality-preserving 5--6~bpw band.

</details>


### [284] [A PAC-Bayesian View of Generalisation for Physics-Informed Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26341)
*Thien V. Nguyen,Amaury Habrard,Benjamin Guedj*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Paper develops a PAC-Bayesian framework for physics-informed machine learning that provides high-probability generalization guarantees with unbounded losses, using a multi-task perspective that jointly treats data fidelity, PDE residuals, and boundary conditions. The derived bounds scale with input-gradient norms, revealing a direct link between physical regularity and generalization. Includes practical self-bounding-aware learning algorithm.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing analyses of physics-informed machine learning rely on approximation or stability arguments and do not fully capture how physical structure influences generalization from finite data, especially in regression settings with unbounded losses.

Method: Developed a PAC-Bayesian framework with multi-task perspective, deriving bounds where complexity scales with input-gradient norms of losses. Instantiated under Sobolev and Poincaré assumptions, yielding two classes of bounds.

Result: Bounds are non-vacuous, significantly tighter than union-bound baselines, and can be effectively minimized during training on standard PDE benchmarks.

Conclusion: Results provide a principled statistical foundation for understanding generalization in physics-informed models, with practical algorithms for optimizing generalization bounds during training.

Abstract: Physics-informed machine learning (PIML) integrates mechanistic knowledge, typically in the form of partial differential equations (PDE), into data-driven models. Despite strong empirical performance, its statistical generalisation properties remain poorly understood, particularly in the regression setting with unbounded losses. Existing analyses rely on approximation or stability arguments and do not fully capture how physical structure influences generalisation from finite data. In this work, we develop a PAC-Bayesian framework for PIML that provides high-probability generalisation guarantees in the presence of unbounded losses. We adopt a multi-task perspective that jointly treats data fidelity, PDE residuals, initial and boundary conditions, avoiding the looseness induced by standard union-bound approaches. Our analysis leverages the structure of physics-informed objectives to derive novel bounds where the complexity scales with input-gradient norms of the losses, revealing a direct link between physical regularity and generalisation. We instantiate this framework under Sobolev and Poincaré-type assumptions, yielding two classes of bounds that trade off statistical complexity and smoothness in different regimes. Building on these results, we propose a self-bounding-aware learning algorithm that directly optimises tractable surrogates of the derived bounds, along with a practical procedure to estimate the associated constants in realistic settings. Empirical evaluations on standard PDE benchmarks demonstrate that our bounds are non-vacuous, significantly tighter than union-bound baselines, and can be effectively minimised during training. Overall, our results provide a principled statistical foundation for the generalisation of physics-informed models.

</details>


### [285] [MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26343)
*Barsat Khadka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MechRL：把「机制可解释性中的电路发现（circuit discovery）」重新表述为一个强化学习问题，训练单一 PPO 剪枝策略在 GPT-2 small 的计算图上逐边删除组件，并以激活修补定义的因果忠实度奖励作为指导；策略在 12 个训练行为上联合训练后，可零样本迁移到 7 个未见过的行为，并恢复出人工分析已知的注意力头（必要性/特异性对照通过），但其电路在同等忠实度下比 ACDC 更大、比归因贪心更贵，属于成本-最小性权衡平面上的被支配内部点。

⚠️ 需要注意：所给摘要与 arXiv 全文描述的实验并不一致。摘要称动作空间为 GPT-2 small 的 144 个注意力头、以零消融与对比奖励、在 induction 与 IOI 两个任务上训练、best-of-five 达到 oracle 上限的 96%；而全文描述的是在约 32,000 条边上以 EAP-IG 预筛出 top-K=3000 候选边的边级剪枝、在 12 个行为（IOI/greater-than/docstring 各 4 个变体）上训练、best-of-sixteen 部署、并在 7 个留出行为上评估，且全文明确将 induction 排除在实验之外。两者在动作空间、任务数、评测协议与关键数字上均不同，应视为两个版本/设定，引用时须核对版本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机制可解释性需要为每个新行为单独手工或半自动地逆向出稀疏的计算电路（attention head、MLP 及其连接），已知方法如 ACDC（贪心剪枝）、edge-attribution patching / EAP-IG（按归因分数保留高分边）虽把第 3 步「剪枝到电路」系统化，但每个行为都要从零独立跑一次全流程，先前发现一个电路的算力投入对下一个行为毫无收益，即「电路发现已被自动化，但未被摊销（amortised）」。另一类基于梯度下降学习 per-task mask 的方法（Cao et al. 2021；Bhaskar et al. 2024）同样是单一行为、单独拟合、无法迁移。因此作者提出的核心问题是：电路发现这一过程本身能否被学习成一个可复用、可迁移的策略，从而把摊销成本一次性付出？

Method: 问题形式化：将边级电路发现建模为 MDP（𝒮,𝒜,T,r,γ），从预筛后的候选图出发，每步由策略选择动作，永久删除边，直到选择 stop；转移确定性，每步通过一次前向传播（激活修补）评估新忠实度。

环境与预筛：计算图取自 Hanna et al. (2024) 的边级图，节点为 GPT-2 small 的 144 个注意力头 + 12 个 MLP + input/logits（共 158 节点），因残差流共享约 32,000 条边；每行为用 EAP-IG（5 步积分）按其自身指标排序，保留 top-K=3000 条边作为候选集。

状态：s_t=(X^e, X^n, m_t, g_t)。边特征 16 维（带符号归因分、重要度排名、父子层号、层距、父子类型 one-hot、Q/K/V 通道）、节点特征 7 维（层号、类型 one-hot、出度、聚合边分）、全局 6 维（步进度、当前忠实度 f_t、剩余边比例、上一步忠实度变化、候选集上限 c_i、headroom f_t−τ）；所有数值在行为内归一化。

动作：三类——stop；batch cut（一次删 N∈{1,3,10,30} 条边，N 条边只需一次前向）；node cut（删掉某组件所有剩余出边）；已删边与耗尽组件被掩蔽。

奖励：以势函数 Φ(f,k)=w(1−k/K)−λ·max(0,τ−f)（w=1, λ=5）为基础，取增量 r_t=Φ(f_{t+1},k_{t+1})−Φ(f_t,k_t) 作 potential-based reward shaping（Ng et al. 1999），另加重复删边惩罚 −0.01；每行为目标 τ_i=c_i（δ=0），以保证跨行为可比。

策略网络：共享 trunk + 四个头（type / edge / node / value），用共享权重对每条边、每个组件独立打分，参数量与 K、M 无关，从而一个网络适配所有行为；trunk 用均值+最大值池化融合边/节点嵌入与全局量得到上下文向量；batch cut 逐条采样并每次重打分以避免删掉互相依赖的边。

训练：PPO + GAE，12 个行为联合训练 1200 次迭代（每次 512 transitions），γ=0.99、GAE λ=0.95、clip 0.2、熵系数 0.01、值系数 0.5、4 轮 4 小批更新、Adam 2.5e-4 线性退火至 0、隐藏宽度 H=128、每 episode 步数上限 150；用 PCGrad 去解多行为梯度冲突，GPT-2 small 全程冻结。

评测与对照：与 ACDC（τ∈{0.001,0.003,0.01} 扫描）与 EAP-IG greedy 在同一图、同一忠实度 f≥0.9 下比较（电路大小、|C|、前向传播次数）；有效性检验包括 ground-truth 组件恢复率、necessity（消融电路后行为坍塌）、specificity（同规模随机子图不忠实）；与从随机初始化训练 200 次迭代的对照以证明 warm-start 增益来自预训练策略。

Result: 1）零样本迁移：冻结策略直接应用于 7 个留出行为（带性别代词、主谓一致、缩写、简单/反向三段论、国家-首都事实回忆、多选），忠实度 0.826–0.997，电路 390–1175 条边；6 个有已发表组件的行为恢复率为 7/7、11/12、7/8、5/5、9/9、3/3，necessity 与 specificity 均接近 0（符合期望）。

2）短 warm-start（80 次迭代）：所有行为忠实度不降、多数提升，电路普遍变小；简单三段论从 1175→290 条边、f 0.826→0.920；国家-首都 0.843→0.892，多选 0.874→0.933。

3）与从头训练对照：warm-start 策略从第一次迭代起就只保留几百条边，而从头训练的策略缓慢收缩，200 次迭代后电路仍大 1.3–3.3 倍（中位 1.65），且 6/7 行为忠实度相当或更低。这是「迁移的是通用剪枝能力而非行为特异解」的最直接证据。

4）超出预筛的证据：同规模下 agent 电路的忠实度在 10 个行为中的 9 个不低于 top-|C| 按分数电路；agent 保留的边中有 30%–50% 属于分数排名之外的「discordant」边（随机子集则为 63%–85%），且删除这些边会在 9/10 行为上显著降低忠实度，说明 agent 救回了 EAP-IG 低估但因果必要的边。

5）与逐行为搜索比较：策略位于成本-最小性平面上的被支配内部点——ACDC 在 9/10 行为上给出更小的电路但需 3,400–19,900 次前向，EAP-IG greedy 几乎零前向但在弥散机制（IOI、三段论、docstring、国家-首都）上需保留 1000–3000 条边甚至达不到 f=0.9；策略单次部署约 2.4–2.5k 次前向，warm-start 额外约 40k/行为，一次性训练约 6×10^5 次前向。作者明确不主张总算力节省。

6）局限：预筛是主要瓶颈（候选集上限 c_i 封顶忠实度；induction 因需要约 16,000 条边候选集而被排除），策略未在原始 32,000 边动作空间上搜索；仅在 GPT-2 small 上验证，扩展到更大模型需解决动作空间问题；未来方向是学习环境的 surrogate model 以支持基于模型的 RL/自博弈，从而去掉归因预筛。

Conclusion: 结论：把机制可解释性的电路发现当作一个可学习的序贯决策问题是可行的——单一策略在 12 个行为上联合训练后，可零样本迁移到未见过的行为，恢复其已知注意力头并通过必要性/特异性对照，说明电路发现是可学习、可摊销、可迁移的「程序」而非重复搜索；短 warm-start 进一步精炼并显著缩小电路。但作者坦承策略在同等忠实度下既非最紧凑（不及 ACDC）也非最廉价（不及 EAP-IG greedy），核心未解瓶颈是边级动作空间规模，必须依赖 EAP-IG 预筛并因此受制于其上限（induction 被迫排除）；未来需以学习的环境模型替代真实前向评估以突破预筛与规模化。整体定位是「把自动化搜索变成可迁移技能」的原理性证明，而非对现有电路发现方法的性能超越。

Abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to general next-token prediction from its damage to the target task. A single PPO policy, trained on two tasks (induction and IOI) in a vectorised multi-task environment, attains the per-episode oracle on both training tasks and on a held-out third task (docstring completion). Its preferred heads coincide with the canonical heads of established literature on precisely the axes those papers identify as causally non-redundant under single-head ablation; the categories they identify as redundant are correctly de-prioritised by the agent. On the held-out task, best-of-five planning recovers 96\% of the oracle ceiling with no task signal supplied at evaluation. These results indicate that reinforcement learning over causal interventions is a viable, transferable substrate for identifying the single-head bottlenecks of mechanistic circuits, complementary to existing path-patching approaches.

</details>


### [286] [When Correct Demonstrations Hurt: Rethinking the Role of Exemplars in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26350)
*Chenghao Qiu,Chunli Peng,Yufeng Yang,Kuan-Hao Huang,Yi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了上下文学习(ICL)中"正确性-效用鸿沟"现象：正确的示范不一定有用，某些正确示范甚至会降低ICL准确率。通过引入"任务保持扰动"框架，作者发现扰动后的示范会改变模型用于上下文推理的证据混合，从而分离示范正确性与效用。实验表明，对于小模型、困难任务和高扰动比例，ICL性能会大幅下降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: The intuition that correct input-output examples are necessary for ICL is challenged by a counterintuitive phenomenon: correctness does not guarantee exemplar utility, and some correct demonstrations can even reduce ICL accuracy.

Method: Proposed task-preserving perturbations framework, including label-updating perturbations and stricter target-preserving perturbations, to study the correctness-utility gap in ICL.

Result: Task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance, especially for smaller models, harder tasks, and higher perturbation ratios.

Conclusion: Task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance; robust ICL requires evaluating not only whether demonstrations are correct, but also how they influence contextual inference.

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is often motivated by the intuition that demonstrations help because they provide correct input-output examples. However, we reveal a counterintuitive phenomenon: correctness does not guarantee exemplar utility, and some correct demonstrations can even reduce ICL accuracy. To study this correctness-utility gap, we introduce task-preserving perturbations, where only the exemplar input is changed, while the example remains a correct instance of the same task. Concretely, each perturbed exemplar is assigned the target induced by the task mapping. This framework covers both label-updating perturbations, where task-relevant semantics change and targets are recomputed, and stricter target-preserving perturbations, where the original target remains valid. We formalize the resulting failure mode as contextual evidence shift: task-preserving perturbations can change the effective mixture of evidence used by the model for contextual inference, thereby separating exemplar correctness from exemplar utility. Across sentiment classification, logical reasoning, and math word problems, we find that task-preserving perturbed demonstrations can substantially degrade ICL performance, especially for smaller models, harder tasks, and higher perturbation ratios. Our results show that robust ICL requires evaluating not only whether demonstrations are correct, but also how they influence contextual inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Chenghao-Qiu/Task-Preserving-ICL.

</details>


### [287] [Energy-Gated Attention and Wavelet Positional Encoding: Complementary Inductive Biases for Transformer Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26355)
*Athanasios Zeris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出两种互补归纳偏置解决标准Transformer注意力的缺陷：能量门控注意力(EGA)通过学习能量估计选择"关注什么"，Morlet位置编码(MoPE)通过小波编码选择"在哪里关注"。两者组合在TinyShakespeare上实现超加和性改善(+0.119)，证明显著性和局部性是互补归纳偏置。实验限制在6M参数以下、字符级基准、单种子训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准Transformer注意力机制存在两个缺陷：将所有令牌视为同等显著，忽视输入的信息结构；所有位置被视为同等局部，无法捕捉不同尺度/频率下的位置影响差异。

Method: 提出两种简单组件：能量门控注意力(EGA)通过单线性投影学习键令牌嵌入的能量估计来门控值聚合，实现"选择关注内容"；Morlet位置编码(MoPE)用学习的高斯窗小波替换固定正弦编码，自适应调整联合位置-频率定位，实现"选择关注位置"。

Result: EGA单独使用获得+0.092验证损失改善，MoPE单独使用为-0.032，但两者组合达到+0.119——超过部分之和。该超加和性在两次独立训练运行中均观察到。消融实验确认结构化谱先验始终不如无约束学习组件。

Conclusion: MoPE与EGA的组合在TinyShakespeare上取得+0.119验证损失改善，超过两者单独使用效果之和，表明能量显著性和尺度选择局部性作为互补归纳偏置具有协同增益效应。

Abstract: Standard transformer attention computes pairwise token similarity but treats all tokens as equally salient and all positions as equally local, regardless of the informational structure of the input. We identify two complementary inductive biases that standard attention lacks: energy salience (which tokens concentrate informational energy, learned end-to-end without explicit frequency decomposition) and scale-selective locality (how far positional influence extends at each frequency, implemented via Morlet wavelet encoding). We address both with two simple components. Energy-Gated Attention (EGA) gates value aggregation by a learned energy estimate of key token embeddings, computed via a single linear projection; it selects what to attend to. Morlet Positional Encoding (MoPE) replaces fixed sinusoidal encodings with learned Gaussian-windowed wavelets that adapt the joint position-frequency localization to the corpus; it specifies where attention operates at each scale. On TinyShakespeare, EGA alone achieves +0.092 validation loss improvement over standard attention (+0.103 over Phase 1-3 baseline); MoPE alone is -0.032 (below baseline as a standalone encoding); but their combination achieves +0.119 -- more than the sum of parts. This superadditivity, observed across two independent training runs, is the central empirical finding: salience and locality are complementary inductive biases, each addressing a gap the other cannot fill alone. Ablations confirm that structured spectral priors (Morlet wavelet gates, scale-initialized heads, fixed sinusoidal PE) consistently underperform their unconstrained learned counterparts, while complementary learned components interact superadditively. All experiments are at small scale (<=6M parameters, character-level benchmarks, single seed); larger-scale multi-seed validation is the most important direction for future work.

</details>


### [288] [Balancing Plasticity and Stability with Fast and Slow Successor Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26357)
*Raymond Chua,Doina Precup,Blake Richards*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper investigates deep RL agents in environments with gradual continual drift (as opposed to abrupt changes). Through experiments in modified Miniworld and MuJoCo environments, the authors demonstrate that stability-focused synaptic consolidation methods outperform plasticity-focused approaches like parameter resetting. They further show that consolidating Successor Features across multiple timescales is particularly effective, suggesting that stability and predictive representations are key for continual learning in realistic non-stationary settings.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Real-world environments evolve gradually through continual drift, but prior RL research focuses on abrupt task changes. This distinction is critical for the stability-plasticity dilemma, as abrupt changes may demand different mechanisms than naturalistic gradual changes. The paper aims to investigate appropriate learning strategies for realistic non-stationary settings.

Method: Modified 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments with naturalistic continual non-stationarity; compared synaptic consolidation (stability-focused) vs. parameter resetting (plasticity-focused); applied consolidation to Successor Features across multiple timescales.

Result: Stability-favoring methods (synaptic consolidation) outperform plasticity-focused approaches (parameter resetting); consolidating Successor Features yields superior performance compared to consolidating Q-values; multi-timescale stabilization of SFs captures complementary aspects of gradual environmental change.

Conclusion: Multi-timescale consolidation of Successor Features is an effective approach for continual learning; prioritizing stability over plasticity is crucial when environmental changes are gradual rather than abrupt.

Abstract: A hallmark of intelligence is the ability to adapt in non-stationary environments, yet deep Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents often struggle in such settings. Prior studies introduce non-stationarity through abrupt shifts in features or dynamics, whereas real-world environments often evolve gradually through continual drift. This distinction has important implications for the "stability-plasticity dilemma" in RL, as abrupt task changes may demand more plasticity than naturalistic settings. To address this, we modify existing 3D Miniworld and MuJoCo environments to incorporate naturalistic, continual non-stationarity, and use them to examine how stability and adaptation affect performance under continuous environmental change. We find that methods favoring stability, such as synaptic consolidation, outperform approaches focused on plasticity, such as parameters resetting. Motivated by this result, and prior evidence that Successor Features (SFs) reduce interference, we investigate whether SFs are better consolidation targets than Q-values. Across both environments, applying neuro-inspired synaptic consolidation to SFs yields superior performance on continually changing settings. Moreover, consolidation is most effective when SFs are stabilized across multiple timescales, which capture complementary aspects of gradual environmental change. Together, these results suggest that stability is more critical in continual learning when changes are gradual, and that multi-timescale consolidation of predictive representations is an effective approach.

</details>


### [289] [Online Learning on Hidden-Convex Losses via Algorithmic Equivalence: Optimal Regret, Geometric Barrier, and Bandit Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26373)
*Anas Barakat,Andreas Kontogiannis,Vasilis Pollatos,Ioannis Panageas,Antonios Varvitsiotis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了隐藏凸损失下在线学习的最优遗憾恢复问题。通过改进离散时间算法等价性论证，证明了在线梯度下降法在相同假设下可达到 O(√T) 的最优对抗遗憾界。同时将充分条件从对角Jacobian条件收紧为必要且充分的Hessian相容性条件，并证明了该条件的必要性。进一步扩展至单点bandit反馈场景，提出球面平滑策略并给出 O(T^(3/4)) 遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究(Ghai et al., 2022)仅证明隐藏凸损失下 OGD 可达 O(T^(2/3)) 遗憾界，但无法确定能否恢复 OCO 中的最优 Θ(√T) 遗憾率；同时其几何条件(对角Jacobian)是否必要且充分尚不明确。

Method: 通过更精确的离散时间算法等价性论证，证明 OGD 在隐藏凸损失上可实现 O(√T) 遗憾界；建立 Hessian 相容性作为必要充分条件；构造反例验证条件必要性；扩展至单点 bandit 反馈场景并采用球面平滑技术。

Result: 理论上证明了 OGD 在隐藏凸设置下可达 O(√T) 最优遗憾界；确立了 Hessian 相容性作为算法等价的充要条件；当该条件失败时，OGD 遗憾可退化至 Ω(T)；Bandit OGD 在球面平滑下可达 O(T^(3/4)) 期望遗憾。

Conclusion: 通过Hessian相容性条件替代原有对角Jacobian条件，扩大了可容许重参数化类别。Bandit设置下提出球面平滑的 bandit OGD，达到 O(T^(3/4)) 期望遗憾界。

Abstract: We study adversarial online learning with hidden-convex losses, i.e., nonconvex losses that become convex after a nonlinear reparameterization. Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) proved that, under geometric and smoothness assumptions, online gradient descent (OGD) on such nonconvex losses approximately simulates online mirror descent (OMD) on the underlying convex losses with a suitable regularizer, yielding $\mathcal{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret. They left open whether the optimal $Θ(\sqrt{T})$ regret from online convex optimization can be recovered in this hidden-convex setting. We answer this question affirmatively. More specifically, via a sharper discrete-time algorithmic equivalence argument, we prove that OGD achieves $\mathcal{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret under the same assumptions, matching the optimal worst-case rate for adversarial online convex optimization. We also address another open question of Ghai, Lu and Hazan (2022) by clarifying the geometry required for this algorithmic equivalence. We replace the diagonal-Jacobian sufficient condition with a necessary-and-sufficient Hessian compatibility condition, thereby expanding the class of admissible reparameterizations. We complement our tight regret bound with a lower bound showing that the Hessian compatibility assumption is essential for OGD; when it fails, we construct a smooth reparameterization and an adversarial sequence of hidden-convex losses for which OGD suffers $Ω(T)$ regret. Finally, we extend our analysis to one-point bandit feedback and prove a $\mathcal{O}(T^{3/4})$ expected regret bound for bandit OGD with spherical smoothing, matching its classical rate on convex losses.

</details>


### [290] [Function-Valued Causal Influence in Nonlinear Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26408)
*Valentina V. Kuskova,Dmitry Zaytsev,Michael Coppedge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文批判了时序因果发现中将非线性模型学习到的因果关系简化为标量边分数的做法，指出这会造成严重信息瓶颈。作者提出函数值因果影响（function-valued causal influence）概念，并用个体条件期望（ICE）框架从训练好的模型中直接估计因果响应函数。实验表明，具有相同标量分数的边可能呈现截然不同的函数行为，且该方法能揭示标量方法系统性地遗漏的特定情境因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Scalar causal edge scores (common in nonlinear ML-based causal discovery) obscure the true object learned—state-dependent functions whose effects vary across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. These scalar scores conflate between-state variation with within-state residual noise, causing loss of important structural information.

Method: The authors use Neural Additive Vector Autoregression (NAVAR) as a representative architecture and introduce a framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation (ICE) for estimating causal response functions from trained models.

Result: Controlled experiments show that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors (monotonic, thresholded, saturating, sign-changing effects). Applied to democratic development data, function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

Conclusion: The paper demonstrates through synthetic and real-world experiments that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structures that scalar score methods systematically miss.

Abstract: Causal discovery in time series is increasingly performed using nonlinear machine-learning models, yet the resulting causal relationships are almost always summarized by scalar edge scores. We argue that this practice obscures the true object learned by nonlinear autoregressive models: a state-dependent function whose effect varies across regimes, magnitudes, and contexts. We formalize function-valued causal influence for additive, contribution-decomposable architectures and show that scalar causal scores constitute a severe information bottleneck, conflating between-state variation with within-state residual noise. Using Neural Additive Vector Autoregression as a representative architecture, we introduce a practical framework based on Individual Conditional Expectation for estimating causal response functions directly from trained models. Through controlled synthetic experiments, we demonstrate that edges with indistinguishable scalar scores can exhibit qualitatively different functional behaviors, including monotonic, thresholded, saturating, and sign-changing effects. An applied case study on democratic development further shows that function-valued analysis reveals regime-specific and asymmetric causal structure systematically missed by score-centric approaches.

</details>


### [291] [Amortized Factor Inference Networks for Posterior Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26419)
*Joohwan Ko,Justin Domke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs)：一个把模型表示为"带类型的先验/似然因子列表"的 encode–merge–decode 推断网络，通过参数共享的 Deep-Sets 式 MLP 与无位置编码注意力，其权重形状与隐变量维度 D 和观测数 N 无关。单个训练好的 AFIN 在一次前向传播（~10 ms）内给出高斯后验近似，精度经自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）修正后可比 NUTS 与逐任务变分推断，但测试时计算量低 2–4 个数量级；还可通过小规模适配器扩展到新的似然类型（如 Poisson），并在合成与 UCI 任务上优于 NPE-PFN/TabPFN 基础模型基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经后验估计（NPE）等摊销推断方法虽能实现快速测试时贝叶斯推断，但本质上绑定于固定的先验、似然与模拟器；一旦更换先验/似然族、参数取值或数据规模，就需要重新训练或昂贵的测试时微调。已有工作只放宽了其中一个维度（如观测数 N、模型参数 θ、或用概率程序文本表示模型），且往往仍需逐任务拟合才能达到 NUTS 级精度。作者提出的核心问题是：能否训练单一推断网络，同时泛化到变化的先验族、似然族、隐变量维度 D 与观测数量 N，甚至在测试时直接接受未见过的因子类型组合？其动机还来自共轭推断的启示：指数族中"编码每个因子→自然参数相加→解码后验"这一模板可以泛化到非共轭情形，只要把三步都变成可学习的、且参数量不随维度变化的模块。

Method: 模型接口：m=(D, N, t_{0:N}, θ_{0:N})，每个观测对应一个似然因子，类型标签 t_n 与数值参数 θ_n 分开，观测在给定 z 时条件独立，先验为因子 0。
架构：Encoder 用类型专属 adapter（把该类型的 θ_n、y_n、协变量经 symlog 与两层坐标级 MLP 编码成节点/对描述子）后接共享的 4 层 node-pair 网络，输出统一的节点特征 E^node∈R^{D×C} 与对特征 E^pair∈R^{D×D×C}（C=40，pair 数组每步对称化）；Merge 用 M=4 个无位置编码的 Transformer 块，让各因子的 node/pair 作为 token 互相注意（注意力分数对坐标与坐标对取平均，node/pair 分数用可学习 λ 混合，8 头×5 维），再沿因子轴求和得 Ȳ；Decoder 由三个坐标级 MLP 输出 μ、精度对角 r_i 与非对角 Ω_ij，通过"对角 = Σ|Ω_ik| + softplus(r_i)+1e-4"保证精度矩阵严格对角占优、正定，用 Cholesky 做密度与采样。
维度无关性：所有映射为参数绑定（parameter-tied）MLP，等价于 Deep Sets 层（局部项 + 全局均值池化），node/pair 摘要取 row/col/diag/全局均值等置换等变线性映射的子集，因此权重形状与 D、N 无关且对坐标置换等变。
训练：在线生成任务（先抽模型再抽 z 与 y），目标为 max E_{p(m,z,y)}[log q(z; f_w(y,m))]（等价最小化前向 KL，偏向覆盖后验质量），AdamW 10 万步、余弦衰减、4 个微批次梯度累积、EMA 权重，单张 H100 不到 24 小时，共 4,550,011 个可训练参数（adapter 55,376 / 共享编码器 728,384 / merge 块 3,643,208 / 解码器 123,043）。训练分布：D∈{1..16}、N∈{1..256} 按偏置采样，4 种先验（对角/全协方差高斯、Student-t、Laplace），5 种似然（含协变量的高斯、含协变量的 Student-t、Bernoulli-logit、Binomial-logit），同一任务可混合多种似然。
推断：一次前向得到 (μ, Λ)；可选 SNIS 以 q_φ 为提议分布做无额外优化的后验修正。计算量 O(KD²(CH+H²)+K²D²C)，D 方向 O(D³)（Cholesky），内存对 D 二次、对 N 线性。

Result: 合成基准：直接 AFIN 输出的 SW²=0.0412、M1=0.0533、M2=0.1047，经 SNIS 修正后与 NUTS（两种实现）及更长 FRVI 拟合的误差相当，而前向耗时约 10 ms（D≤16、N≤64），D=64 时 67 ms/1.1 GB、N=1024 时 71 ms/1.3 GB，测试时算力比 NUTS/VI 低 2–4 个数量级。SNIS 诊断显示 AFIN 提议 ESS/样本在数据丰富设置达 0.954、权重退化小，但在数据稀缺与异质似然设置 ESS 降至 0.25–0.47。UCI 12 个任务上 SW²/M1/M2 相对时间曲线同样优于 VI 与 NUTS。校准：训练范围内 90% 边际区间覆盖 0.875（平均绝对偏差 2.6 个百分点），共轭任务上直接预测覆盖 0.92；外推时明显退化（N=384–1024 时 0.57，D=24–64 时 0.74）。消融：node+pair+注意力最优，node-only 注意力次之（0.0490），去掉注意力的"求和"变体大幅变差（0.132/0.143）；merge 消融中 learned attention 优于 uniform mixing 再优于 self-only；训练时排除的先验–似然组合在测试时误差升高（M1 0.052→0.072），表明组合泛化不完美但仍有迁移。扩展：新增 Poisson 似然仅训练 adapter（4.9 GPU-h）即可用，SW² 0.059→0.030，与已有似然混合时 90% 区域质量仍约 0.90；对比 NPE-PFN（TabPFN v2，1k/10k 上下文）在全部 144 个任务上 AFIN 的 M1/M2/SW² 均更低，且 SNIS 后 ESS 更高（0.81 vs 0.60）。

Conclusion: AFIN 证明：把模型表示为"带类型的因子列表"并用 encode–merge–decode 的参数共享网络处理，可让单一摊销推断网络同时覆盖先验族、似然族、参数取值、隐变量维度与观测数量，权重形状与 D、N 无关，并保留置换等变性；其共轭式"编码—求和—解码"组织是对指数族自然参数相加的可学习推广，通过注意力实现因子间信息交换以逼近非共轭依赖。局限与未来方向：(1) 作用域限于单一全局隐向量、条件独立观测、已知因子参数，需扩展到层次模型与局部隐变量；(2) 解码器为高斯，限制可表达后验，可换为混合/流式解码器以保持 SNIS 所需密度；(3) 成本对 D 与 N 均为二次，D 的外推精度最先退化，需在更大规模上训练。需注意论文中 Table 1 的 NUTS 级精度对比并非受控比较，E.9 的 NPE-PFN 对比也使用了各自的评估预算与计时口径。

Abstract: Amortized inference promises fast test-time Bayesian inference, but existing methods are inherently tied to fixed models. Extending amortization to unseen models typically requires retraining or costly test-time finetuning. In this paper, we ask: is it possible to build a single inference network capable of generalizing across varying priors, likelihoods, and dimensionality? We introduce Amortized Factor Inference Networks (AFINs), a family of encode-merge-decode inference networks built on dimension-independent modules that map a model specification and its observations to the parameters of a variational posterior. Experimentally, a single trained AFIN achieves posterior accuracy comparable to NUTS and several variational inference methods, while requiring 2 to 4 orders of magnitude less test-time compute. Code is available at https://github.com/joohwanko/AFINs.

</details>


### [292] [FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26423)
*Peiyu Duan,Jiyao Wang,Nicha C. Dvornek,Junlin Yang,Ziqi Gao,Lawrence H. Staib,James S. Duncan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FM-fMRI，一个基于事件条件流匹配的任务态fMRI生成模型，可从静息态fMRI合成任务态ROI时间序列，在HCP和BioPoint自闭症数据集上表现优于扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线方法，并成功应用于自闭症分类任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务态fMRI能直接反映神经动力学，但获取成本高、难度大；而静息态fMRI数据丰富易得，因此需要研究从静息态到任务态的跨模态合成方法，以降低大规模应用的门槛。

Method: 提出FM-fMRI方法，采用事件条件流匹配（flow-matching）模型学习从静息态fMRI到任务态ROI时间序列的条件向量场，支持连续时间生成和基于ODE的快速采样，可灵活处理异质性事件计划。

Result: FM-fMRI在Human Connectome Project和BioPoint自闭症队列上实现了最强的频谱和连接一致性，分布匹配性能优于条件扩散模型、GAN和VAE基线。

Conclusion: FM-fMRI可有效合成任务态fMRI时间序列，在数据受限的临床场景中具有实用价值；通过增强BioPoint队列数据，成功提升了自闭症分类的下游任务性能。

Abstract: Task-based fMRI provides a direct readout of task-evoked neural dynamics, but it is expensive and difficult to acquire at scale, motivating rest-to-task synthesis from widely available resting-state fMRI (rsfMRI). We propose FM-fMRI, an event-conditioned flow-matching model that learns a continuous-time conditional vector field to generate task ROI time series from a subject's rsfMRI and the task event information. The formulation enables fast ODE-based sampling and flexible conditioning over heterogeneous event schedules. Rather than optimizing for pointwise reconstruction, we evaluated generated signals using complementary criteria that probe temporal and spectral structure, subject and group-level connectome consistency, and distributional alignment. On the public Human Connectome Project and internal BioPoint autism cohort, FM-fMRI achieves the strongest spectral and connectivity agreement and improved distribution-level matching over conditional diffusion, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and variational autoencoders (VAEs) baselines. Furthermore, we augment the BioPoint cohort by synthesizing task-fMRI ROI time series with our method, improving downstream autism classification and demonstrating practical utility in data-limited clinical settings. The code will be available on GitHub.

</details>


### [293] [Aperiodic and Low-Frequency Spectral Bias in Reconstruction based EEG Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26434)
*Aditya Kommineni,Emily Zhou,Kleanthis Avramidis,Simon Bock Segaard,Jeppe Roden Münster,Andreas Peter Juhl Hansen,Takfarinas Medani,Tiantian Feng,Richard Leahy,Shrikanth Narayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究揭示了重建目标预训练任务与EEG信号特殊频谱结构之间的根本不匹配：基于重建的EEG基础模型倾向于过度表征高频 aperiodic 成分而忽视 oscillatory 成分，且编码了过多的受试者身份信息而非任务相关特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管EEG基础模型在大数据场景下表现良好，但在低资源环境下往往无法优于完全监督模型。

Method: 通过受控的合成生成的EEG输入进行实验，并结合真实世界BCI数据集上的线性探针评估。

Result: EEG基础模型嵌入主要捕获EEG信号的周期性成分，而对振荡成分（尤其是高频）的表征不足；嵌入编码了更多受试者身份信息而非任务相关信息。

Conclusion: Future work should incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure to develop more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

Abstract: EEG foundation models, pre-trained on large-scale unlabelled EEG data, have emerged as a promising direction towards learning generalizable EEG representations. Despite showing positive results in data-rich regimes, they often fail to outperform significantly smaller supervised models in low-resource settings compared to fully supervised models. We provide a mechanistic account of this shortcoming, attributing it to a fundamental mismatch between reconstruction-based pretext tasks and the idiosyncratic spectral structure of EEG signals, which decompose into distinct high-power aperiodic and low-power oscillatory components. Using controlled, synthetically-generated EEG inputs, we demonstrate that EEG foundation model embeddings are biased to capture the aperiodic components of the EEG signal while under-representing oscillatory components, particularly at higher frequencies. Additionally, linear probe evaluations on real-world BCI datasets further reveal that embeddings encode subject identity more strongly than task-relevant information, thereby reinforcing the low-frequency and aperiodic component bias in foundation model embeddings trained primarily on reconstruction based objectives. Together, these findings elucidate a failure mode in reconstruction based EEG foundation models and motivate future work to incorporate auxiliary losses explicitly targeting high-frequency oscillatory structure as a path toward more capable and generalizable EEG representations.

</details>


### [294] [DDGAD: Trajectory Dynamics for Diffusion-Based Graph Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26446)
*Yuxin Yang,Limei Hu,Feng Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DDGAD框架，利用轨迹动力学区分正常和异常节点，通过可靠性感知共识机制抑制GCN中的污染传播问题，在五个真实数据集上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GCN的图异常检测方法存在污染传播的根本问题——异常节点通过消息传递污染其邻居的表示，导致检测性能下降。

Method: 提出基于轨迹动力学的扩散图异常检测框架（DDGAD）。引入分布式可靠性感知共识精炼机制缓解污染传播，定义三种互补的异常信号：邻域不一致性、可靠性权重和动力学冲突能量，并提供正常节点稳定性的初步理论分析。

Result: 在五个真实数据集上进行了广泛实验，验证了框架的有效性。

Conclusion: DDGAD框架通过分布式可靠性感知共识精炼机制有效抑制了污染传播，在五个真实数据集上验证了有效性。正常节点在扩散正则化和可靠性感知邻域共识的耦合作用下表现出稳定一致的表示轨迹，而异常节点则因全局流形先验与局部污染消息传递之间的方向分歧而呈现不稳定冲突的动力学行为。

Abstract: Graph anomaly detection (GAD) aims to identify nodes or substructures whose behavior or attributes deviate significantly from the overall pattern in graph-structured data, with critical applications in financial risk control, social network analysis, and cybersecurity. However, existing GCN-based methods suffer from the fundamental problem of contamination propagation, where anomalous nodes pollute the representations of their neighbors through message passing, leading to degraded detection performance. In this paper, we propose DDGAD, a novel diffusion-based graph anomaly detection framework that leverages trajectory dynamics to distinguish normal and anomalous nodes. Our key insight is that normal nodes exhibit consistent and stable representation trajectories under the coupled effects of diffusion regularization and reliability-aware neighborhood consensus, while anomalous nodes exhibit unstable and conflicting dynamics due to the directional disagreement between the global manifold prior and locally contaminated message passing. To mitigate contamination propagation, we introduce a distributed reliability-aware consensus refinement mechanism and define three complementary anomaly signals: neighbor inconsistency, reliability weight, and dynamical conflict energy. We further provide a preliminary theoretical analysis on normal node stability under the coupled dynamics. These signals collectively characterize anomalous behaviors from the perspectives of local inconsistency, consensus reliability, and dynamical instability. Extensive experiments on five real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

</details>


### [295] [MuCon: Clipped Muon Updates for LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26459)
*Albert Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了MuCon剪切操作能否在避免完整密集SVD的前提下进行近似。通过推导极分解和标量根的精确恒等式，揭示了阈值附近奇异值的病态性是主要数值障碍，并指出矩阵函数方法需配合稳定的极分解原语或显式正则化才能可靠运行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon优化器中的剪切（clipping）操作通常需要完整的密集奇异值分解（SVD），计算成本高昂。该论文旨在探究在何种条件下可以绕过完整SVD来近似MuCon剪切步骤。

Method: 给出了两个精确恒等式：极分解/绝对值公式和标量根 formulation，后者引入了剪切正定因子的有理牛顿滤波器。同时分析了两种方法共有的数值障碍：阈值附近的奇异值导致符号决策和有理求解器病态化。

Result: 识别出MuCon剪切计算的数值障碍本质：当奇异值接近剪切阈值τ时，符号决策变得病态，导致有理方程组条件数激增。

Conclusion: 矩阵函数方法仅在与稳定的极分解/平方根原语或显式正则化结合时才能有效使用；该研究为构建无需完整密集SVD的近似MuCon剪切算法奠定了理论基础。

Abstract: Muon-style optimizers take a matrix-valued momentum or preconditioned update $B = U \operatorname{diag}(σ_1,\ldots,σ_r) V^\top$ and replace it with its canonical partial polar factor $\operatorname{Pol}(B) = U V^\top$. This maps every nonzero singular value to one. MuCon is the clipped-Muon variant studied here: it applies singular-value clipping to the same Muon matrix, $D^{\mathrm{MuCon}}\_τ(B) = \operatorname{MClip}\_τ(B) = U \operatorname{diag}\bigl(\min\{σ\_i,τ\}\bigr) V^\top, \qquad τ> 0$. Thus, $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ denotes the mathematical clipping operator, while MuCon denotes the optimizer primitive that substitutes this clipped direction for Muon's polar direction. The Muon/MuCon scaling parameterization used in this work is called $\text{SpectralP}$: it is the hidden-matrix scaling recipe under which polar Muon or clipped MuCon directions are applied. The map $\operatorname{MClip}\_τ$ is the Frobenius projection onto the spectral-norm ball $\{X : \|X\|_2 \le τ\}$: it leaves singular values at or below $τ$ unchanged and modifies only the violating singular directions. This paper asks when the MuCon clipping step can be approximated without a full dense SVD. We record two exact identities, a polar/absolute-value formula and a scalar-root formulation leading to a rational Newton filter for the clipped positive-semidefinite factor, and identify the numerical obstruction common to both: singular values near the threshold make sign decisions and rational solves ill-conditioned. Matrix-function methods are therefore useful only when paired with stable polar/square-root primitives or explicit regularization near the clipping boundary.

</details>


### [296] [Diffuse to Detect: Generative Diffusion Models for Unsupervised IC Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.26468)
*Yuxuan Yin,Chen He,Todd Jacobs,Jialei He,Boxun Xu,Robert Jin,Peng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个基于扩散Transformer的无监督异常检测框架，用于半导体潜在缺陷筛选。通过自编码器压缩原始测试数据，结合正弦位置编码和晶圆位置嵌入生成结构化token序列，利用扩散模型中频时间步的噪声预测误差计算异常分数，实现无需标注缺陷的晶圆级快速筛查，并在16nm工业IC数据上达到最优性能，同时提供可解释的失效定位能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Latent defect screening faces extreme challenges: near-zero failure rates, high-dimensional test data, and absence of labeled anomalies, making traditional supervised approaches infeasible.
